boast.quick_def: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.  [disapproval]

watched.quick_def: If you watch someone or something, you look at them, usually for a period of time, and pay attention to what is happening.

playroom.quick_def: A playroom is a room in a house for children to play in.

rabbits.quick_def: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets, or live wild in holes in the ground.

industrial.quick_def: You use industrial to describe things which relate to or are used in industry.

revolution.quick_def: A revolution is a successful attempt by a large group of people to change the political system of their country by force.

increased.quick_def: If something increases or you increase it, it becomes greater in number, level, or amount.

productivity.quick_def: Productivity is the rate at which goods are produced.

decreases.quick_def: When something decreases or when you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

putting.quick_def: When you put something in a particular place or position, you move it into that place or position.

job.quick_def: A job is the work that someone does to earn money.

shrinking.quick_def: If cloth or clothing shrinks, it becomes smaller in size, usually as a result of being washed.

daily.quick_def: If something happens daily, it happens every day.

generation.quick_def: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

worried.quick_def: When you are worried, you are unhappy because you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen in the future.

new-found.quick_def: If something is new-found, it is something that you have recently got or discovered.

least.quick_def: You use at least to say that a number or amount is the smallest that is possible or likely and that the actual number or amount may be greater. The forms at the least and at the very least are also used.

bothered.quick_def: If you do not bother to do something or if you do not bother with it, you do not do it, consider it, or use it because you think it is unnecessary or because you are too lazy.

output.quick_def: Output is used to refer to the amount of something that a person or thing produces.

hour.quick_def: An hour is a period of sixty minutes.

doubled.quick_def: You use double to indicate that something includes or is made of two things of the same kind.

reserved.quick_def: If something is reserved for a particular person or purpose, it is kept specially for that person or purpose.

unemployed.quick_def: Someone who is unemployed does not have a job.

underemployed.quick_def: If someone is underemployed, they have not got enough work to do, or their work does not make full use of their skills or abilities.

ii.quick_def: II is a Roman numeral that stands for the number 2.

noticeably.quick_def: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

wages.quick_def: Someone's wages are the amount of money that is regularly paid to them for the work that they do.

stagnated.quick_def: If something such as a business or society stagnates, it stops changing or progressing.  [disapproval]

bookstores.quick_def: A bookstore is the same as a bookshop.  [mainly US]

abound.quick_def: If things abound, or if a place abounds with things, there are very large numbers of them.  [formal]

manuals.quick_def: Manual work is work in which you use your hands or your physical strength rather than your mind.

describing.quick_def: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

manage.quick_def: If you manage an organization, business, or system, or the people who work in it, you are responsible for controlling them.

stress.quick_def: If you stress a point in a discussion, you put extra emphasis on it because you think it is important.

reasons.quick_def: The reason for something is a fact or situation which explains why it happens or what causes it to happen.

companies.quick_def: A company is a business organization that makes money by selling goods or services.

responded.quick_def: When you respond to something that is done or said, you react to it by doing or saying something yourself.

improvements.quick_def: If there is an improvement in something, it becomes better. If you make improvements to something, you make it better.

climate.quick_def: The climate of a place is the general weather conditions that are typical of it.

having.quick_def: You use the forms have and has with a past participle to form the present perfect tense of verbs.

overtime.quick_def: Overtime is time that you spend doing your job in addition to your normal working hours.

hiring.quick_def: If you hire someone, you employ them or pay them to do a particular job for you.

personnel.quick_def: The personnel of an organization are the people who work for it.

economist.quick_def: An economist is a person who studies, teaches, or writes about economics.

b.quick_def: B is the second letter of the English alphabet.

schor.quick_def: Schor is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a person's family.

harvard.quick_def: Harvard is a very famous and old university in the United States.

current.quick_def: A current is a steady and continuous flowing movement of some of the water in a river, lake, or sea.

gained.quick_def: If a person or place gains something such as an ability or quality, they gradually get more of it.

amount.quick_def: The amount of something is how much there is, or how much you have, need, or get.

notoriety.quick_def: To achieve notoriety means to become well-known for something bad.

jobless.quick_def: Someone who is jobless does not have a job, although they would like one.

entirely.quick_def: Entirely means completely and not just partly.

decoupled.quick_def: If two countries, organizations, or ideas that were connected in some way are decoupled, the connection between them is ended.  [formal]

employment.quick_def: Employment is the fact of having a paid job.

firms.quick_def: A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

downsizing.quick_def: To downsize something such as a business or industry means to make it smaller.  [business]

profits.quick_def: A profit is an amount of money that you gain when you are paid more for something than it cost you to make, get, or do it.

climb.quick_def: If you climb something such as a tree, mountain, or ladder, or climb up it, you move towards the top of it. If you climb down it, you move towards the bottom of it.

equal.quick_def: If two things are equal or if one thing is equal to another, they are the same in size, number, standard, or value.

d.quick_def: D is the fourth letter of the English alphabet.

spreading.quick_def: If you spread something somewhere, you open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

observes.quick_def: If you observe a person or thing, you watch them carefully, especially in order to learn something about them.

labour.quick_def: Labour is very hard work, usually physical work.

g.quick_def: G is the seventh letter of the English alphabet.

ehrenberg.quick_def: Ehrenberg is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a person's family.

cornell.quick_def: Cornell is the name of a well-known university. It's a place where people go to study and learn.

pushes.quick_def: When you push something, you use force to make it move away from you or away from its previous position.

employers.quick_def: Your employer is the person or organization that you work for.

fewer.quick_def: You use a few to indicate that you are talking about a small number of people or things. You can also say a very few.

workers.quick_def: A particular kind of worker does the kind of work mentioned.

compels.quick_def: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

incentives.quick_def: If something is an incentive to do something, it encourages you to do it.

involve.quick_def: If a situation or activity involves something, that thing is a necessary part or consequence of it.

calls.quick_def: If you call someone or something by a particular name or title, you give them that name or title.

structure.quick_def: The structure of something is the way in which it is made, built, or organized.

compensation.quick_def: Compensation is money that someone who has experienced loss or suffering claims from the person or organization responsible, or from the state.

quirks.quick_def: A quirk is something unusual or interesting that happens by chance.

salaries.quick_def: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

benefits.quick_def: The benefit of something is the help that you get from it or the advantage that results from it.

profitable.quick_def: A profitable organization or practice makes a profit.

ask.quick_def: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

managerial.quick_def: Managerial means relating to the work of a manager.

supply.quick_def: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

obvious.quick_def: If something is obvious, it is easy to see or understand.

lesson.quick_def: A lesson is a fixed period of time when people are taught about a particular subject or taught how to do something.

lines.quick_def: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

once.quick_def: If something happens once, it happens one time only.

salary.quick_def: A salary is the money that someone is paid each month by their employer, especially when they are in a profession such as teaching, law, or medicine.

cost.quick_def: The cost of something is the amount of money that is needed in order to buy, do, or make it.

firm.quick_def: A firm is an organization which sells or produces something or which provides a service which people pay for.

whether.quick_def: You use whether when you are talking about a choice or doubt between two or more alternatives.

office.quick_def: An office is a room or a part of a building where people work sitting at desks.

diminishing.quick_def: When something diminishes, or when something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

returns.quick_def: When you return to a place, you go back there after you have been away.

overworked.quick_def: If you overwork or if someone overworks you, you work too hard, and are likely to become very tired or ill.

lose.quick_def: If you lose a contest, a fight, or an argument, you do not succeed because someone does better than you and defeats you.

arable.quick_def: Arable farming involves growing crops such as wheat and barley rather than keeping animals or growing fruit and vegetables. Arable land is land that is used for arable farming.

pastures.quick_def: Pasture is land with grass growing on it for farm animals to eat.

employer.quick_def: Your employer is the person or organization that you work for.

incentive.quick_def: If something is an incentive to do something, it encourages you to do it.

hourly.quick_def: An hourly event happens once every hour.

receive.quick_def: When you receive something, you get it after someone gives it to you or sends it to you.

pension.quick_def: Someone who has a pension receives a regular sum of money from the state or from a former employer because they have retired or because they are widowed or have a disability.

contributions.quick_def: If you make a contribution to something, you do something to help make it successful or to produce it.

medical.quick_def: Medical means relating to illness and injuries and to their treatment or prevention.

insurance.quick_def: Insurance is an arrangement in which you pay money to a company, and they pay money to you if something unpleasant happens to you, for example if your property is stolen or damaged, or if you get a serious illness.

tied.quick_def: If you tie two things together or tie them, you fasten them together with a knot.

harder.quick_def: Something that is hard is very firm and stiff to touch and is not easily bent, cut, or broken.

complain.quick_def: If you complain about a situation, you say that you are not satisfied with it.

trade.quick_def: Trade is the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods or services between people, firms, or countries.

reduced.quick_def: If you reduce something, you make it smaller in size or amount, or less in degree.

huge.quick_def: Something or someone that is huge is extremely large in size.

penalty.quick_def: A penalty is a punishment that someone is given for doing something which is against a law or rule.

career.quick_def: A career is the job or profession that someone does for a long period of their life.

maintains.quick_def: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

negative.quick_def: A fact, situation, or experience that is negative is unpleasant, depressing, or harmful.

signal.quick_def: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

lotte.quick_def: Lotte is a name, usually used for a person.

bailyn.quick_def: Bailyn is a name, usually used to call a person.

massachusetts.quick_def: a north-eastern US state in New England, also known informally as the Bay State or the Old Colony. The capital and largest city is Boston. The state was settled in 1620 by the Pilgrim Fathers. It played an important part in the American Revolution and was one of the original 13 states. Its main industries include the production of electronic and communication equipment, as well as education and research. It also produces a lot of vegetables and fruit, especially cranberries.

institute.quick_def: An institute is an organization set up to do a particular type of work, especially research or teaching. You can also use institute to refer to the building the organization occupies.

adds.quick_def: If you add one thing to another, you put it in or on the other thing, to increase, complete, or improve it.

corporate.quick_def: Corporate means relating to business corporations or to a particular business corporation.  [business]

managers.quick_def: A manager is a person who is responsible for running part of or the whole of a business organization.

measure.quick_def: If you measure the quality, value, or effect of something, you discover or judge how great it is.

contribution.quick_def: If you make a contribution to something, you do something to help make it successful or to produce it.

underlings.quick_def: You refer to someone as an underling when they are inferior in rank or status to someone else and take orders from them. You use this word to show that you do not respect someone.  [disapproval]

well-being.quick_def: Well-being is the state of being happy, healthy, and comfortable.

proxy.quick_def: If you do something by proxy, you arrange for someone else to do it for you.

know.quick_def: If you know a fact, a piece of information, or an answer, you have it correctly in your mind.

adjust.quick_def: When you adjust to a new situation, you get used to it by changing your behaviour or your ideas.

behavior.quick_def: People's or animals' behavior is the way that they behave. You can refer to a typical and repeated way of behaving as a behavior.

accordingly.quick_def: You use accordingly to introduce a fact or situation which is a result or consequence of something that you have just referred to.

belongs.quick_def: If something belongs to you, you own it.

fit.quick_def: If something fits, it is the right size and shape to go onto a person's body or onto a particular object.

cites.quick_def: If you cite something, you quote it or mention it, especially as an example or proof of what you are saying.  [formal]

both.quick_def: You use both when you are referring to two people or things and saying that something is true about each of them.

quantitative.quick_def: Quantitative means relating to different sizes or amounts of things.  [formal]

qualitative.quick_def: Qualitative means relating to the nature or standard of something, rather than to its quantity.  [formal]

part-time.quick_def: If a job is part-time, you only work for some of the normal working hours, not the whole time.

succumb.quick_def: If you succumb to temptation or pressure, you do something that you want to do, or that other people want you to do, although you feel it might be wrong.  [formal]

fatigue.quick_def: Fatigue is a feeling of extreme physical or mental tiredness.

stressful.quick_def: If a situation or experience is stressful, it causes the person involved to feel stress.

jobs.quick_def: A job is the work that someone does to earn money.

employ.quick_def: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

gain.quick_def: If a person or place gains something such as an ability or quality, they gradually get more of it.

resulting.quick_def: A result is something that happens or exists because of something else that has happened.

redundancy.quick_def: When there are redundancies, an organization tells some of its employees to leave because their jobs are no longer necessary or because the organization can no longer afford to pay them.  [British, business]

asserts.quick_def: If someone asserts a fact or belief, they state it firmly.  [formal]

cover.quick_def: If you cover something, you place something else over it in order to protect it, hide it, or close it.

contingencies.quick_def: A contingency is something that might happen in the future.  [formal]

going.quick_def: When you go somewhere, you move or travel there.

crises.quick_def: A crisis is a situation in which something or someone is affected by one or more very serious problems.

workplace.quick_def: Your workplace is the place where you work.

positive.quick_def: If you are positive about things, you are hopeful and confident, and think of the good aspects of a situation rather than the bad ones.

experiences.quick_def: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity, which you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

change.quick_def: If there is a change in something, it becomes different.

more-is-better.quick_def: The idea that having more of something is always better.

culture.quick_def: Culture consists of activities such as the arts and philosophy, which are considered to be important for the development of civilization and of people's minds.

reports.quick_def: If you report something that has happened, you tell people about it.

appear.quick_def: If you say that something appears to be the way you describe it, you are reporting what you believe or what you have been told, though you cannot be sure it is true.  [vagueness]

willing.quick_def: You use will to indicate that you hope, think, or have evidence that something is going to happen or be the case in the future.

experiment.quick_def: An experiment is a scientific test which is done in order to discover what happens to something in particular conditions.

flexible.quick_def: A flexible object or material can be bent easily without breaking.

arrangements.quick_def: Arrangements are plans and preparations which you make so that something will happen or be possible.

financial.quick_def: Financial means relating to or involving money.

cultural.quick_def: Cultural means relating to a particular society and its ideas, customs, and art.

successfully.quick_def: Something that is successful achieves what it was intended to achieve. Someone who is successful achieves what they intended to achieve.

makers.quick_def: The maker of a product is the firm that manufactures it.

models.quick_def: A model of an object is a physical representation that shows what it looks like or how it works. The model is often smaller than the object it represents.

build.quick_def: If you build something, you make it by joining things together.

tiny.quick_def: Something or someone that is tiny is extremely small.

buyers.quick_def: A buyer is a person who is buying something or who intends to buy it.

humblest.quick_def: A humble person is not proud and does not believe that they are better than other people.

household.quick_def: A household is all the people in a family or group who live together in a house.

object.quick_def: An object is anything that has a fixed shape or form, that you can touch or see, and that is not alive.

notes.quick_def: A note is a short letter.

curious.quick_def: If you are curious about something, you are interested in it and want to know more about it.

inversion.quick_def: When there is an inversion of something, it is changed into its opposite.  [formal]

designers.quick_def: A designer is a person whose job is to design things by making drawings of them.

incomes.quick_def: A person's or organization's income is the money that they earn or receive, as opposed to the money that they have to spend or pay out.

noble.quick_def: If you say that someone is a noble person, you admire and respect them because they are unselfish and morally good.  [approval]

manufactured.quick_def: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.  [business]

versatile.quick_def: If you say that a person is versatile, you approve of them because they have many different skills.  [approval]

imposing.quick_def: If you impose something on people, you use your authority to force them to accept it.

mirror.quick_def: A mirror is a flat piece of glass which reflects light, so that when you look at it you can see yourself reflected in it.

width.quick_def: The width of something is the distance it measures from one side or edge to the other.

court.quick_def: A court is a place where legal matters are decided by a judge and jury or by a magistrate.

small.quick_def: A small person, thing, or amount of something is not large in physical size.

dirt.quick_def: If there is dirt on something, there is dust, mud, or a stain on it.

dramatically.quick_def: A dramatic change or event happens suddenly and is very noticeable and surprising.

serving.quick_def: If you serve your country, an organization, or a person, you do useful work for them.

crowns.quick_def: A crown is a circular ornament, usually made of gold and jewels, which a king or queen wears on their head at official ceremonies. You can also use crown to refer to anything circular that is worn on someone's head.

teeth.quick_def: Teeth is the plural of tooth.

doses.quick_def: A dose of medicine or a drug is a measured amount of it which is intended to be taken at one time.

dispose.quick_def: If you  dispose of something that you no longer want or need, you throw it away.

unwanted.quick_def: If you say that something or someone is unwanted, you mean that you do not want them, or that nobody wants them.

horizon.quick_def: The horizon is the line in the far distance where the sky seems to meet the land or the sea.

optical.quick_def: Optical devices, processes, and effects involve or relate to vision, light, or images.

store.quick_def: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, store is used mainly to refer to a large shop selling a variety of goods, but in American English a store can be any size of shop.

programs.quick_def: A program is a set of instructions that a computer follows in order to perform a particular task.  [computing]

information.quick_def: Information about someone or something consists of facts about them.

pulses.quick_def: Your pulse is the regular beating of blood through your body, which you can feel when you touch particular parts of your body, especially your wrist.

lasers.quick_def: A laser is a narrow beam of concentrated light produced by a special machine. It is used for cutting very hard materials, and in many technical fields such as surgery and telecommunications.

electrons.quick_def: An electron is a tiny particle of matter that is smaller than an atom and has a negative electrical charge.  [technical]

fibres.quick_def: A fibre is a thin thread of a natural or artificial substance, especially one that is used to make cloth or rope.

copper.quick_def: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used to make things such as coins and electrical wires.

wire.quick_def: A wire is a long thin piece of metal that is used to fasten things or to carry electric current.

machines.quick_def: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

hundreds.quick_def: A hundred or one hundred is the number 100.

vastly.quick_def: Vastly means to an extremely great degree or extent.

workings.quick_def: Working people have jobs which they are paid to do.

cells.quick_def: A cell is the smallest part of an animal or plant that is able to function independently. Every animal or plant is made up of millions of cells.

surge.quick_def: A surge is a sudden large increase in something that has previously been steady, or has only increased or developed slowly.

optic.quick_def: Optic means relating to the eyes or to sight.

liquid.quick_def: A liquid is a substance which is not solid but which flows and can be poured, for example water.

crystal.quick_def: A crystal is a small piece of a substance that has formed naturally into a regular symmetrical shape.

displays.quick_def: If you display something that you want people to see, you put it in a particular place, so that people can see it easily.

billion.quick_def: A billion is a thousand million.

dollar.quick_def: The dollar is the unit of money used in the USA, Canada, Australia, and some other countries. It is represented by the symbol $. A dollar is divided into one hundred smaller units called cents.

employing.quick_def: If a person or company employs you, they pay you to work for them.

plants.quick_def: A plant is a living thing that grows in the earth and has a stem, leaves, and roots.

commerce.quick_def: Commerce is the activities and procedures involved in buying and selling things.

widened.quick_def: If you widen something or if it widens, it becomes greater in measurement from one side or edge to the other.

horizons.quick_def: The horizon is the line in the far distance where the sky seems to meet the land or the sea.

spins.quick_def: If something spins or if you spin it, it turns quickly around a central point.

roman.quick_def: Roman means related to or connected with ancient Rome and its empire.

booming.quick_def: If there is a boom in the economy, there is an increase in economic activity, for example in the amount of things that are being bought and sold.

nearly.quick_def: Nearly is used to indicate that something is not quite the case, or not completely the case.

men.quick_def: A man is an adult male human being.

women.quick_def: Women is the plural of woman.

blowing.quick_def: When a wind or breeze blows, the air moves.

piece.quick_def: A piece of something is an amount of it that has been broken off, torn off, or cut off.

chihuly.quick_def: Chihuly is a family name. Usually, it refers to a person with this last name.

smiling.quick_def: When you smile, the corners of your mouth curve up and you sometimes show your teeth. People smile when they are pleased or amused, or when they are being friendly.

spell.quick_def: When you spell a word, you write or speak each letter in the word in the correct order.

financially.quick_def: Financial means relating to or involving money.

successful.quick_def: Something that is successful achieves what it was intended to achieve. Someone who is successful achieves what they intended to achieve.

headquarters.quick_def: The headquarters of an organization are its main offices.

pizza.quick_def: A pizza is a flat, round piece of dough covered with tomatoes, cheese, and other savoury food, and then baked in an oven.

dollars.quick_def: The dollar is the unit of money used in the USA, Canada, Australia, and some other countries. It is represented by the symbol $. A dollar is divided into one hundred smaller units called cents.

average.quick_def: An average is the result that you get when you add two or more numbers together and divide the total by the number of numbers you added together.

machine.quick_def: A machine is a piece of equipment which uses electricity or an engine in order to do a particular kind of work.

holes.quick_def: A hole is a hollow space in something solid, with an opening on one side.

sags.quick_def: When something sags, it hangs down loosely or sinks downwards in the middle.

secret.quick_def: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

versatility.quick_def: If you say that a person is versatile, you approve of them because they have many different skills.  [approval]

lies.quick_def: If you are lying somewhere, you are in a horizontal position and are not standing or sitting.

interior.quick_def: The interior of something is the inside part of it.

thus.quick_def: You use thus to show that what you are about to mention is the result or consequence of something else that you have just mentioned.  [formal]

random.quick_def: A random sample or method is one in which all the people or things involved have an equal chance of being chosen.

disordered.quick_def: If you describe something as disordered, you mean it is untidy and is not neatly arranged.

fashion.quick_def: Fashion is the area of activity that involves styles of clothing and appearance.

characteristic.quick_def: The characteristics of a person or thing are the qualities or features that belong to them and make them recognizable.

raw.quick_def: Raw materials or substances are in their natural state before being processed or used in manufacturing.

disturbed.quick_def: If you disturb someone, you interrupt what they are doing and upset them.

position.quick_def: The position of someone or something is the place where they are in relation to other things.

molecular.quick_def: Molecular means relating to or involving molecules.

crystalline.quick_def: A crystalline substance is in the form of crystals or contains crystals.

cools.quick_def: Something that is cool has a temperature which is low but not very low.

engineers.quick_def: An engineer is a person who uses scientific knowledge to design, construct, and maintain engines and machines or structures such as roads, railways, and bridges.

tremendous.quick_def: You use tremendous to emphasize how strong a feeling or quality is, or how large an amount is.  [informal, emphasis]

formability.quick_def: Formability is the ability of a material to be shaped into different forms.

allows.quick_def: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

tailor.quick_def: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes.

whatever.quick_def: You use whatever to refer to anything or everything of a particular type.

continue.quick_def: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

mixtures.quick_def: A mixture of things consists of several different things together.

imaginations.quick_def: Your imagination is the ability that you have to form pictures or ideas in your mind of things that are new and exciting, or things that you have not experienced.

sees.quick_def: When you see something, you notice it using your eyes.

dramatic.quick_def: A dramatic change or event happens suddenly and is very noticeable and surprising.

skin.quick_def: Your skin is the natural covering of your body.

electric.quick_def: An electric device or machine works by means of electricity, rather than using some other source of power.

currents.quick_def: A current is a steady and continuous flowing movement of some of the water in a river, lake, or sea.

opaque.quick_def: If an object or substance is opaque, you cannot see through it.

button.quick_def: Buttons are small hard objects sewn on to shirts, coats, or other pieces of clothing. You fasten the clothing by pushing the buttons through holes called buttonholes.

instant.quick_def: An instant is an extremely short period of time.

curtains.quick_def: Curtains are large pieces of material which you hang from the top of a window.  [mainly British]

It is known especially for its ancient buildings, including York Minster. It was an important city in Roman times and in the Middle Ages, and it was the most important city in the Anglo-Saxon region of Northumbria. perform.quick_def: When you perform a task or action, especially a complicated one, you do it.

colours.quick_def: The colour of something is the appearance that it has as a result of the way in which it reflects light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

instantly.quick_def: An instant is an extremely short period of time.

true.quick_def: If something is true, it is based on facts rather than being invented or imagined, and is accurate and reliable.

fulfilment.quick_def: Fulfilment is a feeling of satisfaction that you get from doing or achieving something, especially something useful.

staying.quick_def: If you stay where you are, you continue to be there and do not leave.

distance.quick_def: The distance between two points or places is the amount of space between them.

management.quick_def: Management is the control and organizing of a business or other organization.

higher.quick_def: Something that is high extends a long way from the bottom to the top when it is upright. You do not use high to describe people, animals, or plants.

success.quick_def: Success is the achievement of something that you have been trying to do.

survey.quick_def: If you carry out a survey, you try to find out detailed information about a lot of different people or things, usually by asking people a series of questions.

positions.quick_def: The position of someone or something is the place where they are in relation to other things.

recruitment.quick_def: The recruitment of workers, soldiers, or members is the act or process of selecting them for an organization or army and persuading them to join.

consultants.quick_def: A consultant is an experienced doctor with a high position, who specializes in one area of medicine.  [mainly British]

nb.quick_def: You write NB to draw someone's attention to what you are about to say or write.

selection.quick_def: Selection is the act of selecting one or more people or things from a group.

sectors.quick_def: A particular sector of a country's economy is the part connected with that specified type of industry.

marx.quick_def: Marx is a common surname. It can refer to a person named Marx.

london-based.quick_def: If a person or an organization is London-based, they are located in London or have their main place of work in London.

findings.quick_def: Someone's findings are the information they get or the conclusions they come to as the result of an investigation or some research.

message.quick_def: A message is a piece of information or a request that you send to someone or leave for them when you cannot speak to them directly.

added.quick_def: If you add one thing to another, you put it in or on the other thing, to increase, complete, or improve it.

sight.quick_def: Someone's sight is their ability to see.

significantly.quick_def: A significant amount or effect is large enough to be important or affect a situation to a noticeable degree.

comparison.quick_def: When you make a comparison, you consider two or more things and discover the differences between them.

explanation.quick_def: If you give an explanation of something that has happened, you give people reasons for it, especially in an attempt to justify it.

woman.quick_def: A woman is an adult female human being.

candidate.quick_def: A candidate is someone who is being considered for a position, for example someone who is running in an election or applying for a job.

manages.quick_def: If you manage an organization, business, or system, or the people who work in it, you are responsible for controlling them.

shortlist.quick_def: If someone is on a shortlist, for example for a job or a prize, they are one of a small group of people who have been chosen from a larger group. The successful person is then chosen from the small group.

herself.quick_def: You use herself to refer to a woman, girl, or female animal.

exceptional.quick_def: You use exceptional to describe someone or something that has a particular quality, usually a good quality, to an unusually high degree.  [approval]

qualified.quick_def: Someone who is qualified has passed the examinations that they need to pass in order to work in a particular profession.

counterparts.quick_def: Someone's or something's counterpart is another person or thing that has a similar function or position in a different place.

thoroughly.quick_def: A thorough action or activity is one that is done very carefully and in a detailed way so that nothing is forgotten.

applying.quick_def: If you apply for something such as a job or membership of an organization, you write a letter or email, or fill in a form in order to ask formally for it.

attending.quick_def: If you attend a meeting or other event, you are present at it.

interviews.quick_def: An interview is a formal meeting at which someone is asked questions in order to find out if they are suitable for a job or a course of study.

rely.quick_def: If you rely on someone or something, you need them and depend on them in order to live or work properly.

convince.quick_def: If someone or something convinces you of something, they make you believe that it is true or that it exists.

any.quick_def: You use any in statements with negative meaning to indicate that no thing or person of a particular type exists, is present, or is involved in a situation.

shortcomings.quick_def: Someone's or something's shortcomings are the faults or weaknesses which they have.
