antiseptic.quick_def: Antiseptic is a substance that kills germs and harmful bacteria.

properties.quick_def: Someone's property is all the things that belong to them or something that belongs to them.  [formal]

tannin.quick_def: Tannin is a yellow or brown chemical that is found in plants such as tea. It is used in the process of making leather and in dyeing.

active.quick_def: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

ingredient.quick_def: Ingredients are the things that are used to make something, especially all the different foods you use when you are cooking a particular dish.

hops.quick_def: If you hop, you move along by jumping on one foot.

plus.quick_def: You say plus to show that one number or quantity is being added to another.

boiled.quick_def: When a hot liquid boils or when you boil it, bubbles appear in it and it starts to change into steam or vapour.

allowed.quick_def: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

communities.quick_def: The community is all the people who live in a particular area or place.

flourish.quick_def: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

quarters.quick_def: A quarter is one of four equal parts of something.

succumbing.quick_def: If you succumb to temptation or pressure, you do something that you want to do, or that other people want you to do, although you feel it might be wrong.  [formal]

water-borne.quick_def: If something is water-borne, it is carried or spread by water.

dysentery.quick_def: Dysentery is an infection in a person's intestines that causes them to pass a lot of waste, in which blood and mucus are mixed with the person's faeces.

eccentric.quick_def: If you say that someone is eccentric, you mean that they behave in a strange way, and have habits or opinions that are different from those of most people.

detective.quick_def: A detective is someone whose job is to discover what has happened in a crime or other situation and to find the people involved. Some detectives work in the police force and others work privately.

deduction.quick_def: A deduction is a conclusion that you have reached about something because of other things that you know to be true.

scepticism.quick_def: Scepticism is great doubt about whether something is true or useful.

wary.quick_def: If you are wary of something or someone, you are cautious because you do not know much about them and you believe they may be dangerous or cause problems.

admiration.quick_def: Admiration is a feeling of great liking and respect for a person or thing.

notable.quick_def: Someone or something that is notable is important or interesting.

porter.quick_def: A porter is a person whose job is to be in charge of the entrance of a building such as a hotel.  [British]

distinguished.quick_def: If you can distinguish one thing from another or distinguish between two things, you can see or understand how they are different.

historian.quick_def: A historian is a person who specializes in the study of history, and who writes books and articles about it.

wrote.quick_def: Wrote is the past tense of write.

favourable.quick_def: If your opinion or your reaction is favourable to something, you agree with it and approve of it.

appraisal.quick_def: If you make an appraisal of something, you consider it carefully and form an opinion about it.

wondered.quick_def: If you wonder about something, you think about it, either because it interests you and you want to know more about it, or because you are worried or suspicious about it.

alighted.quick_def: If something is alight, it is burning.

required.quick_def: If you require something or if something is required, you need it or it is necessary.  [formal]

static.quick_def: Something that is static does not move or change.

burst.quick_def: If something bursts or if you burst it, it suddenly breaks open or splits open and the air or other substance inside it comes out.

infant.quick_def: An infant is a baby or very young child.  [formal]

mortality.quick_def: If you refer to the fact that people are mortal, you mean that they have to die and cannot live for ever.

happened.quick_def: Something that happens occurs or is done without being planned.

sudden.quick_def: Sudden means happening quickly and unexpectedly.

bacteria.quick_def: Bacteria are very small organisms. Some bacteria can cause disease.

listers.quick_def: Listers are people with the last name Lister.

agriculture.quick_def: Agriculture is farming and the methods that are used to raise and look after crops and animals.

wiped.quick_def: If you wipe something, you rub its surface to remove dirt or liquid from it.

malaria.quick_def: Malaria is a serious disease carried by mosquitoes which causes periods of fever.

gains.quick_def: If a person or place gains something such as an ability or quality, they gradually get more of it.

sanitation.quick_def: Sanitation is the process of keeping places clean and healthy, especially by providing a sewage system and a clean water supply.

widespread.quick_def: Something that is widespread exists or happens over a large area, or to a great extent.

food.quick_def: Food is what people and animals eat.

height.quick_def: The height of a person or thing is their size or length from the bottom to the top.

weight.quick_def: The weight of a person or thing is how heavy they are, measured in units such as kilograms, pounds, or tons.

statistics.quick_def: Statistics are facts which are obtained from analysing information expressed in numbers, for example information about the number of times that something happens.

got.quick_def: You use get with adjectives to mean 'become'. For example, if someone gets cold, they become cold, and if they get angry, they become angry.

deaths.quick_def: Death is the permanent end of the life of a person or animal.

appeared.quick_def: If you say that something appears to be the way you describe it, you are reporting what you believe or what you have been told, though you cannot be sure it is true.  [vagueness]

blank.quick_def: Something that is blank has nothing on it.

economically.quick_def: Something that is economical does not require a lot of money to operate. For example a car that only uses a small amount of petrol is economical.

digging.quick_def: If people or animals dig, they make a hole in the ground or in a pile of earth, stones, or rubbish.

incidence.quick_def: The incidence of something bad, such as a disease, is the frequency with which it occurs, or the occasions when it occurs.

deduced.quick_def: If you deduce something or deduce that something is true, you reach that conclusion because of other things that you know to be true.

regulating.quick_def: To regulate an activity or process means to control it, especially by means of rules.

drank.quick_def: Drank is the past tense of drink.

antibacterial.quick_def: Antibacterial substances or products kill bacteria.

agent.quick_def: An agent is a person who looks after someone else's business affairs or does business on their behalf.  [business]

preserve.quick_def: If you preserve a situation or condition, you make sure that it remains as it is, and does not change or end.

tax.quick_def: Tax is an amount of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

introduced.quick_def: To introduce something means to cause it to enter a place or exist in a system for the first time.

malt.quick_def: Malt is a substance made from grain that has been soaked in water and then dried in a hot oven. Malt is used in the production of whisky, beer, and other alcoholic drinks.

gin.quick_def: Gin is a strong colourless alcoholic drink made from grain and juniper berries.

rise.quick_def: If something rises, it moves upwards.

suddenly.quick_def: If something happens suddenly, it happens quickly and unexpectedly.

dropped.quick_def: If a level or amount drops or if someone or something drops it, it quickly becomes less.

looser.quick_def: Something that is loose is not firmly held or fixed in place.

grip.quick_def: If you grip something, you take hold of it with your hand and continue to hold it firmly.

japanese.quick_def: Japanese means belonging or relating to Japan, or to its people, language, or culture.

prevalence.quick_def: the fact of existing or being very common at a particular time or in a particular place

provided.quick_def: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

extraordinary.quick_def: If you describe something or someone as extraordinary, you mean that they have some extremely good or special quality.  [approval]

dates.quick_def: A date is a specific time that can be named, for example a particular day or a particular year.

direct.quick_def: Direct means moving towards a place or object, without changing direction and without stopping, for example in a journey.

clipper.quick_def: Clippers are a tool used for cutting small amounts from something, especially from someone's hair or nails.

dipping.quick_def: If you dip something in a liquid, you put it into the liquid for a short time, so that only part of it is covered, and take it out again.

drink.quick_def: When you drink a liquid, you take it into your mouth and swallow it.

stomach-purifying.quick_def: If something is stomach-purifying, it can clean and make the stomach healthier.

breast.quick_def: A woman's breasts are the two soft, round parts on her chest that can produce milk to feed a baby.

milk.quick_def: Milk is the white liquid produced by cows, goats, and some other animals, which people drink and use to make butter, cheese, and yoghurt.

mothers.quick_def: Your mother is the woman who gave birth to you. You can also call someone your mother if she brings you up as if she was this woman. You can call your mother 'Mother'.

healthier.quick_def: Someone who is healthy is well and is not suffering from any illness.

sipped.quick_def: If you sip a drink or sip at it, you drink by taking just a small amount at a time.

pushed.quick_def: When you push something, you use force to make it move away from you or away from its previous position.

contention.quick_def: Someone's contention is the idea or opinion that they are expressing in an argument or discussion.

forge.quick_def: If one person or institution forges an agreement or relationship with another, they create it with a lot of hard work, hoping that it will be strong or lasting.

tea-soaked.quick_def: If something is tea-soaked, it has been in tea for some time and has absorbed the tea's properties.

literacy.quick_def: Literacy is the ability to read and write.

futures.quick_def: The future is the period of time that will come after the present, or the things that will happen then.

essence.quick_def: The essence of something is its basic and most important characteristic which gives it its individual identity.

work-based.quick_def: If something is work-based, it is related to or centered around work.

labour-saving.quick_def: If something is labour-saving, it can help people do things with less work.

afraid.quick_def: If you are afraid of someone or afraid to do something, you are frightened because you think that something very unpleasant is going to happen to you.

technologically.quick_def: Technological means relating to or associated with technology.

entered.quick_def: When you enter a place such as a room or building, you go into it or come into it.  [formal]

abandoned.quick_def: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

wheel.quick_def: The wheels of a vehicle are the circular objects which are fixed underneath it and which enable it to move along the ground.

internationally.quick_def: International means between or involving different countries.

giftedness.quick_def: Giftedness means the quality of having special natural ability or talent.

determined.quick_def: If a particular factor determines the nature of a thing or event, it causes it to be of a particular kind.  [formal]

score.quick_def: In a sport or game, if a player scores a goal or a point, they gain a goal or point.

general.quick_def: A general is a senior officer in the armed forces, usually in the army.

intelligence.quick_def: Intelligence is the quality of being intelligent or clever.

iq.quick_def: Your IQ is your level of intelligence, as indicated by a special test that you do. IQ is an abbreviation for 'intelligence quotient'. Compare EQ.

cut-off.quick_def: A cut-off is a point or limit that decides when something stops or starts.

educational.quick_def: Educational matters or institutions are concerned with or relate to education.

contributes.quick_def: If you contribute to something, you say or do things to help to make it successful.

relationship.quick_def: The relationship between two people or groups is the way in which they feel and behave towards each other.

freeman.quick_def: A man who is a freeman of a particular city has been given a special honour by that city, known as the freedom of the city.

backup.quick_def: Backup consists of extra equipment, resources, or people that you can get help or support from if necessary.

reported.quick_def: If you report something that has happened, you tell people about it.

verbal.quick_def: You use verbal to indicate that something is expressed in speech rather than in writing or action.

interactions.quick_def: When people interact with each other or interact, they communicate as they work or spend time together.

etc.quick_def: etc is used at the end of a list to indicate that you have mentioned only some of the items involved and have not given a full list. etc is a written abbreviation for 'et cetera'.

tests.quick_def: When you test something, you try it, for example by touching it or using it for a short time, in order to find out what it is, what condition it is in, or how well it works.

decidedly.quick_def: Decidedly means to a great extent and in a way that is very obvious.

learned.quick_def: If you learn something, you obtain knowledge or a skill through studying or training.

achievement.quick_def: An achievement is something which someone has succeeded in doing, especially after a lot of effort.

age-norms.quick_def: Age-norms are the normal or expected levels of development, behavior, or achievement for people of a certain age.

manipulate.quick_def: If you say that someone manipulates people, you disapprove of them because they skilfully force or persuade people to do what they want.  [disapproval]

knowledge.quick_def: Knowledge is information and understanding about a subject which a person has, or which all people have.

know-how.quick_def: Know-how is the practical skills and knowledge needed to do something well.

vocabulary.quick_def: Your vocabulary is the total number of words you know in a particular language.

aspect.quick_def: An aspect of something is one of the parts of its character or nature.

dependent.quick_def: Your dependants are the people you support financially, such as your children.  [formal]

heard.quick_def: When you hear a sound, you become aware of it through your ears.

identify.quick_def: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

thinking.quick_def: If you think that something is the case, you have the opinion that it is the case.

excellence.quick_def: If someone or something has the quality of excellence, they are extremely good in some way.

emerge.quick_def: To emerge means to come out from an enclosed or dark space such as a room or a vehicle, or from a position where you could not be seen.

exceptionally.quick_def: You use exceptional to describe someone or something that has a particular quality, usually a good quality, to an unusually high degree.  [approval]

able.quick_def: If you are able to do something, you have skills or qualities which make it possible for you to do it.

includes.quick_def: If one thing includes another thing, it has the other thing as one of its parts.

focused.quick_def: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

challenging.quick_def: A challenge is something new and difficult which requires great effort and determination.

tuition.quick_def: If you are given tuition in a particular subject, you are taught about that subject.

encouragement.quick_def: Encouragement is the activity of encouraging someone, or something that is said or done in order to encourage them.

dream.quick_def: A dream is an imaginary series of events that you experience in your mind while you are asleep.

intellectually.quick_def: in a way that is connected with or using a person's ability to think in a logical way and understand things

average-ability.quick_def: If someone has average-ability, they have a normal or common level of ability, not very high or very low.

older.quick_def: Someone who is old has lived for many years and is no longer young.

pupils.quick_def: The pupils of a school are the children who go to it.

external.quick_def: External is used to indicate that something is on the outside of a surface or body, or that it exists, happens, or comes from outside.

regulation.quick_def: Regulations are rules made by a government or other authority in order to control the way something is done or the way people behave.

teacher.quick_def: A teacher is a person who teaches, usually as a job at a school or similar institution.

compensates.quick_def: To compensate someone for money or things that they have lost means to pay them money or give them something to replace that money or those things.

effective.quick_def: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

self-regulation.quick_def: Self-regulation is the ability to control your own behavior, emotions, and thoughts by yourself.

metacognition.quick_def: Metacognition is the ability to think about your own thinking and learning. It helps you plan, check, and improve how you learn.

strategies.quick_def: A strategy is a general plan or set of plans intended to achieve something, especially over a long period.

monitoring.quick_def: If you monitor something, you regularly check its development or progress, and sometimes comment on it.

evaluation.quick_def: If you evaluate something or someone, you consider them in order to make a judgment about them, for example about how good or bad they are.

choice.quick_def: If there is a choice of things, there are several of them and you can choose the one you want.

emotional.quick_def: Emotional means concerned with emotions and feelings.

feelings.quick_def: A feeling is an emotion, such as anger or happiness.

curiosity.quick_def: Curiosity is a desire to know about something.

confidence.quick_def: If you have confidence in someone, you feel that you can trust them.

achievers.quick_def: A high achiever is someone who is successful in their studies or their work, usually as a result of their efforts. A low achiever is someone who achieves less than those around them.

self-regulatory.quick_def: If something is self-regulatory, it can control or adjust itself without much outside help.

effectively.quick_def: Something that is effective works well and produces the results that were intended.

lower.quick_def: Something that is low measures only a short distance from the bottom to the top, or from the ground to the top.

transfer.quick_def: If you transfer something or someone from one place to another, or they transfer from one place to another, they go from the first place to the second.

deal.quick_def: If you say that you need or have a great deal of or a good deal of a particular thing, you are emphasizing that you need or have a lot of it.  [emphasis]

unfamiliar.quick_def: If something is unfamiliar to you, you know nothing or very little about it, because you have not seen or experienced it before.

tasks.quick_def: A task is an activity or piece of work which you have to do, usually as part of a larger project.

demonstrating.quick_def: To demonstrate a fact means to make it clear to people.

talent.quick_def: Talent is the natural ability to do something well.

overviewing.quick_def: When you are overviewing something, you are looking at the whole of it quickly to get a general idea.

shore.quick_def: The shores or the shore of a sea, lake, or wide river is the land along the edge of it. Someone who is on shore is on the land rather than on a ship.

kanevsky.quick_def: Kanevsky is a name, usually used to call a person.

instructor.quick_def: An instructor is someone who teaches a skill such as driving or skiing. In American English, instructor can also be used to refer to a schoolteacher or to a university teacher of low rank.

succinctly.quick_def: using only a few words that state something clearly

gifted.quick_def: Someone who is gifted has a natural ability to do something well.

teach.quick_def: If you teach someone something, you give them instructions so that they know about it or how to do it.

errors.quick_def: An error is something you have done which is considered to be incorrect or wrong, or which should not have been done.

shorten.quick_def: If you shorten an event or the length of time that something lasts, or if it shortens, it does not last as long as it would otherwise do or as it used to do.

adjustments.quick_def: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

teaching.quick_def: If you teach someone something, you give them instructions so that they know about it or how to do it.

teachers.quick_def: A teacher is a person who teaches, usually as a job at a school or similar institution.

conversely.quick_def: You say conversely to indicate that the situation you are about to describe is the opposite or reverse of the one you have just described.  [formal]

overdirect.quick_def: When you overdirect someone, you give them too many directions or control them too much.

diminish.quick_def: When something diminishes, or when something diminishes it, it becomes reduced in size, importance, or intensity.

autonomy.quick_def: Autonomy is the control or government of a country, organization, or group by itself rather than by others.

spoon-feeding.quick_def: Spoon-feeding is a way of teaching where teachers give students all the information directly without letting them think or find things out by themselves.

examination.quick_def: An examination is a formal test that you take to show your knowledge or ability in a particular subject, or to obtain a qualification.  [formal]

equally.quick_def: Equally means in sections, amounts, or spaces that are the same size as each other.

dependence.quick_def: Your dependence on something or someone is your need for them in order to succeed or be able to survive.

risks.quick_def: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

motivation.quick_def: If you are motivated by something, especially an emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.

helps.quick_def: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or money.

fundamental.quick_def: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

outcome.quick_def: The outcome of an activity, process, or situation is the situation that exists at the end of it.

competent.quick_def: Someone who is competent is efficient and effective.

child-initiated.quick_def: If something is child-initiated, it is started or begun by a child.

ability-peer.quick_def: People who have the same or similar ability as you.

tutoring.quick_def: A tutor is a teacher at a British university or college. In some American universities or colleges, a tutor is a teacher of the lowest rank.

bright.quick_def: A bright colour is strong and noticeable, and not dark.

deprived.quick_def: If you deprive someone of something that they want or need, you take it away from them, or you prevent them from having it.

theoretical.quick_def: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles that relate to a particular subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

performance.quick_def: A performance involves entertaining an audience by doing something such as singing, dancing, or acting.

domain.quick_def: A domain is a particular field of thought, activity, or interest, especially one over which someone has control, influence, or rights.  [formal]

elshout.quick_def: Elshout is a name, usually a person's last name.

simonton.quick_def: Simonton is a name, usually a person's name.

brought.quick_def: If you bring someone or something with you when you come to a place, they come with you or you have them with you.

him.quick_def: You use him to refer to a man, boy, or male animal.

conclusion.quick_def: When you come to a conclusion, you decide that something is true after you have thought about it carefully and have considered all the relevant facts.

independence.quick_def: If a country has or gains independence, it has its own government and is not ruled by any other country.

reaching.quick_def: When someone or something reaches a place, they arrive there.

highest.quick_def: Something that is high extends a long way from the bottom to the top when it is upright. You do not use high to describe people, animals, or plants.

expertise.quick_def: Expertise is special skill or knowledge that is acquired by training, study, or practice.

intellectual.quick_def: Intellectual means involving a person's ability to think and to understand ideas and information.

demands.quick_def: If you demand something such as information or action, you ask for it in a very forceful way.

effort.quick_def: If you make an effort to do something, you try very hard to do it.

mixed.quick_def: If two substances mix or if you mix one substance with another, you stir or shake them together, or combine them in some other way, so that they become a single substance.

weisberg.quick_def: Weisberg is a name, usually used to call a person.

sum.quick_def: A sum of money is an amount of money.

emotions.quick_def: An emotion is a feeling such as happiness, love, fear, anger, or hatred, which can be caused by the situation that you are in or the people you are with.

facilitate.quick_def: To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen.

fear.quick_def: Fear is the unpleasant feeling you have when you think that you are in danger.

limit.quick_def: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

advance.quick_def: To advance means to move forward, often in order to attack someone.

motivates.quick_def: If you are motivated by something, especially an emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.

problem-solving.quick_def: Problem-solving is the act of finding solutions to problems.

review.quick_def: A review of a situation or system is its formal examination by people in authority. This is usually done in order to see whether it can be improved or corrected.

achieving.quick_def: If you achieve a particular aim or effect, you succeed in doing it or causing it to happen, usually after a lot of effort.

forces.quick_def: If someone forces you to do something, they make you do it even though you do not want to, for example by threatening you.

harness.quick_def: If you harness something such as an emotion or natural source of energy, you bring it under your control and use it.

desire.quick_def: A desire is a strong wish to do or have something.

leonardo.quick_def: Leonardo is a name for a person.

da.quick_def: district attorney a lawyer who is responsible for bringing criminal charges against somebody in a particular area or state

vinci.quick_def: Vinci is a place name. It is also part of the name of Leonardo da Vinci, a very famous artist.

reproductions.quick_def: A reproduction is a copy of something such as a piece of furniture or a work of art.

accept.quick_def: If you accept something that you have been offered, you say yes to it or agree to take it.

rewardingly.quick_def: If you do something rewardingly, you get good results or feelings from it.

bother.quick_def: If you do not bother to do something or if you do not bother with it, you do not do it, consider it, or use it because you think it is unnecessary or because you are too lazy.

museum.quick_def: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

read.quick_def: When you read something such as a book or article, you look at and understand the words that are written there.

actual.quick_def: You use actual to emphasize that you are referring to something real or genuine.  [emphasis]

manuscript.quick_def: A manuscript is a handwritten or typed document, especially a writer's first version of a book before it is published.

printed.quick_def: If someone prints something such as a book or newspaper, they produce it in large quantities using a machine.

reproduction.quick_def: If you try to reproduce something, you try to copy it.

developments.quick_def: Development is the gradual growth or formation of something.

print.quick_def: If someone prints something such as a book or newspaper, they produce it in large quantities using a machine.

texts.quick_def: The text of a book is the main part of it, rather than the introduction, pictures, or notes.

whereas.quick_def: You use whereas to introduce a comment which contrasts with what is said in the main clause.

paintings.quick_def: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

argued.quick_def: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

interpreting.quick_def: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

reading.quick_def: When you read something such as a book or article, you look at and understand the words that are written there.

medium.quick_def: If something is of medium size, it is neither large nor small, but approximately half way between the two.

follows.quick_def: If you follow someone who is going somewhere, you move along behind them because you want to go to the same place.

conventions.quick_def: A convention is a way of behaving that is considered to be correct or polite by most people in a society.

novels.quick_def: A novel is a long written story about imaginary people and events.

reader.quick_def: The readers of a newspaper, magazine, or book are the people who read it.

attends.quick_def: If you attend a meeting or other event, you are present at it.

page.quick_def: A page is one side of one of the pieces of paper in a book, magazine, or newspaper. Each page usually has a number printed at the top or bottom.

painting.quick_def: A painting is a picture which someone has painted.

attend.quick_def: If you attend a meeting or other event, you are present at it.

closely.quick_def: When you close something such as a door or lid or when it closes, it moves so that a hole, gap, or opening is covered.

marks.quick_def: A mark is a small area of something such as dirt that has accidentally got onto a surface or piece of clothing.

shapes.quick_def: The shape of an object, a person, or an area is the appearance of their outside edges or surfaces, for example whether they are round, square, curved, or fat.

signify.quick_def: If an event, a sign, or a symbol signifies something, it is a sign of that thing or represents that thing.

facsimiles.quick_def: A facsimile of something is a copy or imitation of it.  [formal]

surviving.quick_def: If a person or living thing survives in a dangerous situation such as an accident or an illness, they do not die.

versions.quick_def: A version of something is a particular form of it in which some details are different from earlier or later forms.

witness.quick_def: A witness to an event such as an accident or crime is a person who saw it.

perfectly.quick_def: You can use perfectly to emphasize an adjective or adverb, especially when you think the person you are talking to might doubt what you are saying.  [emphasis]

assign.quick_def: If you assign a piece of work to someone, you give them the work to do.

creations.quick_def: You can refer to something that someone has made as a creation, especially if it shows skill, imagination, or artistic ability.

workshop.quick_def: A workshop is a period of discussion or practical work on a particular subject in which a group of people share their knowledge or experience.

apprentices.quick_def: An apprentice is a young person who works for someone in order to learn their skill.

regular.quick_def: Regular events have equal amounts of time between them, so that they happen, for example, at the same time each day or each week.

bread.quick_def: Bread is a very common food made from flour, water, and yeast.

task.quick_def: A task is an activity or piece of work which you have to do, usually as part of a larger project.

reproducing.quick_def: If you try to reproduce something, you try to copy it.

pictures.quick_def: A picture consists of lines and shapes which are drawn, painted, or printed on a surface and show a person, thing, or scene.

incomparably.quick_def: If you describe someone or something as incomparable, you mean that they are extremely good or impressive.

reliable.quick_def: People or things that are reliable can be trusted to work well or to behave in the way that you want them to.

reprographic.quick_def: Reprographic means related to the process of making copies of documents or pictures.

high-quality.quick_def: If something is high-quality, it is very good and made well.

prints.quick_def: If someone prints something such as a book or newspaper, they produce it in large quantities using a machine.

faithful.quick_def: Someone who is faithful to a person, organization, idea, or activity remains firm in their belief in them or support for them.

duplication.quick_def: If you say that there has been duplication of something, you mean that someone has done a task unnecessarily because it has already been done before.

implicit.quick_def: Something that is implicit is expressed in an indirect way.

recognition.quick_def: Recognition is the act of recognizing someone or identifying something when you see it.

spread.quick_def: If you spread something somewhere, you open it out or arrange it over a place or surface, so that all of it can be seen or used easily.

culturally.quick_def: Cultural means relating to a particular society and its ideas, customs, and art.

valuable.quick_def: If you describe something or someone as valuable, you mean that they are very useful and helpful.

museums.quick_def: A museum is a building where a large number of interesting and valuable objects, such as works of art or historical items, are kept, studied, and displayed to the public.

promote.quick_def: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread.

severe.quick_def: You use severe to indicate that something bad or undesirable is great or intense.

limitations.quick_def: The limitation of something is the act or process of controlling or reducing it.

limitation.quick_def: The limitation of something is the act or process of controlling or reducing it.

presents.quick_def: You use present to describe things and people that exist now, rather than those that existed in the past or those that may exist in the future.

exhibits.quick_def: If someone or something shows a particular quality, feeling, or type of behaviour, you can say that they exhibit it.  [formal]

repositories.quick_def: A repository is a place where something is kept safely.  [formal]

treasure.quick_def: Treasure is a collection of valuable old objects such as gold coins and jewels that has been hidden or lost.  [literary]

reminded.quick_def: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

view.quick_def: Your views on something are the beliefs or opinions that you have about it, for example whether you think it is good, bad, right, or wrong.

presence.quick_def: Someone's presence in a place is the fact that they are there.

security.quick_def: Security refers to all the measures that are taken to protect a place, or to ensure that only people with permission enter it or leave it.

guards.quick_def: If you guard a place, person, or object, you stand near them in order to watch and protect them.

attendants.quick_def: An attendant is someone whose job is to serve or help people in a place such as a car park or a cloakroom.

ropes.quick_def: A rope is a thick cord or wire that is made by twisting together several thinner cords or wires. Ropes are used for jobs such as pulling cars, tying up boats, or tying things together.

cases.quick_def: A particular case is a particular situation or incident, especially one that you are using as an individual example or instance of something.

notion.quick_def: A notion is an idea or belief about something.

housed.quick_def: A house is a building in which people live, usually the people belonging to one family.

numerous.quick_def: If people or things are numerous, they exist or are present in large numbers.

dozens.quick_def: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

worth.quick_def: If something is worth a particular amount of money, it can be sold for that amount or is considered to have that value.

possesses.quick_def: If you possess something, you have it or own it.

judges.quick_def: A judge is the person in a court of law who decides how the law should be applied, for example how criminals should be punished.

personal.quick_def: A personal opinion, quality, or thing belongs or relates to one particular person rather than to other people.

relative.quick_def: Your relatives are the members of your family.

worthlessness.quick_def: Something that is worthless is of no real value or use.

furthermore.quick_def: Furthermore is used to introduce a piece of information or opinion that adds to or supports the previous one.  [formal]

consideration.quick_def: Consideration is careful thought about something.

setting.quick_def: A set of things is a number of things that belong together or that are thought of as a group.

impresses.quick_def: If something impresses you, you feel great admiration for it.

viewer.quick_def: Viewers are people who watch television, or who are watching a particular programme on television.

assigned.quick_def: If you assign a piece of work to someone, you give them the work to do.

monetary.quick_def: Monetary means relating to money, especially the total amount of money in a country.  [business]

institution.quick_def: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

evidently.quick_def: You use evidently to say that something is obviously true, for example because you have seen evidence of it yourself.

thinks.quick_def: If you think that something is the case, you have the opinion that it is the case.

alter.quick_def: If something alters or if you alter it, it changes.

deterred.quick_def: To deter someone from doing something means to make them not want to do it or continue doing it.

extend.quick_def: If you say that something, usually something large, extends for a particular distance or extends from one place to another, you are indicating its size or position.

spontaneous.quick_def: Spontaneous acts are not planned or arranged, but are done because someone suddenly wants to do them.

immediate.quick_def: An immediate result, action, or reaction happens or is done without any delay.

self-reliant.quick_def: If a person is self-reliant, they can do things by themselves and don't need others' help.

struck.quick_def: When there is a strike, workers stop doing their work for a period of time, usually in order to try to get better pay or conditions for themselves.  [business]

seeing.quick_def: When you see something, you notice it using your eyes.

diverse.quick_def: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

drawings.quick_def: A drawing is a picture made with a pencil or pen.

displacement.quick_def: Displacement is the removal of something from its usual place or position by something which then occupies that place or position.  [formal]

heightened.quick_def: If something heightens a feeling or if the feeling heightens, the feeling increases in degree or intensity.

sheer.quick_def: You can use sheer to emphasize that a state or situation is complete and does not involve or is not mixed with anything else.  [emphasis]

volume.quick_def: The volume of something is the amount of it that there is.

realistically.quick_def: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

distressing.quick_def: Distress is a state of extreme sorrow, suffering, or pain.

appreciation.quick_def: Appreciation of something is the recognition and enjoyment of its good qualities.

prescribed.quick_def: If a doctor prescribes medicine or treatment for you, he or she tells you what medicine or treatment to have.

contrast.quick_def: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

audience.quick_def: The audience at a play, concert, film, or public meeting is the group of people watching or listening to it.

encounters.quick_def: If you encounter problems or difficulties, you experience them.

opera.quick_def: An opera is a play with music in which all the words are sung.

duration.quick_def: The duration of an event or state is the time during which it happens or exists.

similarly.quick_def: You use similarly to say that something is similar to something else.

poems.quick_def: A poem is a piece of writing in which the words are chosen for their beauty and sound and are carefully arranged, often in short lines which rhyme.

temporal.quick_def: Temporal powers or matters relate to ordinary institutions and activities rather than to religious or spiritual ones.  [formal]

sequence.quick_def: A sequence of events or things is a number of events or things that come one after another in a particular order.

superficially.quick_def: If you describe someone as superficial, you disapprove of them because they do not think deeply, and have little understanding of anything serious or important.  [disapproval]

appreciating.quick_def: If you appreciate something, for example a piece of music or good food, you like it because you recognize its good qualities.

richness.quick_def: A rich person has a lot of money or valuable possessions.

detail.quick_def: The details of something are its individual features or elements.

dominant.quick_def: Someone or something that is dominant is more powerful, successful, influential, or noticeable than other people or things.

critical.quick_def: A critical time, factor, or situation is extremely important.

academic.quick_def: Academic is used to describe things that relate to the work done in schools, colleges, and universities, especially work which involves studying and reasoning rather than practical or technical skills.

devoted.quick_def: If you devote yourself, your time, or your energy to something, you spend all or most of your time or energy on it.

discovering.quick_def: If you discover something that you did not know about before, you become aware of it or learn of it.

context.quick_def: The context of an idea or event is the general situation that relates to it, and which helps it to be understood.

perfect.quick_def: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

harmony.quick_def: If people are living in harmony with each other, they are living together peacefully rather than fighting or arguing.

seeking.quick_def: If you seek something such as a job or a place to live, you try to find one.  [formal]

conserving.quick_def: If you conserve a supply of something, you use it carefully so that it lasts for a long time.

authentic.quick_def: An authentic person, object, or emotion is genuine.

readings.quick_def: Reading is the activity of reading books.

participatory.quick_def: A participatory system, activity, or role involves a particular person or group of people taking part in it.

criticism.quick_def: Criticism is the action of expressing disapproval of something or someone. A criticism is a statement that expresses disapproval.

abundance.quick_def: An abundance of something is a large quantity of it.

classic.quick_def: A classic example of a thing or situation has all the features which you expect such a thing or situation to have.

absent.quick_def: If someone or something is absent from a place or situation where they should be or where they usually are, they are not there.

warning.quick_def: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

suppressed.quick_def: If someone in authority suppresses an activity, they prevent it from continuing, by using force or making it illegal.

express.quick_def: When you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

rendered.quick_def: You can use render with an adjective that describes a particular state to say that someone or something is changed into that state. For example, if someone or something makes a thing harmless, you can say that they render it harmless.

permanently.quick_def: Something that is permanent lasts for ever.

accessible.quick_def: If a place or building is accessible to people, it is easy for them to reach it or get into it. If an object is accessible, it is easy to reach.

high-fidelity.quick_def: High-fidelity means the reproduction of sound or images is very accurate and close to the original.

awe.quick_def: Awe is the feeling of respect and amazement that you have when you are faced with something wonderful and often rather frightening.

seek.quick_def: If you seek something such as a job or a place to live, you try to find one.  [formal]

maintain.quick_def: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

existed.quick_def: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

beginning.quick_def: To begin to do something means to start doing it.

traversing.quick_def: If someone or something traverses an area of land or water, they go across it.  [literary]

distances.quick_def: The distance between two points or places is the amount of space between them.

clothing.quick_def: To clothe someone means to provide them with clothes to wear.

travelled.quick_def: If you travel, you go from one place to another, often to a place that is far away.

purposes.quick_def: The purpose of something is the reason for which it is made or done.

religious.quick_def: You use religious to describe things that are connected with religion or with one particular religion.

conviction.quick_def: A conviction is a strong belief or opinion.

migration.quick_def: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

compelling.quick_def: If a situation, a rule, or a person compels you to do something, they force you to do it.

motivations.quick_def: Your motivation for doing something is what causes you to want to do it.

era.quick_def: You can refer to a period of history or a long period of time as an era when you want to draw attention to a particular feature or quality that it has.

wealthy.quick_def: Someone who is wealthy has a large amount of money, property, or valuable possessions.

aristocrats.quick_def: An aristocrat is someone whose family has a high social rank, especially someone who has a title.

officials.quick_def: Official means approved by the government or by someone in authority.

seaside.quick_def: You can refer to an area that is close to the sea, especially one where people go for their holidays, as the seaside.

resorts.quick_def: If you resort to a course of action that you do not really approve of, you adopt it because you cannot see any other way of achieving what you want.

pompeii.quick_def: Pompeii is an ancient city in Italy. It was destroyed by a volcano eruption long ago.

herculaneum.quick_def: Herculaneum is the name of an ancient city. It was destroyed by a volcano long ago.

afforded.quick_def: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

vacation.quick_def: A vacation is a period of the year when universities and colleges, and in the United States also schools, are officially closed.

villas.quick_def: A villa is a fairly large house, especially one that is used for holidays in Mediterranean countries.

rome.quick_def: used to say that a complicated task will take a long time and should not be rushed

ages.quick_def: Your age is the number of years that you have lived.

continued.quick_def: If someone or something continues to do something, they keep doing it and do not stop.

grow.quick_def: When people, animals, and plants grow, they increase in size and change physically over a period of time.

played.quick_def: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games.

economies.quick_def: An economy is the system according to which the money, industry, and trade of a country or region are organized.

distinctly.quick_def: If something is distinct from something else of the same type, it is different or separate from it.

twentieth-century.quick_def: Something that belongs to or happened during the period from 1901 to 2000.

advent.quick_def: The advent of an important event, invention, or situation is the fact of it starting or coming into existence.  [formal]

availability.quick_def: the fact that something is possible to get, buy or find

inexpensive.quick_def: Something that is inexpensive does not cost very much.

transportation.quick_def: Transportation refers to any type of vehicle that you can travel in or carry goods in.  [mainly US]

airline.quick_def: An airline is a company which provides regular services carrying people or goods in aeroplanes.

subsequent.quick_def: You use subsequent to describe something that happened or existed after the time or event that has just been referred to.  [formal]

jet.quick_def: A jet is an aircraft that is powered by jet engines.

signalled.quick_def: A signal is a gesture, sound, or action which is intended to give a particular message to the person who sees or hears it.

concern.quick_def: Concern is worry about a situation.

governments.quick_def: The government of a country is the group of people who are responsible for governing it.

earning.quick_def: If you earn money, you receive money in return for work that you do.

exchange.quick_def: If two or more people exchange things of a particular kind, they give them to each other at the same time.

grown.quick_def: When people, animals, and plants grow, they increase in size and change physically over a period of time.

industrialised.quick_def: When a country industrializes or is industrialized, it develops a lot of industries.

fastest.quick_def: Fast means happening, moving, or doing something at great speed. You also use fast in questions or statements about speed.

largest.quick_def: A large thing or person is greater in size than usual or average.

segments.quick_def: A segment of something is one part of it, considered separately from the rest.

unrecognised.quick_def: If someone does something unrecognized, nobody knows or recognizes them while they do it.

entity.quick_def: An entity is something that exists separately from other things and has a clear identity of its own.  [formal]

value-added.quick_def: Value-added means something has extra value or worth that is added to it.

gross.quick_def: You use gross to describe something unacceptable or unpleasant to a very great amount, degree, or intensity.

estimated.quick_def: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

trillion.quick_def: A trillion is a million million.

consumer.quick_def: A consumer is a person who buys things or uses services.

spending.quick_def: When you spend money, you pay money for things that you want.

contributor.quick_def: If you contribute to something, you say or do things to help to make it successful.

excess.quick_def: An excess of something is a larger amount than is needed, allowed, or usual.

indirect.quick_def: An indirect result or effect is not caused immediately and obviously by a thing or person, but happens because of something else that they have done.

taxes.quick_def: Tax is an amount of money that you have to pay to the government so that it can pay for public services.

profound.quick_def: You use profound to emphasize that something is very great or intense.  [emphasis]

educative.quick_def: Something that has an educative role teaches you something.  [formal]

effects.quick_def: The effect of one thing on another is the change that the first thing causes in the second thing.

obscured.quick_def: If something or someone is obscure, they are unknown, or are known by only a few people.

fragmentation.quick_def: A fragment of something is a small piece or part of it.

motels.quick_def: A motel is a hotel intended for people who are travelling by car.

amusements.quick_def: Amusement is the feeling that you have when you think that something is funny or amusing.

enterprises.quick_def: An enterprise is a company or business, often a small one.  [business]

businesses.quick_def: Business is work relating to the production, buying, and selling of goods or services.

residents.quick_def: The residents of a house or area are the people who live there.

easily.quick_def: You use easily to emphasize that something is very likely to happen, or is very likely to be true.  [emphasis]

overlooked.quick_def: If a building or window overlooks a place, you can see the place clearly from the building or window.

underestimated.quick_def: If you underestimate something, you do not realize how large or great it is or will be.

meis.quick_def: Meis is a name, usually used to call a person.

points.quick_def: You use point to refer to something that someone has said or written.

concepts.quick_def: A concept is an idea or abstract principle.

analysts.quick_def: An analyst is a person whose job is to analyse a subject and give opinions about it.

credible.quick_def: Credible means able to be trusted or believed.

base.quick_def: The base of something is its lowest edge or part.

estimate.quick_def: If you estimate a quantity or value, you make an approximate judgment or calculation of it.

global.quick_def: You can use global to describe something that happens in all parts of the world or affects all parts of the world.

regions.quick_def: A region is a large area of land that is different from other areas of land, for example because it is one of the different parts of a country with its own customs and characteristics, or because it has a particular geographical feature.

exclusive.quick_def: If you describe something as exclusive, you mean that it is limited to people who have a lot of money or who belong to a high social class, and is therefore not available to everyone.

province.quick_def: A province is a large section of a country which has its own administration.

institutionalised.quick_def: If someone such as a sick, mentally ill, or old person is institutionalized, they are sent to stay in a special hospital or home, usually for a long period.

mcintosh.quick_def: McIntosh is a common surname. It can be the name of a person.

commodity.quick_def: A commodity is something that is sold for money.  [business]

ranks.quick_def: Someone's rank is the position or grade that they have in an organization.

income.quick_def: A person's or organization's income is the money that they earn or receive, as opposed to the money that they have to spend or pay out.

bermuda.quick_def: a British dependency in the west Atlantic Ocean, consisting of a large number of small islands. It has an important tourist industry. The capital city is Hamilton.

caribbean.quick_def: The Caribbean is the sea which is between the Caribbean islands, Central America, and the north coast of South America.

hawkins.quick_def: Hawkins is a name, usually used for a person.

ritchie.quick_def: a first name for boys, short for Richard

quoting.quick_def: If you quote someone as saying something, you repeat what they have written or said.

published.quick_def: When a company publishes a book or magazine, it prints copies of it, which are sent to shops to be sold.

ranked.quick_def: Someone's rank is the position or grade that they have in an organization.

bahamas.quick_def: The Bahamas is a country made up of many islands in the Atlantic Ocean. It's a place where people can go on vacation.

brazil.quick_def: the curved nut of a large South American tree. It has a hard shell with three sides.

former.quick_def: Former is used to describe someone who used to have a particular job, position, or role, but no longer has it.

west.quick_def: The west is the direction which you look towards in the evening in order to see the sun set.

hong.quick_def: Hong is often used as part of a proper name, like in the name of a place or a person. It doesn't have a single simple meaning on its own.

kong.quick_def: Kong is often a part of a name, like a place name or a person's name.

jamaica.quick_def: an island in the Caribbean Sea that is part of the West Indies. It has been an independent country and a member of the Commonwealth since 1962. Its capital city is Kingston and its official language is English. It is popular with tourists. Rastafarianism and reggae music have their origins in Jamaica. After the Second World War Jamaican people were encouraged by the British government to come to Britain to work, and Britain has a large community of Jamaican origin.

singapore.quick_def: a small country in south-east Asia, consisting of the island of Singapore and 62 smaller islands near the end of the Malay Peninsula. It has been a republic and a member of the Commonwealth since 1965. The first town there was established by Stamford Raffles (1781-1826) in 1819, and it soon became an important port for ships travelling between Europe, India and China. It was part of the British Empire until it became independent from the UK in 1963. Singapore is well known for its political and economic stability. It is still one of the world's most important ports, and has successful banks and technology industries.

kingdom.quick_def: A kingdom is a country or region that is ruled by a king or queen.

statistical.quick_def: Statistical means relating to the use of statistics.

measurement.quick_def: A measurement is a result, usually expressed in numbers, that you obtain by measuring something.

certainty.quick_def: Certainty is the state of being definite or of having no doubts at all about something.

precise.quick_def: You use precise to emphasize that you are referring to an exact thing, rather than something vague.  [emphasis]

valid.quick_def: A valid argument, comment, or idea is based on sensible reasoning.

world-wide.quick_def: If something is world-wide, it happens in all parts of the world.

participation.quick_def: If you participate in an activity, you take part in it.

domestic.quick_def: Domestic political activities, events, and situations happen or exist within one particular country.

captivating.quick_def: If you are captivated by someone or something, you find them fascinating and attractive.

leaves.quick_def: The leaves of a tree or plant are the parts that are flat, thin, and usually green. Many trees and plants lose their leaves in the winter and grow new leaves in the spring.

magnificent.quick_def: If you say that something or someone is magnificent, you mean that you think they are extremely good, beautiful, or impressive.

yellow.quick_def: Something that is yellow is the colour of lemons, butter, or the middle part of an egg.

purple.quick_def: Something that is purple is of a reddish-blue colour.

puzzled.quick_def: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

green.quick_def: Green is the colour of grass or leaves.

chlorophyll.quick_def: Chlorophyll is a green substance in plants which enables them to use the energy from sunlight in order to grow.

molecule.quick_def: A molecule is the smallest amount of a chemical substance which can exist by itself.

captures.quick_def: If you capture someone or something, you catch them, especially in a war.

sunlight.quick_def: Sunlight is the light that comes from the sun during the day.

converts.quick_def: If one thing is converted or converts into another, it is changed into a different form.

tree.quick_def: A tree is a tall plant that has a hard trunk, branches, and leaves.

declines.quick_def: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

considerably.quick_def: Considerable means great in amount or degree.  [formal]

evergreen.quick_def: An evergreen is a tree or bush which has green leaves all the year round.

conifers.quick_def: Conifers are a group of trees and shrubs, for example pine trees and fir trees, that grow in cooler areas of the world. They have fruit called cones, and very thin leaves called needles which they do not normally lose in winter.

exception.quick_def: An exception is a particular thing, person, or situation that is not included in a general statement, judgment, or rule.

best.quick_def: Best is the superlative of well2.

abandon.quick_def: If you abandon a place, thing, or person, you leave the place, thing, or person permanently or for a long time, especially when you should not do so.

photosynthesis.quick_def: Photosynthesis is the way that green plants make their food using sunlight.  [technical]

maintaining.quick_def: If you maintain something, you continue to have it, and do not let it stop or grow weaker.

redundant.quick_def: If you are made redundant, your employer tells you to leave because your job is no longer necessary or because your employer cannot afford to keep paying you.  [British, business]

saves.quick_def: If you save someone or something, you help them to avoid harm or to escape from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

precious.quick_def: If you say that something such as a resource is precious, you mean that it is valuable and should not be wasted or used badly.

discards.quick_def: If you discard something, you get rid of it because you no longer want it or need it.

letting.quick_def: If you let something happen, you allow it to happen without doing anything to stop or prevent it.

dismantles.quick_def: If you dismantle a machine or structure, you carefully separate it into its different parts.

molecules.quick_def: A molecule is the smallest amount of a chemical substance which can exist by itself.

ships.quick_def: A ship is a large boat which carries passengers or cargo.

nitrogen.quick_def: Nitrogen is a colourless element that has no smell and is usually found as a gas. It forms about 78% of the earth's atmosphere, and is found in all living things.

twigs.quick_def: A twig is a very small thin branch that grows out from a main branch of a tree or bush.

depleted.quick_def: To deplete a stock or amount of something means to reduce it.  [formal]

dominated.quick_def: To dominate a situation means to be the most powerful or important person or thing in it.

unmasking.quick_def: If you unmask someone or something bad, you show or make known their true nature or character, when they had previously been thought to be good.

explains.quick_def: If you explain something, you give details about it or describe it so that it can be understood.

brilliant.quick_def: A brilliant person, idea, or performance is extremely clever or skilful.

reds.quick_def: Something that is red is the colour of blood or fire.

purples.quick_def: Something that is purple is of a reddish-blue colour.

maple.quick_def: A maple or a maple tree is a tree with five-pointed leaves which turn bright red or gold in autumn.

sumac.quick_def: Sumac is a kind of tree that has bright red or purple leaves in autumn.

anthocyanins.quick_def: Anthocyanins are water-soluble plant pigments that can show colors from red to blue.

water-soluble.quick_def: If something is water-soluble, it can dissolve in water.

machinery.quick_def: You can use machinery to refer to machines in general, or machines that are used in a factory or on a farm.

absorbed.quick_def: If something absorbs a liquid, gas, or other substance, it soaks it up or takes it in.

accomplish.quick_def: If you accomplish something, you succeed in doing it.
