competed.quick_def: When one firm or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its own goods in preference to those of the other firm or country. You can also say that two firms or countries compete.

bigger.quick_def: A big person or thing is large in physical size.

sledges.quick_def: A sledge is an object used for travelling over snow. It consists of a framework which slides on two strips of wood or metal.  [British]

hauled.quick_def: If you haul something which is heavy or difficult to move, you move it using a lot of effort.

log.quick_def: A log is a piece of a thick branch or of the trunk of a tree that has been cut so that it can be used for fuel or for making things.

gone.quick_def: When you go somewhere, you move or travel there.

toppling.quick_def: If someone or something topples somewhere or if you topple them, they become unsteady or unstable and fall over.

nineteenth.quick_def: The nineteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number nineteen.

standing.quick_def: When you are standing, your body is upright, your legs are straight, and your weight is supported by your feet.

hunt.quick_def: If you hunt for something or someone, you try to find them by searching carefully or thoroughly.

hawaii.quick_def: the 50th and last state to join the US, in 1959, also known as the Aloha State. It consists of eight main islands and other smaller ones in the north Pacific Ocean. Its capital Honolulu, which is also the largest city, and the port of Pearl Harbor are on Oahu. The state attracts many tourists and produces sugar, pineapples, flowers, nuts and coffee. Captain James Cook visited the islands in 1778, and they have been under US control since 1900.

lipo.quick_def: Lipo is a name, usually used to call a person.

catastrophe.quick_def: A catastrophe is an unexpected event that causes great suffering or damage.

heroic.quick_def: If you describe a person or their actions as heroic, you admire them because they show extreme bravery.

wind-lashed.quick_def: If a place is wind-lashed, it is strongly hit by the wind.

infertile.quick_def: A person or animal that is infertile is unable to produce babies.

circular.quick_def: Something that is circular is shaped like a circle.

windbreaks.quick_def: A windbreak is something such as a line of trees or a fence which gives protection against the wind.

gardened.quick_def: In British English, a garden is a piece of land next to a house, with flowers, vegetables, other plants, and often grass. In American English, the usual word is yard, and a garden refers only to land which is used for growing flowers and vegetables.

rocks.quick_def: Rock is the hard substance which the Earth is made of.

moist.quick_def: Something that is moist is slightly wet.

argue.quick_def: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

prehistoric.quick_def: Prehistoric people and things existed at a time before information was written down.

contend.quick_def: If you have to contend with a problem or difficulty, you have to deal with it or overcome it.

moai-building.quick_def: Moai-building is the activity of building moai, which are big stone statues.

upright.quick_def: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

backs.quick_def: If you move back, you move in the opposite direction to the one in which you are facing or in which you were moving before.

experiments.quick_def: An experiment is a scientific test which is done in order to discover what happens to something in particular conditions.

bit.quick_def: A bit of something is a small amount of it.

manoeuvre.quick_def: If you manoeuvre something into or out of an awkward position, you skilfully move it there.

kg.quick_def: kg is an abbreviation for kilogram or , kilograms.

replica.quick_def: A replica of something such as a statue, building, or weapon is an accurate copy of it.

fat.quick_def: If you say that a person or animal is fat, you mean that they have a lot of flesh on their body and that they weigh too much. You usually use the word fat when you think that this is a bad thing.  [disapproval]

bellies.quick_def: The belly of a person or animal is their stomach or abdomen. In British English, this is an informal or literary use.

tilted.quick_def: If you tilt an object or if it tilts, it moves into a sloping position with one end or side higher than the other.

d-shaped.quick_def: If something is D-shaped, it has the shape like the letter D.

handlers.quick_def: A handler is someone whose job is to be in charge of and control an animal.

wholly.quick_def: You use wholly to emphasize the extent or degree to which something is the case.  [emphasis]

responsible.quick_def: If someone or something is responsible for a particular event or situation, they are the cause of it or they can be blamed for it.

nuts.quick_def: The firm shelled fruit of some trees and bushes are called nuts. Some nuts can be eaten.

grooves.quick_def: A groove is a deep line cut into a surface.

rats.quick_def: A rat is an animal which has a long tail and looks like a large mouse.

overrun.quick_def: If an army or an armed force overruns a place, area, or country, it succeeds in occupying it very quickly.

reseeding.quick_def: Reseeding means planting seeds again in a place where there were seeds before.

doomed.quick_def: Doom is a terrible future state or event which you cannot prevent.

campaign.quick_def: A campaign is a planned set of activities that people carry out over a period of time in order to achieve something such as social or political change.

deforestation.quick_def: If an area is deforested, all the trees there are cut down or destroyed.

collapsed.quick_def: If a building or other structure collapses, it falls down very suddenly.

stable.quick_def: If something is stable, it is not likely to change or come to an end suddenly.

arrival.quick_def: When a person or vehicle arrives at a place, you can refer to their arrival.

immunity.quick_def: If you are immune to a particular disease, you cannot be affected by it.

slave.quick_def: A slave is someone who is the property of another person and has to work for that person.

traders.quick_def: A trader is a person whose job is to trade in goods or stocks.

decimated.quick_def: To decimate something such as a group of people or animals means to destroy a very large number of them.

shrivelled.quick_def: When something shrivels or when something shrivels it, it becomes dryer and smaller, often with lines in its surface, as a result of losing the water it contains.

populated.quick_def: If an area is populated by certain people or animals, those people or animals live there, often in large numbers.

peaceful.quick_def: Peaceful activities and situations do not involve war.

ingenious.quick_def: Something that is ingenious is very clever and involves new ideas, methods, or equipment.

careful.quick_def: If you are careful, you give serious attention to what you are doing, in order to avoid harm, damage, or mistakes. If you are careful to do something, you make sure that you do it.

stewards.quick_def: A steward is someone who works on a ship, plane, or train, looking after passengers and serving meals to them.

reckless.quick_def: If you say that someone is reckless, you mean that they act in a way which shows that they do not care about danger or the effect their behaviour will have on other people.

destroyers.quick_def: A destroyer is a small, heavily armed warship.

ruining.quick_def: To ruin something means to severely harm, damage, or spoil it.

abject.quick_def: You use abject to emphasize that a situation or quality is extremely bad.  [emphasis]

whichever.quick_def: You use whichever in order to indicate that it does not matter which of the possible alternatives happens or is chosen.

lessons.quick_def: A lesson is a fixed period of time when people are taught about a particular subject or taught how to do something.

neuroaesthetics.quick_def: Neuroaesthetics is a new field of study that uses science to understand art.

objectivity.quick_def: Your objective is what you are trying to achieve.

understanding.quick_def: If you understand someone or understand what they are saying, you know what they mean.

masterpieces.quick_def: A masterpiece is an extremely good painting, novel, film, or other work of art.

blurred.quick_def: A blur is a shape or area which you cannot see clearly because it has no distinct outline or because it is moving very fast.

imagery.quick_def: You can refer to the descriptions in something such as a poem or song, and the pictures they create in your mind, as its imagery.  [formal]

impressionist.quick_def: An impressionist is an entertainer who does amusing imitations of well-known people.

amygdala.quick_def: either of two areas in the brain that are linked to memory, the emotions and the sense of smell

plays.quick_def: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games.

crucial.quick_def: If you describe something as crucial, you mean it is extremely important.

abstract.quick_def: An abstract idea or way of thinking is based on general ideas rather than on real things and events.

mondrian.quick_def: Mondrian is a well-known artist. Artists are people who create art.

blocks.quick_def: A block of flats or offices is a large building containing them.

pollock.quick_def: Pollock is a kind of fish that people can catch and eat.

seemingly.quick_def: If something is seemingly the case, you mean that it appears to be the case, even though it may not really be so.

haphazard.quick_def: If you describe something as haphazard, you are critical of it because it is not at all organized or is not arranged according to a plan.  [disapproval]

splashed.quick_def: If you splash about or splash around in water, you hit or disturb the water in a noisy way, causing some of it to fly up into the air.

paint.quick_def: Paint is a coloured liquid that you put onto a surface with a brush in order to protect the surface or to make it look nice, or that you use to produce a picture.

canvas.quick_def: Canvas is a strong, heavy cloth that is used for making things such as tents, sails, and bags.

sceptics.quick_def: A sceptic is a person who has doubts about things that other people believe.

inclination.quick_def: An inclination is a feeling that makes you want to act in a particular way.

crowd.quick_def: A crowd is a large group of people who have gathered together, for example to watch or listen to something interesting, or to protest about something.

perceptual.quick_def: Perceptual means relating to the way people interpret and understand what they see or notice.  [formal]

matching.quick_def: A match is an organized game of football, tennis, cricket, or some other sport.  [mainly British]

imagine.quick_def: If you imagine something, you think about it and your mind forms a picture or idea of it.

mentality.quick_def: Your mentality is your attitudes and your way of thinking.

fuzzy.quick_def: Fuzzy hair sticks up in a soft, curly mass.

angelina.quick_def: Angelina is a common female name.

hawley-dolan.quick_def: Hawley-Dolan is a family name. People with this name can be someone you know in real life or in a story.

boston.quick_def: the capital and largest city in the US state of Massachusetts. It is a major port and cultural centre, having nearly 50 colleges and universities. It also has the oldest underground railway in the US. Boston was settled in 1630 and played an important part in the American Revolution. It became a centre for Irish immigrants in the second half of the 19th century. International runners compete each year in the Boston marathon race, first run in 1897.

debate.quick_def: A debate is a discussion about a subject on which people have different views.

doodles.quick_def: A doodle is a pattern or picture that you draw when you are bored or thinking about something else.

infants.quick_def: An infant is a baby or very young child.  [formal]

chimps.quick_def: A chimp is the same as a chimpanzee.  [informal]

elephants.quick_def: An elephant is a very large animal with a long, flexible nose called a trunk, which it uses to pick up things. Elephants live in Africa, India, and other parts of Asia.

judge.quick_def: A judge is the person in a court of law who decides how the law should be applied, for example how criminals should be punished.

preferred.quick_def: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

captions.quick_def: A caption is the words printed underneath a picture or cartoon which explain what it is about.

labelled.quick_def: A label is a piece of paper or plastic that is attached to an object in order to give information about it.

incorrectly.quick_def: in a way that is not accurate or true

chimp.quick_def: A chimp is the same as a chimpanzee.  [informal]

messy.quick_def: A messy person or activity makes things dirty or untidy.

brushstrokes.quick_def: Brushstrokes are the marks made on a surface by a painter's brush.

acclaimed.quick_def: If someone or something is acclaimed, they are praised enthusiastically.  [formal]

masterpiece.quick_def: A masterpiece is an extremely good painting, novel, film, or other work of art.

trials.quick_def: A trial is a formal meeting in a law court, at which a judge and jury listen to evidence and decide whether a person is guilty of a crime.

artist.quick_def: An artist is someone who draws or paints pictures or creates sculptures as a job or a hobby.

pepperell.quick_def: Pepperell is a name, usually used for a person.

cardiff.quick_def: the capital city of Wales, in the south-east of the country. It is an important industrial city and port, and a major cultural centre. It is governed by a unitary authority.

creates.quick_def: To create something means to cause it to happen or exist.

representational.quick_def: In a representational painting, the artist attempts to show things as they really are.  [formal]

collaborators.quick_def: A collaborator is someone that you work with to produce a piece of work, especially a book or some research.

decide.quick_def: If you decide to do something, you choose to do it, usually after you have thought carefully about the other possibilities.

artwork.quick_def: Artwork is drawings and photographs that are prepared in order to be included in something such as a book or advertisement.

rated.quick_def: The rate at which something happens is the speed with which it happens.

scrutiny.quick_def: If a person or thing is under scrutiny, they are being studied or observed very carefully.

neural.quick_def: Neural means relating to a nerve or to the nervous system.  [medicine]

puzzles.quick_def: If something puzzles you, you do not understand it and feel confused.

decipher.quick_def: If you decipher a piece of writing or a message, you work out what it says, even though it is very difficult to read or understand.

exclusively.quick_def: Exclusively is used to refer to situations or activities that involve only the thing or things mentioned, and nothing else.

encasing.quick_def: If a person or an object is encased in something, they are completely covered or surrounded by it.

deceptively.quick_def: If something is deceptive, it encourages you to believe something which is not true.

eye-tracking.quick_def: Eye-tracking is a way to study where a person looks by following the movement of their eyes.

confirm.quick_def: If something confirms what you believe, suspect, or fear, it shows that it is definitely true.

meticulously.quick_def: in a way that pays careful attention to every detail

composed.quick_def: The things that something is composed of are its parts or members. The separate things that compose something are the parts or members that form it.

radically.quick_def: Radical changes and differences are very important and great in degree.

originals.quick_def: You use original when referring to something that existed at the beginning of a process or activity, or the characteristics that something had when it began or was made.

eyes.quick_def: Your eyes are the parts of your body with which you see.

flit.quick_def: If you flit around or flit between one place and another, you go to lots of places without staying for very long in any of them.

pleasurable.quick_def: Pleasurable experiences or sensations are pleasant and enjoyable.

oshin.quick_def: Oshin is a name used to call a person.

vartanian.quick_def: Vartanian is a family name. People with this name can be someone you know or meet.

toronto.quick_def: the capital of Ontario and the largest city in Canada, situated on the north shore of Lake Ontario

compare.quick_def: When you compare things, you consider them and discover the differences or similarities between them.

gogh.quick_def: Gogh is a last name. Vincent van Gogh is a very famous painter.

miro.quick_def: Miro is the name of a well-known artist. People often talk about his paintings.

composition.quick_def: When you talk about the composition of something, you are referring to the way in which its various parts are put together and arranged.

activation.quick_def: If a device or process is activated, something causes it to start working.

linked.quick_def: If there is a link between two things or situations, there is a relationship between them, for example because one thing causes or affects the other.

interpretation.quick_def: An interpretation of something is an opinion about what it means.

alex.quick_def: a first name for boys or girls, short for Alexander or Alexandra

forsythe.quick_def: Forsythe is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a family.

liverpool.quick_def: a large city and port in north-west England, on the River Mersey. It first became important during the Industrial Revolution, producing and exporting cotton goods. It was also a major port for the slave trade, receiving profits from the sale of slaves in America. In the 20th century the city became famous as the home of the Beatles and for Liverpool and Everton football clubs. Among its many famous buildings are the Royal Liver Building with its two towers, the Anglican and Roman Catholic cathedrals, and the Walker Art Gallery. In 2008 it held the European Capital of Culture title.

analysed.quick_def: If you analyse something, you consider it carefully or use statistical methods in order to fully understand it.

intricacy.quick_def: Intricacy is the state of being made up of many small parts or details.

please.quick_def: You say please when you are politely asking or inviting someone to do something.  [politeness]

boring.quick_def: If someone or something bores you, you find them dull and uninteresting.

overload.quick_def: If you overload something such as a vehicle, you put more things or people into it than it was designed to carry.

appealing.quick_def: If you appeal to someone to do something, you make a serious and urgent request to them.

fractals.quick_def: In geometry, a fractal is a shape made up of parts that are the same shape as itself and are of smaller and smaller sizes.

repeated.quick_def: If you repeat something, you say or write it again. You can say I repeat to show that you feel strongly about what you are repeating.

motifs.quick_def: A motif is a design which is used as a decoration or as part of an artistic pattern.

recurring.quick_def: If something recurs, it happens more than once.

scales.quick_def: If you refer to the scale of something, you are referring to its size or extent, especially when it is very big.

mountain.quick_def: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides.

peaks.quick_def: The peak of a process or an activity is the point at which it is at its strongest, most successful, or most fully developed.

branches.quick_def: The branches of a tree are the parts that grow out from its trunk and have leaves, flowers, or fruit growing on them.

handwritten.quick_def: A piece of writing that is handwritten is one that someone has written using a pen or pencil rather than by typing it.

letter.quick_def: If you write a letter to someone, you write a message on paper and send it to them, usually by post.

replaying.quick_def: If a match between two sports teams is replayed, the two teams play it again, because neither team won the first time, or because the match was stopped because of bad weather.  [mainly British]

reconstructs.quick_def: If you reconstruct something that has been destroyed or badly damaged, you build it and make it work again.

energetic.quick_def: If you are energetic in what you do, you have a lot of enthusiasm and determination.

actions.quick_def: Action is doing something for a particular purpose.

neurons.quick_def: A neuron is a cell which is part of the nervous system. Neurons send messages to and from the brain.  [technical]

mimic.quick_def: If you mimic the actions or voice of a person or animal, you imitate them, usually in a way that is meant to be amusing or entertaining.

tested.quick_def: When you test something, you try it, for example by touching it or using it for a short time, in order to find out what it is, what condition it is in, or how well it works.

neuroaesthetic.quick_def: Neuroaesthetic is about the study of how the brain responds to art and beauty.

fashions.quick_def: Fashion is the area of activity that involves styles of clothing and appearance.

generations.quick_def: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

forgotten.quick_def: If you forget something or forget how to do something, you cannot think of it or think how to do it, although you knew it or knew how to do it in the past.

foolish.quick_def: If someone's behaviour or action is foolish, it is not sensible and shows a lack of good judgment.

laws.quick_def: The law is a system of rules that a society or government develops in order to deal with crime, business agreements, and social relationships. You can also use the law to refer to the people who work in this system.

artistic.quick_def: Someone who is artistic is good at drawing or painting, or arranging things in a beautiful way.

interpretations.quick_def: An interpretation of something is an opinion about what it means.

decoding.quick_def: If you decode a message that has been written or spoken in a code, you change it into ordinary language.

appreciate.quick_def: If you appreciate something, for example a piece of music or good food, you like it because you recognize its good qualities.

silk.quick_def: Silk is a substance which is made into smooth fine cloth and sewing thread. You can also refer to this cloth or thread as silk.

smooth.quick_def: A smooth surface has no roughness, lumps, or holes.

cocoons.quick_def: A cocoon is a covering of silky threads that the larvae of moths and other insects make for themselves before they grow into adults.

soft.quick_def: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

protective.quick_def: Protective means designed or intended to protect something or someone from harm.

shells.quick_def: The shell of a nut or egg is the hard covering which surrounds it.

mulberry.quick_def: A mulberry or a mulberry tree is a tree which has small purple berries which you can eat.

silkworms.quick_def: A silkworm is the young form of a Chinese moth and it produces silk.

insect.quick_def: An insect is a small animal that has six legs. Most insects have wings. Ants, flies, butterflies, and beetles are all insects.

larvae.quick_def: A larva is an insect at the stage of its life after it has developed from an egg and before it changes into its adult form.

legend.quick_def: A legend is a very old and popular story that may be true.

lei.quick_def: a circle of flowers that is placed around the necks of visitors to Hawaii

tzu.quick_def: Tzu is a name or part of a name. It can be a person's last name or part of a full-name.

wife.quick_def: Someone's wife is the woman they are married to.

emperor.quick_def: An emperor is a man who rules an empire or is the head of state in an empire.

ruler.quick_def: The ruler of a country is the person who rules the country.

bc.quick_def: You use BC in dates to indicate a number of years or centuries before the year in which Jesus Christ is believed to have been born. Compare AD.

walk.quick_def: When you walk, you move forward by putting one foot in front of the other in a regular way.

husband.quick_def: Someone's husband is the man they are married to.

destruction.quick_def: Destruction is the act of destroying something, or the state of being destroyed.

sat.quick_def: Sat is the past tense and past participle of sit.

sipping.quick_def: If you sip a drink or sip at it, you drink by taking just a small amount at a time.

unravel.quick_def: If something such as a plan or system unravels, it breaks up or begins to fail.

thread.quick_def: Thread or a thread is a long very thin piece of a material such as cotton, nylon, or silk, especially one that is used in sewing.

fingers.quick_def: Your fingers are the four long thin parts at the end of each hand.

subsequently.quick_def: You use subsequent to describe something that happened or existed after the time or event that has just been referred to.  [formal]

persuaded.quick_def: If you persuade someone to do something, you cause them to do it by giving them good reasons for doing it.

rear.quick_def: The rear of something such as a building or vehicle is the back part of it.

grove.quick_def: A grove is a group of trees that are close together.

devised.quick_def: If you devise a plan, system, or machine, you have the idea for it and design it.

reel.quick_def: A reel is a cylindrical object around which you wrap something such as cinema film, magnetic tape, fishing line, or cotton thread.  [mainly British]

cocoon.quick_def: A cocoon is a covering of silky threads that the larvae of moths and other insects make for themselves before they grow into adults.

woven.quick_def: Woven is a past participle of weave.

fabric.quick_def: Fabric is cloth or other material produced by weaving together cotton, nylon, wool, silk, or other threads. Fabrics are used for making things such as clothes, curtains, and sheets.

cultivation.quick_def: If you cultivate land or crops, you prepare land and grow crops on it.

millennia.quick_def: A millennium is a period of one thousand years, especially one which begins and ends with a year ending in '000', for example the period from the year 1000 to the year 2000.  [formal]

silkworm.quick_def: A silkworm is the young form of a Chinese moth and it produces silk.

restricted.quick_def: If you restrict something, you put a limit on it in order to reduce it or prevent it becoming too great.

harvesting.quick_def: The harvest is the gathering of a crop.

weaving.quick_def: If you weave cloth or a carpet, you make it by crossing threads over and under each other using a frame or machine called a loom.

royalty.quick_def: The members of royal families are sometimes referred to as royalty.

clothes.quick_def: To clothe someone means to provide them with clothes to wear.

relaxed.quick_def: If you relax or if something relaxes you, you feel more calm and less worried or tense.

qing.quick_def: The Qing refers to a dynasty in Chinese history. A dynasty is a period when a family rules a country.

dynasty.quick_def: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

caste.quick_def: A caste is one of the traditional social classes into which people are divided in a Hindu society.

sometime.quick_def: You use sometime to refer to a time in the future or the past that is unknown or that has not yet been decided.

han.quick_def: Han refers to a famous dynasty in Chinese history. It was a very important and prosperous time in China.

prized.quick_def: A prize is money or something valuable that is given to someone who has the best results in a competition or game, or as a reward for doing good work.

unit.quick_def: If you consider something as a unit, you consider it as a single, complete thing.

currency.quick_def: The money used in a particular country is referred to as its currency.

grain.quick_def: A grain of wheat, rice, or other cereal crop is a seed from it.

diplomatic.quick_def: Diplomatic means relating to diplomacy and diplomats.

gifts.quick_def: A gift is something that you give someone as a present.

bowstrings.quick_def: Bowstrings are the strings on a bow that you pull to shoot an arrow.

musical.quick_def: You use musical to indicate that something is connected with playing or studying music.

indication.quick_def: An indication is a sign which suggests, for example, what people are thinking or feeling.

tomb.quick_def: A tomb is a large grave that is above ground and that usually has a sculpture or other decoration on it.

died.quick_def: When people, animals, and plants die, they stop living.

exotic.quick_def: Something that is exotic is unusual and interesting, usually because it comes from or is related to a distant country.

lucrative.quick_def: A lucrative activity, job, or business deal is very profitable.

route.quick_def: A route is a way from one place to another.

westward.quick_def: Westward or westwards means towards the west.

bringing.quick_def: If you bring someone or something with you when you come to a place, they come with you or you have them with you.

wool.quick_def: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and on some other animals.

named.quick_def: The name of a person, place, or thing is the word or group of words that is used to identify them.

mediterranean.quick_def: The Mediterranean is the sea between southern Europe and North Africa.

climbing.quick_def: If you climb something such as a tree, mountain, or ladder, or climb up it, you move towards the top of it. If you climb down it, you move towards the bottom of it.

pamir.quick_def: Pamir is the name of a mountain range. A mountain range is a group of mountains close to each other.

crossing.quick_def: If you cross something such as a room, a road, or an area of land or water, you move or travel to the other side of it. If you cross to a place, you move or travel over a room, road, or area of land or water in order to reach that place.

trading.quick_def: Trade is the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods or services between people, firms, or countries.

damascus.quick_def: an experience that results in a great change in a person's attitudes or beliefs

merchandise.quick_def: Merchandise is goods that are bought, sold, or traded.  [formal]

shipped.quick_def: A ship is a large boat which carries passengers or cargo.

merchants.quick_def: A merchant is a person who buys or sells goods in large quantities, especially one who imports and exports them.

handled.quick_def: A handle is a small round object or a lever that is attached to a door and is used for opening and closing it.

mostly.quick_def: You use mostly to indicate that a statement is generally true, for example true about the majority of a group of things or people, true most of the time, or true in most respects.

middlemen.quick_def: A middleman is a person or company which buys things from the people who produce them and sells them to the people who want to buy them.  [business]

sole.quick_def: The sole thing or person of a particular type is the only one of that type.

producer.quick_def: A producer is a person whose job is to produce plays, films, programmes, or CDs.

silk-making.quick_def: Silk-making is the activity of making silk.

byzantine.quick_def: Byzantine means related to or connected with the Byzantine Empire.

empire.quick_def: An empire is a number of individual nations that are all controlled by the government or ruler of one particular country.

ruled.quick_def: Rules are instructions that tell you what you are allowed to do and what you are not allowed to do.

monks.quick_def: A monk is a member of a male religious community that is usually separated from the outside world.

justinian.quick_def: Justinian is the name of a person, often referring to an important Byzantine emperor.

smuggled.quick_def: If someone smuggles things or people into a place or out of it, they take them there illegally or secretly.

constantinople.quick_def: Constantinople is an old name of a city. Now it's called Istanbul in Turkey.

istanbul.quick_def: Istanbul is a very big and important city in Turkey. It's a place with many people, buildings and activities.

turkey.quick_def: A turkey is a large bird that is kept on a farm for its meat.

concealed.quick_def: If you conceal something, you cover it or hide it carefully.

hollow.quick_def: Something that is hollow has a space inside it, as opposed to being solid all the way through.

walking.quick_def: When you walk, you move forward by putting one foot in front of the other in a regular way.

canes.quick_def: Cane is used to refer to the long, hollow, hard stems of plants such as bamboo. Strips of cane are often used to make furniture, and some types of cane can be crushed and processed to make sugar.

byzantines.quick_def: The Byzantines are the people who lived in the Byzantine Empire.

secretive.quick_def: If you are secretive, you like to have secrets and to keep your knowledge, feelings, or intentions hidden.

imperial.quick_def: Imperial is used to refer to things or people that are or were connected with an empire.

monopoly.quick_def: If a company, person, or state has a monopoly on something such as an industry, they have complete control over it, so that it is impossible for others to become involved in it.  [business]

arabs.quick_def: Arabs are people from the Arab world, which includes many countries in the Middle East and North Africa.

conquered.quick_def: If one country or group of people conquers another, they take complete control of their land.

persia.quick_def: Persia is an old name for a country in Western Asia. It's now called Iran.

capturing.quick_def: If you capture someone or something, you catch them, especially in a war.

silks.quick_def: Silk is a substance which is made into smooth fine cloth and sewing thread. You can also refer to this cloth or thread as silk.

sicily.quick_def: Sicily is an island in the Mediterranean Sea. It is a place where people live and there are many things like houses, shops and natural scenery.

swept.quick_def: If you sweep an area of floor or ground, you push dirt or rubbish off it using a brush with a long handle.

lands.quick_def: Land is an area of ground, especially one that is used for a particular purpose such as farming or building.

andalusia.quick_def: Andalusia is a place in southern Spain.

silk-producing.quick_def: If a place or thing is silk-producing, it makes silk.

tenth.quick_def: The tenth item in a series is the one that you count as number ten.

thirteenth.quick_def: The thirteenth item in a series is the one that you count as number thirteen.

export.quick_def: To export products or raw materials means to sell them to another country.

venetian.quick_def: A Venetian is a person from Venice. It can also be used to describe things related to Venice.

traded.quick_def: Trade is the activity of buying, selling, or exchanging goods or services between people, firms, or countries.

extensively.quick_def: Something that is extensive covers or includes a large physical area.

growers.quick_def: A grower is a person who grows large quantities of a particular plant or crop in order to sell them.

settle.quick_def: If people settle an argument or problem, or if something settles it, they solve it, for example by making a decision about who is right or about what to do.

processed.quick_def: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

como.quick_def: Como is the name of a place, a province in northern Italy.

enjoys.quick_def: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

esteemed.quick_def: Esteem is the admiration and respect that you feel towards another person.  [formal]

reputation.quick_def: To have a reputation for something means to be known or remembered for it.

downfall.quick_def: The downfall of a successful or powerful person or institution is their loss of success or power.

cheaper.quick_def: Goods or services that are cheap cost less money than usual or than you expected.

facilitated.quick_def: To facilitate an action or process, especially one that you would like to happen, means to make it easier or more likely to happen.

opening.quick_def: If you open something such as a door, window, or lid, or if it opens, its position is changed so that it no longer covers a hole or gap.

suez.quick_def: Suez is the name of a place, often related to the Suez Canal. It's a well-known location in Egypt.

driving.quick_def: When you drive somewhere, you operate a car or other vehicle and control its movement and direction.

nylon.quick_def: Nylon is a strong, flexible artificial fibre.

traditionally.quick_def: Traditional customs, beliefs, or methods are ones that have existed for a long time without changing.

stockings.quick_def: Stockings are items of women's clothing which fit closely over the feet and legs. Stockings are usually made of nylon or silk and are held in place by suspenders.

parachutes.quick_def: A parachute is a device which enables a person to jump from an aircraft and float safely to the ground. It consists of a large piece of thin cloth attached to your body by strings.

wars.quick_def: A war is a period of fighting or conflict between countries or states.

interrupted.quick_def: If you interrupt someone who is speaking, you say or do something that causes them to stop.

stifled.quick_def: If someone stifles something you consider to be a good thing, they prevent it from continuing.  [disapproval]

restored.quick_def: To restore a situation or practice means to cause it to exist again.

practically.quick_def: Practically means almost, but not completely or exactly.

exporter.quick_def: An exporter is a country, firm, or person that sells and sends goods to another country.

yarn.quick_def: Yarn is thread used for knitting or making cloth.

metric.quick_def: Metric means relating to the metric system.

thirds.quick_def: The third item in a series is the one that you count as number three.

loosely.quick_def: Something that is loose is not firmly held or fixed in place.

intervals.quick_def: An interval between two events or dates is the period of time between them.

cycle.quick_def: If you cycle, you ride a bicycle.

rewarded.quick_def: A reward is something that you are given, for example because you have behaved well, worked hard, or provided a service to the community.

instinct.quick_def: Instinct is the natural tendency that a person or animal has to behave or react in a particular way.

dingle.quick_def: Dingle is a proper name, usually used as a person's last name.

varying.quick_def: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

combinations.quick_def: A combination of things is a mixture of them.

migrations.quick_def: If people migrate, they move from one place to another, especially in order to find work or to live somewhere for a short time.

prolonged.quick_def: To prolong something means to make it last longer.

movements.quick_def: A movement is a group of people who share the same beliefs, ideas, or aims.

habitats.quick_def: The habitat of an animal or plant is the natural environment in which it normally lives or grows.

linear.quick_def: A linear process or development is one in which something changes or progresses straight from one stage to another, and has a starting point and an ending point.

zigzaggy.quick_def: If something is zigzaggy, it has a line or path that goes in many sharp turns and changes direction often.

behaviours.quick_def: People's or animals' behaviour is the way that they behave. You can refer to a typical and repeated way of behaving as a behaviour.

concerning.quick_def: Concern is worry about a situation.

preparation.quick_def: Preparation is the process of getting something ready for use or for a particular purpose or making arrangements for something.

overfeeding.quick_def: Overfeeding means giving too much food to someone or something.

allocations.quick_def: An allocation is an amount of something, especially money, that is given to a particular person or used for a particular purpose.

attentiveness.quick_def: the quality of listening or watching carefully and with interest

mission.quick_def: A mission is an important task that people are given to do, especially one that involves travelling to another country.

undistracted.quick_def: If you are undistracted, you can focus on what you are doing without being interrupted by other things.

temptations.quick_def: If you feel you want to do something or have something, even though you know you really should avoid it, you can refer to this feeling as temptation. You can also refer to the thing you want to do or have as a temptation.

undeterred.quick_def: if somebody is undeterred by something, they do not allow it to stop them from doing something

aside.quick_def: If you move something aside, you move it to one side of you.

tern.quick_def: A tern is a small black and white seabird with long wings and a forked tail.

circle.quick_def: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

notice.quick_def: If you notice something or someone, you become aware of them.

smelly.quick_def: Something that is smelly has an unpleasant smell.

herring.quick_def: A herring is a long silver-coloured fish. Herring live in large groups in the sea.

bird-watcher.quick_def: A bird-watcher is a person who likes to watch birds in nature.

gulls.quick_def: A gull is a common sea bird.

dive.quick_def: If you dive into some water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head.

voraciously.quick_def: If you describe a person, or their appetite for something, as voracious, you mean that they want a lot of something.  [literary]

handouts.quick_def: A handout is a gift of money, clothing, or food, which is given free to poor people.

flies.quick_def: A fly is a small insect with two wings. There are many kinds of flies, and the most common are black in colour.

resists.quick_def: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

distraction.quick_def: A distraction is something that turns your attention away from something you want to concentrate on.

driven.quick_def: Driven is the past participle of drive.

instinctive.quick_def: An instinctive feeling, idea, or action is one that you have or do without thinking or reasoning.

admirable.quick_def: An admirable quality or action is one that deserves to be praised and admired.

destination.quick_def: The destination of someone or something is the place to which they are going or being sent.

bird.quick_def: A bird is a creature with feathers and wings. Female birds lay eggs. Most birds can fly.

mate.quick_def: You can refer to someone's friends as their mates.  [British, informal]

totally.quick_def: A total is the number that you get when you add several numbers together or when you count how many things there are in a group.

undivided.quick_def: If you give someone or something your undivided attention, you concentrate on them fully and do not think about anything else.

intent.quick_def: If you are intent on doing something, you are eager and determined to do it.

gravelly.quick_def: A gravelly voice is low and rather rough and harsh.

coastline.quick_def: A country's coastline is the outline of its coast.

terns.quick_def: A tern is a small black and white seabird with long wings and a forked tail.

converged.quick_def: If people or vehicles converge on a place, they move towards it from different directions.

hatch.quick_def: When a baby bird, insect, or other animal hatches, or when it is hatched, it comes out of its egg by breaking the shell.

define.quick_def: If you define something, you show, describe, or state clearly what it is and what its limits are, or what it is like.

depending.quick_def: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

sorts.quick_def: If you talk about a particular sort of something, you are talking about a class of things that have particular features in common and that belong to a larger group of related things.

joel.quick_def: Joel is a common male name.

berger.quick_def: Berger is a surname. A surname is the family name that a person shares with other family members.

montana.quick_def: a large state in the north-western US, on the Canadian border. The capital city is Helena, and the largest city is Billings. Montana became a state in 1889, and is also called the Treasure State. It produces many minerals, and its mines once supplied half of all US copper (= a soft red-brown metal). It also produces grain, potatoes, sheep and cattle. Montana's tourist attractions include the Rocky Mountains, Yellowstone National Park, the Glacier National Park and the Little Bighorn Battlefield National Monument.

pronghorn.quick_def: A pronghorn is a kind of fast-running animal that lives in North America.

terrestrial.quick_def: A terrestrial animal or plant lives on land or on the ground rather than in the sea, in trees, or in the air.  [technical]

mammals.quick_def: Mammals are animals such as humans, dogs, lions, and whales. Most female mammals give birth to babies rather than laying eggs, and all female mammals feed their young with milk.

prefers.quick_def: If you prefer someone or something, you like that person or thing better than another, and so you are more likely to choose them if there is a choice.

suited.quick_def: A man's suit consists of a jacket, trousers, and sometimes a waistcoat, all made from the same fabric.

beasts.quick_def: You can refer to an animal as a beast, especially if it is a large, dangerous, or unusual one.  [literary]

seasonal.quick_def: A seasonal factor, event, or change occurs during one particular time of the year.

back-and-forth.quick_def: Back-and-forth means moving first in one direction and then back in the opposite direction, or having a continuous exchange between two things or people.

zooplankton.quick_def: Zooplankton is a mass of very small animals that float in water and are eaten by sea creatures.

upward.quick_def: An upward movement or look is directed towards a higher place or a higher level.

downward.quick_def: A downward movement or look is directed towards a lower place or a lower level.

aphids.quick_def: Aphids are very small insects which live on plants and suck their juices.

fly.quick_def: A fly is a small insect with two wings. There are many kinds of flies, and the most common are black in colour.

onward.quick_def: Onward means moving forward or continuing a journey.

aphid.quick_def: Aphids are very small insects which live on plants and suck their juices.

citing.quick_def: If you cite something, you quote it or mention it, especially as an example or proof of what you are saying.  [formal]

distinguish.quick_def: If you can distinguish one thing from another or distinguish between two things, you can see or understand how they are different.

sky.quick_def: The sky is the space around the Earth which you can see when you stand outside and look upwards.

takeoff.quick_def: Takeoff is the beginning of a flight, when an aircraft leaves the ground.

tender.quick_def: Someone or something that is tender expresses gentle and caring feelings.

fatten.quick_def: If an animal is fattened, or if it fattens, it becomes fatter as a result of eating more.

feeding.quick_def: the act of giving food to a person, an animal or a plant

migrational.quick_def: If something is migrational, it is related to the movement of animals from one place to another at a particular time of the year.

focuses.quick_def: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

wildebeest.quick_def: A wildebeest is a large African antelope which has a hairy tail, short curved horns, and long hair under its neck. Wildebeest usually live in large groups.

guide.quick_def: A guide is a book that gives you information or instructions to help you do or understand something.

antelope.quick_def: An antelope is an animal like a deer, with long legs and horns, that lives in Africa or Asia. Antelopes are graceful and can run fast. There are many different types of antelope.

mammal.quick_def: Mammals are animals such as humans, dogs, lions, and whales. Most female mammals give birth to babies rather than laying eggs, and all female mammals feed their young with milk.

spends.quick_def: When you spend money, you pay money for things that you want.

mountainous.quick_def: A mountainous place has a lot of mountains.

teton.quick_def: Teton is the name of a mountain range and a national park in the western USA. It's a place with beautiful mountains and nature.

mountains.quick_def: A mountain is a very high area of land with steep sides.

river.quick_def: A river is a large amount of fresh water flowing continuously in a long line across the land.

plains.quick_def: A plain object, surface, or fabric is entirely in one colour and has no pattern, design, or writing on it.

wait.quick_def: When you wait for something or someone, you spend some time doing very little, because you cannot act until that thing happens or that person arrives.

sagebrush.quick_def: a plant with leaves that smell sweet that grows in dry regions in the western US; an area of ground covered with sagebrush

invariance.quick_def: Invariance means the quality of not changing. It's when something stays the same all the time.

severity.quick_def: You use severe to indicate that something bad or undesirable is great or intense.

constriction.quick_def: If a part of your body, especially your throat, is constricted or if it constricts, something causes it to become narrower.

bottlenecks.quick_def: A bottleneck is a place where a road becomes narrow or where it meets another road so that the traffic slows down or stops, often causing traffic jams.

pass.quick_def: To pass someone or something means to go past them without stopping.

bounty.quick_def: You can refer to something that is provided in large amounts as bounty.  [literary]

grazing.quick_def: When animals graze or are grazed, they eat the grass or other plants that are growing in a particular place. You can also say that a field is grazed by animals.

escaping.quick_def: If you escape from a place, you succeed in getting away from it.

die.quick_def: When people, animals, and plants die, they stop living.

overwinter.quick_def: to spend the winter months in a place; to stay alive or to keep something alive during the winter

shoulders.quick_def: Your shoulders are between your neck and the tops of your arms.

forested.quick_def: A forested area is an area covered in trees growing closely together.

hills.quick_def: A hill is an area of land that is higher than the land that surrounds it.

v.quick_def: V is the twenty-second letter of the English alphabet.

corridor.quick_def: A corridor is a long passage in a building, with doors and rooms on one or both sides.

choke.quick_def: When you choke or when something chokes you, you cannot breathe properly or get enough air into your lungs.

passageway.quick_def: A passageway is a long narrow space with walls or fences on both sides, which connects one place or room with another.

agencies.quick_def: An agency is a business which provides a service on behalf of other businesses.  [business]

path.quick_def: A path is a long strip of ground which people walk along to get from one place to another.

bottleneck.quick_def: A bottleneck is a place where a road becomes narrow or where it meets another road so that the traffic slows down or stops, often causing traffic jams.

complicated.quick_def: To complicate something means to make it more difficult to understand or deal with.

traversed.quick_def: If someone or something traverses an area of land or water, they go across it.  [literary]

borders.quick_def: The border between two countries or regions is the dividing line between them. Sometimes the border also refers to the land close to this line.

dangers.quick_def: Danger is the possibility that someone may be harmed or killed.

wisdom.quick_def: Wisdom is the ability to use your experience and knowledge in order to make sensible decisions or judgments.

journeying.quick_def: When you make a journey, you travel from one place to another.

compositions.quick_def: When you talk about the composition of something, you are referring to the way in which its various parts are put together and arranged.

beginner.quick_def: A beginner is someone who has just started learning to do something and cannot do it very well yet.

mathematics.quick_def: Mathematics is the study of numbers, quantities, or shapes.

discoveries.quick_def: If someone makes a discovery, they become aware of something that they did not know about before.

depend.quick_def: If you say that one thing depends on another, you mean that the first thing will be affected or determined by the second.

specialized.quick_def: If you specialize in a thing, you know a lot about it and concentrate a great deal of your time and energy on it, especially in your work or when you are studying or training. You also use specialize to talk about a restaurant which concentrates on a particular type of food.

algebra.quick_def: Algebra is a type of mathematics in which letters are used to represent possible quantities.

geometry.quick_def: Geometry is the branch of mathematics concerned with the properties and relationships of lines, angles, curves, and shapes.

trigonometry.quick_def: Trigonometry is the branch of mathematics that is concerned with calculating the angles of triangles or the lengths of their sides.

arithmetic.quick_def: Arithmetic is the part of mathematics that is concerned with the addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division of numbers.

odd.quick_def: If you describe someone or something as odd, you think that they are strange or unusual.

chapters.quick_def: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

illustrates.quick_def: If you say that something illustrates a situation that you are drawing attention to, you mean that it shows that the situation exists.

chapter.quick_def: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

elementary.quick_def: Something that is elementary is very simple and basic.

readers.quick_def: The readers of a newspaper, magazine, or book are the people who read it.

participate.quick_def: If you participate in an activity, you take part in it.

mathematical.quick_def: Something that is mathematical involves numbers and calculations.

beauty.quick_def: Beauty is the state or quality of being beautiful.

logical.quick_def: In a logical argument or method of reasoning, each step must be true if the step before it is true.

intuitive.quick_def: If you have an intuitive idea or feeling about something, you feel that it is true although you have no evidence or proof of it.

haven.quick_def: A haven is a place where people or animals feel safe, secure, and happy.

enjoy.quick_def: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

importantly.quick_def: Something that is important is very significant, is highly valued, or is necessary.

differs.quick_def: If two or more things differ, they are unlike each other in some way.

colorful.quick_def: Something that is colorful has bright colors or a lot of different colors.

describe.quick_def: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

adept.quick_def: Someone who is adept at something can do it skilfully.

bridge.quick_def: A bridge is a structure that is built over a railway, river, or road so that people or vehicles can cross from one side to the other.

gap.quick_def: A gap is a space between two things or a hole in the middle of something solid.

separates.quick_def: If one thing is separate from another, there is a barrier, space, or division between them, so that they are clearly two things.

cultures.quick_def: Culture consists of activities such as the arts and philosophy, which are considered to be important for the development of civilization and of people's minds.

humanities.quick_def: All the people in the world can be referred to as humanity.

analytical.quick_def: An analytical way of doing something involves the use of logical reasoning.

numerical.quick_def: Numerical means expressed in numbers or relating to numbers.

illustrate.quick_def: If you say that something illustrates a situation that you are drawing attention to, you mean that it shows that the situation exists.

intuition.quick_def: Your intuition or your intuitions are unexplained feelings you have that something is true even when you have no evidence or proof of it.

alleged.quick_def: If you allege that something bad is true, you say it but do not prove it.  [formal]

narrowed.quick_def: Something that is narrow measures a very small distance from one side to the other, especially compared to its length or height.

cite.quick_def: If you cite something, you quote it or mention it, especially as an example or proof of what you are saying.  [formal]

structural.quick_def: Structural means relating to or affecting the structure of something.

engineer.quick_def: An engineer is a person who uses scientific knowledge to design, construct, and maintain engines and machines or structures such as roads, railways, and bridges.

mathematician.quick_def: A mathematician is a person who is trained in the study of numbers and calculations.

publishes.quick_def: When a company publishes a book or magazine, it prints copies of it, which are sent to shops to be sold.

stories.quick_def: A story is a description of imaginary people and events, which is written or told in order to entertain.

non-scientists.quick_def: Non-scientists are people who are not scientists.

omit.quick_def: If you omit someone or something, you do not include them in an activity or piece of work, deliberately or accidentally.

provides.quick_def: If you provide something that someone needs or wants, or if you provide them with it, you give it to them or make it available to them.

foundation.quick_def: Found is the past tense and past participle of find.

tantalized.quick_def: If someone or something tantalizes you, they make you feel hopeful and excited about getting what you want, usually before disappointing you by not letting you have what they appeared to offer.

spectator.quick_def: A spectator is someone who watches something, especially a sporting event.

participant.quick_def: The participants in an activity are the people who take part in it.

details.quick_def: The details of something are its individual features or elements.

expanding.quick_def: If something expands or is expanded, it becomes larger.

universe.quick_def: The universe is the whole of space and all the stars, planets, and other forms of matter and energy in it.

subatomic.quick_def: A subatomic particle is a particle which is part of an atom, for example an electron, a proton, or a neutron.  [technical]

particles.quick_def: A particle of something is a very small piece or amount of it.

chromosomes.quick_def: A chromosome is a part of a cell in an animal or plant. It contains genes which determine what characteristics the animal or plant will have.

outline.quick_def: If you outline an idea or a plan, you explain it in a general way.

sketched.quick_def: A sketch is a drawing that is done quickly without a lot of details. Artists often use sketches as a preparation for a more detailed painting or drawing.

text.quick_def: The text of a book is the main part of it, rather than the introduction, pictures, or notes.

non-mathematical.quick_def: If something is non-mathematical, it has nothing to do with mathematics.

step-by-step.quick_def: If something is done step-by-step, it is done one step at a time, following a certain order.

pages.quick_def: A page is one side of one of the pieces of paper in a book, magazine, or newspaper. Each page usually has a number printed at the top or bottom.

newspaper.quick_def: A newspaper is a publication consisting of a number of large sheets of folded paper, on which news, advertisements, and other information is printed.

pencil.quick_def: A pencil is an object that you write or draw with. It consists of a thin piece of wood with a rod of a black or coloured substance through the middle. If you write or draw something in pencil, you do it using a pencil.

check.quick_def: If you check something such as a piece of information or a document, you make sure that it is correct or satisfactory.

enjoyed.quick_def: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

unpleasant.quick_def: If something is unpleasant, it gives you bad feelings, for example by making you feel upset or uncomfortable.

episode.quick_def: You can refer to an event or a short period of time as an episode if you want to suggest that it is important or unusual, or has some particular quality.

fifth.quick_def: The fifth item in a series is the one that you count as number five.

grade.quick_def: If something is graded, its quality is judged, and it is often given a number or a name that indicates how good or bad it is.

aficionados.quick_def: If someone is an aficionado of something, they like it and know a lot about it.

serves.quick_def: If you serve your country, an organization, or a person, you do useful work for them.

sharpen.quick_def: If your senses, understanding, or skills sharpen or are sharpened, you become better at noticing things, thinking, or doing something.

careers.quick_def: A career is the job or profession that someone does for a long period of their life.

medicine.quick_def: Medicine is the treatment of illness and injuries by doctors and nurses.

extended.quick_def: If you say that something, usually something large, extends for a particular distance or extends from one place to another, you are indicating its size or position.

line.quick_def: A line is a long thin mark which is drawn or painted on a surface.

testimonials.quick_def: A testimonial is a written statement about a person's character and abilities, often written by their employer.

physician.quick_def: In formal American English or old-fashioned British English, a physician is a doctor.

prepared.quick_def: If you prepare something, you make it ready for something that is going to happen.

analyzed.quick_def: When you analyze something, you study it carefully to understand it better. 'Analyzed' is the past tense of 'analyze'.

background.quick_def: Your background is the kind of family you come from and the kind of education you have had. It can also refer to such things as your social and racial origins, your financial status, or the type of work experience that you have.

schools.quick_def: A school is a place where children are educated. You usually refer to this place as school when you are talking about the time that children spend there and the activities that they do there.

attribute.quick_def: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

theorems.quick_def: A theorem is a statement in mathematics or logic that can be proved to be true by reasoning.

analyze.quick_def: When you analyze something, you study it carefully to understand it better.

principles.quick_def: A principle is a general belief that you have about the way you should behave, which influences your behaviour.

lawyers.quick_def: A lawyer is a person who is qualified to advise people about the law and represent them in court.

master.quick_def: A servant's master is the man that he or she works for.

legal.quick_def: Legal is used to describe things that relate to the law.

delight.quick_def: Delight is a feeling of very great pleasure.

watching.quick_def: If you watch someone or something, you look at them, usually for a period of time, and pay attention to what is happening.

solutions.quick_def: A solution to a problem or difficult situation is a way of dealing with it so that the difficulty is removed.

purely.quick_def: You use purely to emphasize that the thing you are mentioning is the most important feature or that it is the only thing which should be considered.  [emphasis]

unanticipated.quick_def: that you have not expected or predicted

biomedical.quick_def: Biomedical research examines the effects of drugs and medical techniques on the biological systems of living creatures.

influence.quick_def: Influence is the power to make other people agree with your opinions or do what you want.

nurture.quick_def: If you nurture something such as a young child or a young plant, you care for it while it is growing and developing.  [formal]

fertilized.quick_def: When an egg from the ovary of a woman or female animal is fertilized, a sperm from the male joins with the egg, causing a baby or young animal to begin forming. A female plant is fertilized when its reproductive parts come into contact with pollen from the male plant.

egg.quick_def: An egg is an oval object that is produced by a female bird and which contains a baby bird. Other animals such as reptiles and fish also lay eggs.

splits.quick_def: If something splits or if you split it, it is divided into two or more parts.

twin.quick_def: If two people are twins, they have the same mother and were born on the same day.

younger.quick_def: A young person, animal, or plant has not lived or existed for very long and is not yet mature.

alternatively.quick_def: You use alternatively to introduce a suggestion or to mention something different to what has just been stated.

comparing.quick_def: When you compare things, you consider them and discover the differences or similarities between them.

fraternal.quick_def: Fraternal actions show strong links of friendship between two people or groups of people.  [formal]

quantify.quick_def: If you try to quantify something, you try to calculate how much of it there is.

ailment.quick_def: An ailment is an illness, especially one that is not very serious.

vulnerability.quick_def: the fact of being weak and easily hurt physically or emotionally

rooted.quick_def: The roots of a plant are the parts of it that grow under the ground.

heredity.quick_def: Heredity is the process by which features and characteristics are passed on from parents to their children before the children are born.

pinpoint.quick_def: If you pinpoint the cause of something, you discover or explain the cause exactly.

inheritance.quick_def: An inheritance is money or property which you receive from someone who has died.

personalities.quick_def: Your personality is your whole character and nature.

galton.quick_def: Galton is a surname. Usually, it refers to a person with this family name.

coined.quick_def: A coin is a small piece of metal which is used as money.

reunited.quick_def: If people are reunited, or if they reunite, they meet each other again after they have been separated for some time.

adults.quick_def: An adult is a mature, fully developed person. An adult has reached the age when they are legally responsible for their actions.

bouchard.quick_def: Bouchard is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a particular family.

lab.quick_def: A lab is the same as a laboratory.

reared.quick_def: The rear of something such as a building or vehicle is the back part of it.

makeup.quick_def: Makeup consists of things such as lipstick, eye shadow, and powder which some women put on their faces to make themselves look more attractive or which actors use to change or improve their appearance.

heritability.quick_def: Heritability is the degree to which a trait can be passed from parents to children.

wherever.quick_def: You use wherever to indicate that something happens or is true in any place or situation.

invisible.quick_def: If you describe something as invisible, you mean that it cannot be seen, for example because it is transparent, hidden, or very small.

helping.quick_def: If you help someone, you make it easier for them to do something, for example by doing part of the work for them or by giving them advice or money.

lately.quick_def: You use lately to describe events in the recent past, or situations that started a short time ago.

radical.quick_def: Radical changes and differences are very important and great in degree.

elemental.quick_def: Elemental feelings and types of behaviour are simple, basic, and forceful.  [literary]

epigenetics.quick_def: Epigenetics is the study of how the environment and other factors can change how our genes work without changing the genes themselves.

operates.quick_def: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

epigenetic.quick_def: Epigenetic means related to changes in how genes work that don't change the DNA sequence itself.

reactions.quick_def: Your reaction to something that has happened or something that you have experienced is what you feel, say, or do because of it.

representing.quick_def: If someone such as a lawyer or a politician represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

component.quick_def: The components of something are the parts that it is made of.

expressed.quick_def: When you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

bodies.quick_def: Your body is all your physical parts, including your head, arms, and legs.

keyboard.quick_def: The keyboard a computer, tablet, or on some mobile phones is the set of keys that you press in order to operate it.

keys.quick_def: A key is a specially shaped piece of metal that you place in a lock and turn in order to open or lock a door, or to start or stop the engine of a vehicle.

symbolizing.quick_def: If one thing symbolizes another, it is used or regarded as a symbol of it.

segment.quick_def: A segment of something is one part of it, considered separately from the rest.

note.quick_def: A note is a short letter.

combining.quick_def: If you combine two or more things or if they combine, they exist together.

determine.quick_def: If a particular factor determines the nature of a thing or event, it causes it to be of a particular kind.  [formal]

tune.quick_def: A tune is a series of musical notes that is pleasant and easy to remember.

revolutionizing.quick_def: When something revolutionizes an activity, it causes great changes in the way that it is done.

revealing.quick_def: To reveal something means to make people aware of it.

mechanism.quick_def: In a machine or piece of equipment, a mechanism is a part, often consisting of a set of smaller parts, which performs a particular function.

rat.quick_def: A rat is an animal which has a long tail and looks like a large mouse.

fetus.quick_def: a young human or animal before it is born, especially a human more than eight weeks after fertilization

behavioral.quick_def: Behavioral means relating to the behavior of a person or animal, or to the study of their behavior.

rodent.quick_def: Rodents are small mammals which have sharp front teeth. Rats, mice, and squirrels are rodents.

grows.quick_def: When people, animals, and plants grow, they increase in size and change physically over a period of time.

embryonic.quick_def: An embryonic process, idea, organization, or organism is one at a very early stage in its development.  [formal]

liver.quick_def: Your liver is a large organ in your body which processes your blood and helps to clean unwanted substances out of it.

geneticist.quick_def: A geneticist is a person who studies or specializes in genetics.

danielle.quick_def: Danielle is a name for a girl. People use it to call a specific female person.

reed.quick_def: Reeds are tall plants that grow in large groups in shallow water or on ground that is always wet and soft. They have strong, hollow stems that can be used for making things such as mats or baskets.

deeply.quick_def: If something is deep, it extends a long way down from the ground or from the top surface of something.

hardwired.quick_def: A hardwired part of a computer forms part of its hardware.

unalterable.quick_def: Something that is unalterable cannot be changed.

origin.quick_def: You can refer to the beginning, cause, or source of something as its origin or origins.

credits.quick_def: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

trailblazer.quick_def: A trailblazer is a person who is the leader in a particular field, especially who does a particular thing before anyone else does.

forget.quick_def: If you forget something or forget how to do something, you cannot think of it or think how to do it, although you knew it or knew how to do it in the past.

schizophrenia.quick_def: Schizophrenia is a serious mental illness. People who have it are unable to relate their thoughts and feelings to what is happening around them and often withdraw from society.

mothering.quick_def: Your mother is the woman who gave birth to you. You can also call someone your mother if she brings you up as if she was this woman. You can call your mother 'Mother'.

reflective.quick_def: If you are reflective, you are thinking deeply about something.  [written]

pen.quick_def: A pen is a long thin object which you use to write in ink.

writings.quick_def: Writing is something that has been written or printed.

sort.quick_def: If you talk about a particular sort of something, you are talking about a class of things that have particular features in common and that belong to a larger group of related things.

film.quick_def: A film consists of moving pictures that have been recorded so that they can be shown at the cinema or on television. A film tells a story, or shows a real situation.  [mainly British]

afford.quick_def: If you cannot afford something, you do not have enough money to pay for it.

sound.quick_def: A sound is something that you hear.

track.quick_def: A track is a narrow road or path.

ultimately.quick_def: Ultimately means finally, after a long and often complicated series of events.

responsibility.quick_def: If you have responsibility for something or someone, or if they are your responsibility, it is your job or duty to deal with them and to take decisions relating to them.

ingredients.quick_def: Ingredients are the things that are used to make something, especially all the different foods you use when you are cooking a particular dish.

voice.quick_def: When someone speaks or sings, you hear their voice.

tracks.quick_def: A track is a narrow road or path.

emphases.quick_def: Emphasis is special or extra importance that is given to an activity or to a part or aspect of something.

desired.quick_def: A desire is a strong wish to do or have something.

refer.quick_def: If you refer to a particular subject or person, you talk about them or mention them.

mentioned.quick_def: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

dialogue.quick_def: Dialogue is communication or discussion between people or groups of people such as governments or political parties.

synchronous.quick_def: happening or existing at the same time

asynchronous.quick_def: Asynchronous events or processes do not happen at the same time.

drama.quick_def: A drama is a serious play for the theatre, television, or radio.

expresses.quick_def: When you express an idea or feeling, or express yourself, you show what you think or feel.

characters.quick_def: The character of a person or place consists of all the qualities they have that make them distinct from other people or places.

characterization.quick_def: Characterization is the way an author or an actor describes or shows what a character is like.

perceives.quick_def: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

actor.quick_def: An actor is someone whose job is acting in plays or films. 'Actor' in the singular usually refers to a man, but some women who act prefer to be called 'actors' rather than ' actresses'.

humphrey.quick_def: Humphrey is a name for a person.

bogart.quick_def: To be like the famous actor Humphrey Bogart, often meaning to act in a tough, cool-looking way.

spade.quick_def: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a flat metal blade and a long handle.

merge.quick_def: If one thing merges with another, or is merged with another, they combine or come together to make one whole thing. You can also say that two things merge, or are merged.

texture.quick_def: The texture of something is the way that it feels when you touch it, for example how smooth or rough it is.

performer.quick_def: A performer is a person who acts, sings, or does other entertainment in front of audiences.

supplies.quick_def: If you supply someone with something that they want or need, you give them a quantity of it.

textures.quick_def: The texture of something is the way that it feels when you touch it, for example how smooth or rough it is.

physiognomy.quick_def: Your physiognomy is your face, especially when it is considered to show your real character.  [formal]

gestures.quick_def: A gesture is a movement that you make with a part of your body, especially your hands, to express emotion or information.

realistic.quick_def: If you are realistic about a situation, you recognize and accept its true nature and try to deal with it in a practical way.

persona.quick_def: Someone's persona is the aspect of their character or nature that they present to other people, perhaps in contrast to their real character or nature.  [formal]

emerges.quick_def: To emerge means to come out from an enclosed or dark space such as a room or a vehicle, or from a position where you could not be seen.

craft.quick_def: You can refer to a boat, a spacecraft, or an aircraft as a craft.

varies.quick_def: If things vary, they are different from each other in size, amount, or degree.

science-fiction.quick_def: Science-fiction is a kind of story that uses scientific ideas and often talks about the future or other worlds.

banal.quick_def: If you describe something as banal, you do not like it because you think that it is so ordinary that it is not at all effective or interesting.  [disapproval]

intrinsic.quick_def: If something has intrinsic value or intrinsic interest, it is valuable or interesting because of its basic nature or character, and not because of its connection with other things.  [formal]

film-maker.quick_def: A film-maker is a person who makes films.
