portray.quick_def: When an actor or actress portrays someone, he or she plays that person in a play or film.

sobochack.quick_def: Sobochack is a family name. A family name is what a family members share.

vivian.quick_def: a first name for girls (usually Vivian, Vivien or Vivienne) or boys (usually Vivian or Vyvyan)

introduction.quick_def: To introduce something means to cause it to enter a place or exist in a system for the first time.

inadequacy.quick_def: The inadequacy of something is the fact that there is not enough of it, or that it is not good enough.

responses.quick_def: Your response to an event or to something that is said is your reply or reaction to it.

beauties.quick_def: Beauty is the state or quality of being beautiful.

comedy.quick_def: Comedy consists of types of entertainment, such as plays and films, or particular scenes in them, that are intended to make people laugh.

baby.quick_def: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

non-stop.quick_def: If something happens non-stop, it happens continuously without stopping.

breakneck.quick_def: If you say that something happens or travels at breakneck speed, you mean that it happens or travels very fast.

underscores.quick_def: If something such as an action or an event underscores another, it draws attention to the other thing and emphasizes its importance.  [mainly US]

dizzy.quick_def: If you feel dizzy, you feel that you are losing your balance and are about to fall.

hepburn.quick_def: Hepburn is a well-known family name. Usually, it refers to famous people with this name, like Katherine Hepburn, a very famous actress.

absurdity.quick_def: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.  [disapproval]

humor.quick_def: the quality in something that makes it funny; the ability to laugh at things that are funny

bounced.quick_def: When an object such as a ball bounces or when you bounce it, it moves upwards from a surface or away from it immediately after hitting it.

gag.quick_def: A gag is something such as a piece of cloth that is tied around or put inside someone's mouth in order to stop them from speaking.

reflection.quick_def: A reflection is an image that you can see in a mirror or in glass or water.

whirlwind.quick_def: A whirlwind is a tall column of air which spins round and round very fast and moves across the land or sea.

plot.quick_def: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, usually against a person or a government.

pure.quick_def: A pure substance is not mixed with anything else.

escapism.quick_def: If you describe an activity or type of entertainment as escapism, you mean that it makes people think about pleasant things instead of the uninteresting or unpleasant aspects of their life.

frenetic.quick_def: If you describe an activity as frenetic, you mean that it is fast and energetic, but rather uncontrolled.

synchronized.quick_def: If you synchronize two activities, processes, or movements, or if you synchronize one activity, process, or movement with another, you cause them to happen at the same time and speed as each other.

portrays.quick_def: When an actor or actress portrays someone, he or she plays that person in a play or film.

playing.quick_def: When children, animals, or perhaps adults play, they spend time doing enjoyable things, such as using toys and taking part in games.

projected.quick_def: A project is a task that requires a lot of time and effort.

realism.quick_def: When people show realism in their behaviour, they recognize and accept the true nature of a situation and try to deal with it in a practical way.  [approval]

click.quick_def: If something clicks or if you click it, it makes a short, sharp sound.

portrayed.quick_def: When an actor or actress portrays someone, he or she plays that person in a play or film.

subconsciously.quick_def: Your subconscious is the part of your mind that can influence you or affect your behaviour even though you are not aware of it.

ominous.quick_def: If you describe something as ominous, you mean that it worries you because it makes you think that something unpleasant is going to happen.

burglary.quick_def: If someone commits a burglary, they enter a building by force and steal things. Burglary is the act of doing this.

mixer.quick_def: A mixer is a machine used for mixing things together.

engage.quick_def: If you engage in an activity, you do it or are actively involved with it.  [formal]

suspense.quick_def: Suspense is a state of excitement or anxiety about something that is going to happen very soon, for example about some news that you are waiting to hear.

nuance.quick_def: A nuance is a small difference in sound, feeling, appearance, or meaning.

ambulance.quick_def: An ambulance is a vehicle for taking people to and from hospital.

siren.quick_def: A siren is a warning device which makes a long, loud noise. Most fire engines, ambulances, and police cars have sirens.

foreground.quick_def: The foreground of a picture or scene you are looking at is the part or area of it that appears nearest to you.

arguing.quick_def: If one person argues with another, they speak angrily to each other about something that they disagree about. You can also say that two people argue.

couple.quick_def: If you refer to a couple of people or things, you mean two or approximately two of them, although the exact number is not important or you are not sure of it.

psychic.quick_def: If you believe that someone is psychic or has psychic powers, you believe that they have strange mental powers, such as being able to read the minds of other people or to see into the future.

injury.quick_def: An injury is damage done to a person's or an animal's body.

incurred.quick_def: If you incur something unpleasant, it happens to you because of something you have done.  [written]

argument.quick_def: An argument is a statement or set of statements that you use in order to try to convince people that your opinion about something is correct.

acknowledging.quick_def: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.  [formal]

ubiquitous.quick_def: If you describe something or someone as ubiquitous, you mean that they seem to be everywhere.  [formal]

noticeable.quick_def: Something that is noticeable is very obvious, so that it is easy to see, hear, or recognize.

absence.quick_def: Someone's absence from a place is the fact that they are not there.

rhythm.quick_def: A rhythm is a regular series of sounds or movements.

tone.quick_def: The tone of a sound is its particular quality.

attitude.quick_def: Your attitude to something is the way that you think and feel about it, especially when this shows in the way you behave.

depicted.quick_def: To depict someone or something means to show or represent them in a work of art such as a drawing or painting.

foreshadows.quick_def: If something foreshadows an event or situation, it suggests that it will happen.

mood.quick_def: Your mood is the way you are feeling at a particular time. If you are in a good mood, you feel cheerful. If you are in a bad mood, you feel angry and impatient.

approaching.quick_def: When you approach something, you get closer to it.

disaster.quick_def: A disaster is a very bad accident such as an earthquake or a plane crash, especially one in which a lot of people are killed.

aid.quick_def: Aid is money, equipment, or services that are provided for people, countries, or organizations who need them but cannot provide them for themselves.

linking.quick_def: If there is a link between two things or situations, there is a relationship between them, for example because one thing causes or affects the other.

scenes.quick_def: A scene in a play, film, or book is part of it in which a series of events happen in the same place.

theme.quick_def: A theme in a piece of writing, a talk, or a discussion is an important idea or subject that runs through it.

remind.quick_def: If someone reminds you of a fact or event that you already know about, they say something which makes you think about it.

salient.quick_def: The salient points or facts of a situation are the most important ones.  [formal]

acceleration.quick_def: The acceleration of a process or change is the fact that it is getting faster and faster.

chases.quick_def: If you chase someone, or chase after them, you run after them or follow them quickly in order to catch or reach them.

creaky.quick_def: A creaky object creaks when it moves.

doors.quick_def: A door is a piece of wood, glass, or metal, which is moved to open and close the entrance to a building, room, cupboard, or vehicle.

horror.quick_def: Horror is a feeling of great shock, fear, and worry caused by something extremely unpleasant.

brilliantly.quick_def: in a way that is very impressive or shows a lot of skill

conceived.quick_def: If you cannot conceive of something, you cannot imagine it or believe it.

subconscious.quick_def: Your subconscious is the part of your mind that can influence you or affect your behaviour even though you are not aware of it.

minds.quick_def: You refer to someone's mind when talking about their thoughts. For example, if you say that something is in your mind, you mean that you are thinking about it, and if you say that something is at the back of your mind, you mean that you are aware of it, although you are not thinking about it very much.

foster.quick_def: Foster parents are people who officially take a child into their family for a period of time, without becoming the child's legal parents. The child is referred to as their foster child.

sprang.quick_def: Sprang is the past tense of spring.

mankind.quick_def: Mankind is the same as humankind. Many people dislike this use.

manifold.quick_def: Things that are manifold are of many different kinds.  [literary]

inventions.quick_def: An invention is a machine, device, or system that has been invented by someone.

sliced.quick_def: A slice of bread, meat, fruit, or other food is a thin piece that has been cut from a larger piece.

pale.quick_def: If something is pale, it is very light in colour or almost white.

originates.quick_def: When something originates or when someone originates it, it begins to happen or exist.  [formal]

embarked.quick_def: If you embark on something new, difficult, or exciting, you start doing it.

ascent.quick_def: An ascent is an upward journey, especially when you are walking or climbing.

unparalleled.quick_def: If you describe something as unparalleled, you are emphasizing that it is, for example, bigger, better, or worse than anything else of its kind, or anything that has happened before.  [emphasis]

foremost.quick_def: The foremost thing or person in a group is the most important or best.

sophistication.quick_def: The sophistication of machines or methods is their quality of being more advanced or complex than others.

marvellous.quick_def: If you describe someone or something as marvellous, you are emphasizing that they are very good.

composing.quick_def: The things that something is composed of are its parts or members. The separate things that compose something are the parts or members that form it.

twenty-five.quick_def: Twenty-five is a number that comes after twenty-four and before twenty-six.

infinite.quick_def: If you describe something as infinite, you are emphasizing that it is extremely great in amount or degree.  [emphasis]

expressions.quick_def: The expression of ideas or feelings is the showing of them through words, actions, or artistic activities.

whilst.quick_def: Whilst means the same as the conjunction while1.  [mainly British, formal, or literary]

likeness.quick_def: If two things or people have a likeness to each other, they are similar to each other.

disclose.quick_def: If you disclose new or secret information, you tell people about it.

penetrate.quick_def: If something or someone penetrates a physical object or an area, they succeed in getting into it or passing through it.

stirrings.quick_def: A stirring event, performance, or account of something makes people very excited or enthusiastic.

soul.quick_def: Your soul is the part of you that consists of your mind, character, thoughts, and feelings. Many people believe that your soul continues existing after your body is dead.

grammarians.quick_def: A grammarian is someone who studies the grammar of a language and writes books about it or teaches it.

port-royal.quick_def: Port-Royal is the name of a place, like a town, an abbey or other location.

abbey.quick_def: An abbey is a church with buildings attached to it in which monks or nuns live or used to live.

versailles.quick_def: Versailles is a famous place in France. It has a very big and beautiful palace.

distilled.quick_def: If a liquid such as whisky or water is distilled, it is heated until it changes into steam or vapour and then cooled until it becomes liquid again. This is usually done in order to make it pure.

eloquently.quick_def: Speech or writing that is eloquent is well expressed and effective in persuading people.

magnitude.quick_def: If you talk about the magnitude of something, you are talking about its great size, scale, or importance.

hymns.quick_def: A hymn is a religious song that Christians sing in church.

praise.quick_def: If you praise someone or something, you express approval for their achievements or qualities.

homage.quick_def: Homage is respect shown towards someone or something you admire, or to a person in authority.

conceals.quick_def: If you conceal something, you cover it or hide it carefully.

incongruity.quick_def: The incongruity of something is its strangeness when considered together with other aspects of a situation.  [formal]

greatest.quick_def: You use great to describe something that is very large. Great is more formal than big.

invented.quick_def: If you invent something such as a machine or process, you are the first person to think of it or make it.

apparent.quick_def: An apparent situation, quality, or feeling seems to exist, although you cannot be certain that it does exist.

paradox.quick_def: You describe a situation as a paradox when it involves two or more facts or qualities which seem to contradict each other.

fascination.quick_def: Fascination is the state of being greatly interested in or delighted by something.

holds.quick_def: When you hold something, you carry or support it, using your hands or your arms.

secrets.quick_def: If something is secret, it is known about by only a small number of people, and is not told or shown to anyone else.

skillfully.quick_def: If you do something skillfully, you do it very well because you have a lot of skills.

drafted.quick_def: A draft is an early version of a letter, email, book, or speech.

perfected.quick_def: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

handiwork.quick_def: You can refer to something that you have done or made yourself as your handiwork.

craftsman.quick_def: A craftsman is a man who makes things skilfully with his hands.

instrument.quick_def: An instrument is a tool or device that is used to do a particular task, especially a scientific task.

barely.quick_def: You use barely to say that something is only just true or only just the case.

dozen.quick_def: If you have a dozen things, you have twelve of them.

measly.quick_def: If you describe an amount, quantity, or size as measly, you are critical of it because it is very small or inadequate.  [informal, disapproval]

morsels.quick_def: A morsel is a very small amount of something, especially a very small piece of food.

configurations.quick_def: A configuration is an arrangement of a group of things.  [formal]

mouth.quick_def: Your mouth is the area of your face where your lips are or the space behind your lips where your teeth and tongue are.

p.quick_def: P is the sixteenth letter of the English alphabet.

f.quick_def: F is the sixth letter of the English alphabet.

k.quick_def: K is the eleventh letter of the English alphabet.

sh.quick_def: You can say 'Sh!' to tell someone to be quiet.  [informal, spoken]

spits.quick_def: Spit is the watery liquid produced in your mouth. You usually use spit to refer to an amount of it that has been forced out of someone's mouth.

splutters.quick_def: If someone splutters, they make short sounds and have difficulty speaking clearly, for example because they are embarrassed or angry.

arrange.quick_def: If you arrange an event or meeting, you make plans for it to happen.

orders.quick_def: If you do something in order to achieve a particular thing or in order that something can happen, you do it because you want to achieve that thing.

meaningless.quick_def: If something that someone says or writes is meaningless, it has no meaning, or appears to have no meaning.

streams.quick_def: A stream is a small narrow river.

sighing.quick_def: When you sigh, you let out a deep breath, as a way of expressing feelings such as disappointment, tiredness, or pleasure.

interminable.quick_def: If you describe something as interminable, you are emphasizing that it continues for a very long time and indicating that you wish it was shorter or would stop.  [emphasis]

boredom.quick_def: Boredom is the state of being bored.

unravelling.quick_def: If something such as a plan or system unravels, it breaks up or begins to fail.

genius.quick_def: Genius is very great ability or skill in a particular subject or activity.

motion.quick_def: Motion is the activity or process of continually changing position or moving from one place to another.

everybody.quick_def: Everybody means the same as everyone.

pre-modern.quick_def: Pre-modern means before the modern time. It refers to a period that was earlier than the modern era.

foragers.quick_def: Foragers are people or animals that go out to look for food.

subtropical.quick_def: Subtropical places have a climate that is warm and wet, and are often near tropical regions.

savannah.quick_def: A savannah is a large area of flat, grassy land, usually in Africa.

post-modern.quick_def: Post-modern means related to a style or idea that comes after the modern period, often showing a mix of different styles and a bit of not following the old rules.

philosophers.quick_def: A philosopher is a person who studies or writes about philosophy.

suburban.quick_def: Suburban means relating to a suburb.

sprawl.quick_def: If you sprawl somewhere, you sit or lie down with your legs and arms spread out in a careless way.

apparently.quick_def: You use apparently to indicate that the information you are giving is something that you have heard, but you are not certain that it is true.  [vagueness]

slightest.quick_def: Something that is slight is very small in degree or quantity.

exertion.quick_def: If someone or something exerts influence, authority, or pressure, they use it in a strong or determined way, especially in order to produce a particular effect.  [formal]

deceptive.quick_def: If something is deceptive, it encourages you to believe something which is not true.

ease.quick_def: If you do something with ease, you do it easily, without difficulty or effort.

victim.quick_def: A victim is someone who has been hurt or killed.

triumphs.quick_def: A triumph is a great success or achievement, often one that has been gained with a lot of skill or effort.

smoothly.quick_def: A smooth surface has no roughness, lumps, or holes.

bothers.quick_def: If you do not bother to do something or if you do not bother with it, you do not do it, consider it, or use it because you think it is unnecessary or because you are too lazy.

resourcefulness.quick_def: Someone who is resourceful is good at finding ways of dealing with problems.

tick.quick_def: A tick is a written mark like a V: ✓. It is used to show that something is correct or has been selected or dealt with.  [mainly British]

estrangement.quick_def: Estrangement is the state of being estranged from someone or the length of time for which you are estranged.  [formal]

tongues.quick_def: Your tongue is the soft movable part inside your mouth which you use for tasting, eating, and speaking.

outlandish.quick_def: If you describe something as outlandish, you disapprove of it because you think it is very unusual, strange, or unreasonable.  [disapproval]

brings.quick_def: If you bring someone or something with you when you come to a place, they come with you or you have them with you.

showiest.quick_def: Something that is showy is very noticeable because it is large, colourful, or bright.

stunts.quick_def: A stunt is something interesting that is done in order to attract attention and get publicity for the person or company responsible for it.

languages.quick_def: A language is a system of communication which consists of a set of sounds and written symbols which are used by the people of a particular country or region for talking or writing.

breath-breaking.quick_def: If something is breath-breaking, it is so long or intense that it makes you out of breath or very surprised.

sentence.quick_def: A sentence is a group of words which, when they are written down, begin with a capital letter and end with a full stop, question mark, or exclamation mark. Most sentences contain a subject and a verb.

turkish.quick_def: Turkish means belonging or relating to Turkey, or to its people, language, or culture.

town-dweller.quick_def: A town-dweller is a person who lives in a town.

wondering.quick_def: If you wonder about something, you think about it, either because it interests you and you want to know more about it, or because you are worried or suspicious about it.

monstrosity.quick_def: If you describe something, especially something large, as a monstrosity, you mean that you think it is extremely ugly.  [disapproval]

squashed.quick_def: If someone or something is squashed, they are pressed or crushed with such force that they become injured or lose their shape.

components.quick_def: The components of something are the parts that it is made of.

stand.quick_def: When you are standing, your body is upright, your legs are straight, and your weight is supported by your feet.

one-off.quick_def: A one-off thing is something that happens or is made only once and not repeated.

freak.quick_def: A freak event or action is one that is a very unusual or extreme example of its type.

sumerian.quick_def: Sumerian refers to the people, language, or things related to an ancient civilization in Mesopotamia.

banks.quick_def: A bank is an institution where people or businesses can keep their money.

euphrates.quick_def: The Euphrates is a very long river in Western Asia.

enabled.quick_def: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity to do it.

documentation.quick_def: Documentation consists of documents which provide proof or evidence of something, or are a record of something.

munintuma.quick_def: There is not enough information to give a clear definition. It seems to be a Sumerian word, but without more context, we can't say exactly what it means.

trim.quick_def: Something that is trim is neat, tidy, and attractive.

colossus.quick_def: If you describe someone or something as a colossus, you think that they are extremely important and great in ability or size.  [journalism, emphasis]

lengthiness.quick_def: Lengthiness means the quality of being very long.

thrifty.quick_def: If you say that someone is thrifty, you are praising them for saving money, not buying unnecessary things, and not wasting things.  [approval]

compactness.quick_def: Compact things are small or take up very little space. You use this word when you think this is a good quality.  [approval]

slots.quick_def: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

corresponding.quick_def: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them. You can also say that two things correspond.

portion.quick_def: A portion of something is a part of it.

sleek.quick_def: Sleek hair or fur is smooth and shiny and looks healthy.

enlisted.quick_def: If someone enlists or is enlisted, they join the army, navy, marines, or air force.

corresponds.quick_def: If one thing corresponds to another, there is a close similarity or connection between them. You can also say that two things correspond.

pronoun.quick_def: A pronoun is a word that you use to refer to someone or something when you do not need to use a noun, often because the person or thing has been mentioned earlier. Examples are 'it', 'she', 'something', and 'myself'.

translation.quick_def: If something that someone has said or written is translated from one language into another, it is said or written again in the second language.

slot.quick_def: A slot is a narrow opening in a machine or container, for example a hole that you put coins in to make a machine work.

fine-tuned.quick_def: When something is fine-tuned, it is adjusted carefully to make it work better or more accurately.

non-sound.quick_def: Non-sound means something that has no sound.

placed.quick_def: A place is any point, building, area, town, or country.

possibly.quick_def: You use possibly to indicate that you are not sure whether something is true or might happen.  [vagueness]

nifty.quick_def: If you describe something as nifty, you think it is neat and pleasing or cleverly done.  [informal, approval]

contraption.quick_def: You can refer to a device or machine as a contraption, especially when it looks strange or you do not know what it is used for.

cork.quick_def: Cork is a soft, light substance which forms the bark of a type of Mediterranean tree.

thick.quick_def: Something that is thick has a large distance between its two opposite sides.

bark.quick_def: When a dog barks, it makes a short, loud noise, once or several times.

oak.quick_def: An oak or an oak tree is a large tree that often grows in woods and forests and has strong, hard wood.

quercus.quick_def: Quercus is a name for a group of trees that includes oaks.

suber.quick_def: Suber is the name of a kind of oak tree. Its bark can be made into cork.

tough.quick_def: A tough person is strong and determined, and can tolerate difficulty or suffering.

elastic.quick_def: Elastic is a rubber material that stretches when you pull it and returns to its original size and shape when you let it go. Elastic is often used in clothes to make them fit tightly, for example round the waist.

buoyant.quick_def: If you are in a buoyant mood, you feel cheerful and behave in a lively way.

fire-resistant.quick_def: If something is fire-resistant, it can resist fire and is not easily burned.

sarcophagi.quick_def: A sarcophagus is a large decorative container in which a dead body was placed in ancient times.

coffins.quick_def: A coffin is a box in which a dead body is buried or cremated.

sandals.quick_def: Sandals are light shoes that you wear in warm weather, which have straps instead of a solid part over the top of your foot.

cm.quick_def: cm is the written abbreviation for centimetre or , centimetres.

thickness.quick_def: Something that is thick has a large distance between its two opposite sides.

insulating.quick_def: If a person or group is insulated from the rest of society or from outside influences, they are protected from them.

coat.quick_def: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

wrapped.quick_def: When you wrap something, you fold paper or cloth tightly round it to cover it completely, for example in order to protect it or so that you can give it to someone as a present.

trunk.quick_def: The trunk of a tree is the large main stem from which the branches grow.

cellular.quick_def: Cellular means relating to the cells of animals or plants.

cubic.quick_def: Cubic is used in front of units of length to form units of volume such as 'cubic metre' and 'cubic foot'.

centimetre.quick_def: A centimetre is a unit of length in the metric system equal to ten millimetres or one-hundredth of a metre.

replicating.quick_def: If you replicate someone's experiment, work, or research, you do it yourself in exactly the same way.  [formal]

elasticity.quick_def: The elasticity of a material or substance is its ability to return to its original shape, size, and condition after it has been stretched.

squash.quick_def: If someone or something is squashed, they are pressed or crushed with such force that they become injured or lose their shape.

watch.quick_def: If you watch someone or something, you look at them, usually for a period of time, and pay attention to what is happening.

release.quick_def: If a person or animal is released from somewhere where they have been locked up or looked after, they are set free or allowed to go.

oaks.quick_def: An oak or an oak tree is a large tree that often grows in woods and forests and has strong, hard wood.

morocco.quick_def: fine soft leather made from the skin of a goat, used especially for making shoes and covering books

warm.quick_def: Something that is warm has some heat but not enough to be hot.

minimum.quick_def: You use minimum to describe an amount which is the smallest that is possible, allowed, or required.

millimetres.quick_def: A millimetre is a metric unit of length that is equal to a tenth of a centimetre or a thousandth of a metre.

rain.quick_def: Rain is water that falls from the clouds in small drops.

grape.quick_def: Grapes are small green or dark purple fruit which grow in bunches. Grapes can be eaten raw, used for making wine, or dried.

vines.quick_def: A vine is a plant that grows up or over things, especially one which produces grapes.

roots.quick_def: The roots of a plant are the parts of it that grow under the ground.

moisture.quick_def: Moisture is tiny drops of water in the air, on a surface, or in the ground.

nutrients.quick_def: Nutrients are substances that help plants and animals to grow.

alentejo.quick_def: Alentejo is a place in southern Portugal.

meets.quick_def: If you meet someone, you happen to be in the same place as them and start talking to them. You may know the other person, but be surprised to see them, or you may not know them at all.

requirements.quick_def: A requirement is a quality or qualification that you must have in order to be allowed to do something or to be suitable for something.

family-owned.quick_def: If a thing is family-owned, it is owned by a family.

exercise.quick_def: If you exercise something such as your authority, your rights, or a good quality, you use it or put it into effect.  [formal]

patience.quick_def: If you have patience, you are able to stay calm and not get annoyed, for example when something takes a long time, or when someone is not doing what you want them to do.

sapling.quick_def: A sapling is a young tree.

harvest.quick_def: The harvest is the gathering of a crop.

harvests.quick_def: The harvest is the gathering of a crop.

top-quality.quick_def: If something is top-quality, it is of the best kind.

damp.quick_def: Something that is damp is slightly wet.

damaged.quick_def: To damage an object means to break it, spoil it physically, or stop it from working properly.

profession.quick_def: A profession is a type of job that requires advanced education or training.

stripping.quick_def: A strip of something such as paper, cloth, or food is a long, narrow piece of it.

sharp.quick_def: A sharp point or edge is very thin and can cut through things very easily. A sharp knife, tool, or other object has a point or edge of this kind.

axes.quick_def: An ax is a tool used for cutting wood. It consists of a heavy metal blade that is sharp at one edge and attached by its other edge to the end of a long handle.

lever.quick_def: A lever is a handle or bar that is attached to a piece of machinery and which you push or pull in order to operate the machinery.
