producers.quick_def: A producer is a person whose job is to produce plays, films, programmes, or CDs.

warned.quick_def: If you warn someone about something such as a possible danger or problem, you tell them about it so that they are aware of it.

adoption.quick_def: If you adopt a new attitude, plan, or way of behaving, you begin to have it.

high-input.quick_def: High-input means using a large amount of resources, like money, time, or materials, to do something.

excessively.quick_def: If you describe the amount or level of something as excessive, you disapprove of it because it is more or higher than is necessary or reasonable.  [disapproval]

financialised.quick_def: When something is financialised, it is changed to be related to finance or used in financial activities.

transparency.quick_def: A transparency is a small piece of photographic film with a frame around it which can be projected onto a screen so that you can see the picture.

adequate.quick_def: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

contended.quick_def: If you have to contend with a problem or difficulty, you have to deal with it or overcome it.

agribusiness.quick_def: Agribusiness is the various businesses that produce, sell, and distribute farm products, especially on a large scale.  [business]

paying.quick_def: When you pay an amount of money to someone, you give it to them because you are buying something from them or because you owe it to them. When you pay something such as a bill or a debt, you pay the amount that you owe.

frequency.quick_def: The frequency of an event is the number of times it happens during a particular period.

unpredictability.quick_def: the quality something has when it is impossible to know in advance that it will happen or what it will be like

varieties.quick_def: If something has variety, it consists of things which are different from each other.

resilient.quick_def: Something that is resilient is strong and not easily damaged by being hit, stretched, or squeezed.

pat.quick_def: If you pat something or someone, you tap them lightly, usually with your hand held flat.

mooney.quick_def: Mooney is a surname. A surname is the family name passed down from parents to children.

co-founder.quick_def: A co-founder is a person who starts a company, organization or project together with other people.

diversify.quick_def: When an organization or person diversifies into other things, or diversifies their range of something, they increase the variety of things that they do or make.

breeds.quick_def: A breed of a pet animal or farm animal is a particular type of it. For example, terriers are a breed of dog.

menus.quick_def: In a restaurant or café, or at a formal meal, the menu is a list of the food and drinks that are available.

authors.quick_def: The author of a piece of writing is the person who wrote it.

community-based.quick_def: If something is community-based, it is centered around or based on a particular community.

autonomous.quick_def: An autonomous country, organization, or group governs or controls itself rather than being controlled by anyone else.

co-operatives.quick_def: Co-operatives are groups where people work together and share things to achieve common goals.

synchronise.quick_def: If you synchronize two activities, processes, or movements, or if you synchronize one activity, process, or movement with another, you cause them to happen at the same time and speed as each other.

bargaining.quick_def: Something that is a bargain is good value for money, usually because it has been sold at a lower price than normal.

commentator.quick_def: A commentator is a broadcaster who gives a radio or television commentary on an event.

giel.quick_def: Giel is a name used to call a person.

ton.quick_def: A ton is a unit of weight that is equal to 2240 pounds in Britain and to 2000 pounds in the United States.

organise.quick_def: If you organize an event or activity, you make sure that the necessary arrangements are made.

marcel.quick_def: Marcel is a name for a person.

vernooij.quick_def: Vernooij is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a particular family.

beukeboom.quick_def: Beukeboom is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a particular family.

stakeholders.quick_def: Stakeholders are people who have an interest in a company's or organization's affairs.  [business]

worsened.quick_def: If a bad situation worsens or if something worsens it, it becomes more difficult, unpleasant, or unacceptable.

intermediary.quick_def: An intermediary is a person who passes messages or proposals between two people or groups.

purchasers.quick_def: When you purchase something, you buy it.  [formal]

dictate.quick_def: If you dictate something, you say or read it aloud for someone else to write down.

minimise.quick_def: If you minimize a risk, problem, or unpleasant situation, you reduce it to the lowest possible level, or prevent it increasing beyond that level.

sonali.quick_def: Sonali is a name for a person, usually a girl's name.

bisht.quick_def: Bisht is a surname. A surname is the family name that a person shares with other family members.

himalayan.quick_def: Himalayan means related to the Himalayas, which are a very big and high mountain range.

inhere.quick_def: INHERE is an abbreviation, which may refer to a specific organization. It's like a short name for a group.

community-supported.quick_def: If something is community-supported, it is supported by the people in a community.

invest.quick_def: If you invest in something, or if you invest a sum of money, you use your money in a way that you hope will increase its value, for example by paying it into a bank, or buying shares or property.

subscription.quick_def: A subscription is an amount of money that you pay regularly in order to belong to an organization, to help a charity or campaign, or to receive copies of a magazine or newspaper.

fair.quick_def: Something or someone that is fair is reasonable, right, and just.

risk-sharing.quick_def: Risk-sharing means that two or more people or groups share the risks together. They all take part in dealing with possible bad things that might happen.

hiram.quick_def: Hiram is a name for a person.

bingham.quick_def: Bingham is a name of a person.

exploration.quick_def: the act of travelling through a place in order to find out about it or look for something in it

hinterland.quick_def: The hinterland of a stretch of coast or a large river is the area of land behind it or around it.

cusco.quick_def: Cusco is a place. It was the old capital of the Inca empire in the Andes mountains of Peru.

inca.quick_def: The Inca refers to a group of people who lived in the Andes mountains of Peru and built a big and powerful empire in the past.

andes.quick_def: The Andes is a very long and big mountain range in South America.

vitcos.quick_def: Vitcos is the name of a city, which was the last capital of the Inca civilisation.

plateau.quick_def: A plateau is a large area of high and fairly flat land.

elevation.quick_def: When someone or something achieves a more important rank or status, you can say that they are elevated to it.  [formal]

urubamba.quick_def: Urubamba is the name of a place, like a river or an area. It's used to tell people which specific place we are talking about.

circuitous.quick_def: A circuitous route is long and complicated rather than simple and direct.  [formal]

amazon.quick_def: In Greek mythology, the Amazons were a tribe of women who were very good at fighting.

canyons.quick_def: A canyon is a long, narrow valley with very steep sides.

ranges.quick_def: A range of things is a number of different things of the same general kind.

preceded.quick_def: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.  [formal]

blasted.quick_def: A blast is a big explosion, especially one caused by a bomb.

rubber.quick_def: Rubber is a strong, waterproof, elastic substance made from the juice of a tropical tree or produced chemically. It is used for making tyres, boots, and other products.

mules.quick_def: A mule is an animal whose parents are a horse and a donkey.

jungle.quick_def: A jungle is a forest in a tropical country where large numbers of tall trees and plants grow very close together.

ollantaytambo.quick_def: Ollantaytambo is a place name, a specific location like a town or a village.

rejoin.quick_def: If you rejoin a group, club, or organization, you become a member of it again after not being a member for a period of time.

corner.quick_def: A corner is a point or an area where two or more edges, sides, or surfaces of something join.

machu.quick_def: Machu is part of the name of a famous place. It is often used with 'Picchu' to refer to an ancient Inca city in Peru.

picchu.quick_def: Picchu is part of the name of a famous place, like Machu Picchu which is an old and well-known site in the mountains.

descent.quick_def: A descent is a movement from a higher to a lower level or position.

trek.quick_def: If you trek somewhere, you go on a journey across difficult country, usually on foot.

companions.quick_def: A companion is someone who you spend time with or who you are travelling with.

showed.quick_def: If something shows that a state of affairs exists, it gives information that proves it or makes it clear to people.

accompanying.quick_def: If you accompany someone, you go somewhere with them.  [formal]

ruins.quick_def: To ruin something means to severely harm, damage, or spoil it.

melchor.quick_def: Melchor is a name for a person.

arteaga.quick_def: Arteaga is a name, usually for a person.

told.quick_def: If you tell someone something, you give them information.

morning.quick_def: The morning is the part of each day between the time that people usually wake up and 12 o'clock noon or lunchtime.

dull.quick_def: If you describe someone or something as dull, you mean they are not interesting or exciting.  [disapproval]

incas.quick_def: The Incas were a group of people who lived in South America a long time ago and had a big and powerful empire.

relates.quick_def: If something relates to a particular subject, it concerns that subject.

expectation.quick_def: Your expectations are your strong hopes or beliefs that something will happen or that you will get something that you want.

climbs.quick_def: If you climb something such as a tree, mountain, or ladder, or climb up it, you move towards the top of it. If you climb down it, you move towards the bottom of it.

describes.quick_def: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

ever-present.quick_def: If something is ever-present, it always exists or is always there.

springs.quick_def: Spring is the season between winter and summer when the weather becomes warmer and plants start to grow again.

prey.quick_def: A creature's prey are the creatures that it hunts and eats in order to live.

mounting.quick_def: If you mount a campaign or event, you organize it and make it take place.

sweeps.quick_def: If you sweep an area of floor or ground, you push dirt or rubbish off it using a brush with a long handle.

mausoleum.quick_def: A mausoleum is a building which contains the grave of a famous person or the graves of a rich family.

monumental.quick_def: You can use monumental to emphasize the size or extent of something.  [emphasis]

staircases.quick_def: A staircase is a set of stairs inside a building.

ceremonial.quick_def: Something that is ceremonial relates to a ceremony or is used in a ceremony.

unbelievable.quick_def: If you say that something is unbelievable, you are emphasizing that it is very good, impressive, intense, or extreme.  [emphasis]

spellbound.quick_def: If you are spellbound by something or someone, you are so fascinated that you cannot think about anything else.

remember.quick_def: If you remember people or events from the past, you still have an idea of them in your mind and you are able to think about them.

hindsight.quick_def: Hindsight is the ability to understand and realize something about an event after it has happened, although you did not understand or realize it at the time.

journal.quick_def: A journal is a magazine, especially one that deals with a specialized subject.

entries.quick_def: If you gain entry to a particular place, you are able to go in.

dimensions.quick_def: A particular dimension of something is a particular aspect of it.

rejoined.quick_def: If you rejoin a group, club, or organization, you become a member of it again after not being a member for a period of time.

soon.quick_def: If something is going to happen soon, it will happen after a short time. If something happened soon after a particular time or event, it happened a short time after it.

geographic.quick_def: Geographic means related to the features of an area, like its location, land, and climate.

magazine.quick_def: A magazine is a publication with a paper cover which is issued regularly, usually every week or every month, and which contains articles, stories, photographs, and advertisements.

article.quick_def: An article is a piece of writing that is published in a newspaper or magazine.

broke.quick_def: When an object breaks or when you break it, it suddenly separates into two or more pieces, often because it has been hit or dropped.

april.quick_def: April is the fourth month of the year in the Western calendar.

birthplace.quick_def: Your birthplace is the place where you were born.  [written]

manco.quick_def: Manco is a name, usually for a person.

chroniclers.quick_def: To chronicle a series of events means to write about them or show them in broadcasts in the order in which they happened.

vilcabamba.quick_def: Vilcabamba is a place where people can live. It's a settlement.

settlement.quick_def: A settlement is an official agreement between two sides who were involved in a conflict or argument.

fled.quick_def: Fled is the past tense and past participle of flee.

spanish.quick_def: Spanish means belonging or relating to Spain, or to its people, language, or culture.

invaders.quick_def: Invaders are soldiers who are invading a country.

desperate.quick_def: If you are desperate, you are in such a bad situation that you are willing to try anything to change it.

sadly.quick_def: If you are sad, you feel unhappy, usually because something has happened that you do not like.

inaccurate.quick_def: If a statement or measurement is inaccurate, it is not accurate or correct.

depths.quick_def: The depth of something such as a river or hole is the distance downwards from its top surface, or between its upper and lower surfaces.

perplexed.quick_def: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

alike.quick_def: If two or more things are alike, they are similar in some way.

conquest.quick_def: Conquest is the act of conquering a country or group of people.

references.quick_def: Reference to someone or something is the act of talking about them or mentioning them. A reference is a particular example of this.

acceptance.quick_def: Acceptance of an offer or a proposal is the act of saying yes to it or agreeing to it.

moya.quick_def: A moya is a country estate where important people can live and enjoy nice things.

estate.quick_def: An estate is a large area of land in the country which is owned by a person, family, or organization.

winters.quick_def: Winter is the season between autumn and spring when the weather is usually cold.

elite.quick_def: You can refer to the most powerful, rich, or talented people within a particular group, place, or society as the elite.

pachacuti.quick_def: Pachacuti is the name of an important Inca emperor. An emperor is like a very powerful king who rules a big area.

custom.quick_def: A custom is an activity, a way of behaving, or an event which is usual or traditional in a particular society or in particular circumstances.

bilingual.quick_def: Bilingual means involving or using two languages.

multilingual.quick_def: Multilingual means involving several different languages.

disadvantage.quick_def: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

monolingual.quick_def: Monolingual means involving, using, or speaking one language.

peers.quick_def: If you peer at something, you look at it very hard, usually because it is difficult to see clearly.

bilingualism.quick_def: Bilingualism is the ability to speak two languages equally well.

interacts.quick_def: When people interact with each other or interact, they communicate as they work or spend time together.

cognitive.quick_def: Cognitive means relating to the mental process involved in knowing, learning, and understanding things.  [technical, formal]

neurological.quick_def: Neurological means related to the nervous system.  [medicine]

identifying.quick_def: If you can identify someone or something, you are able to recognize them or distinguish them from others.

hear.quick_def: When you hear a sound, you become aware of it through your ears.

arrive.quick_def: When a person or vehicle arrives at a place, they come to it at the end of a journey.

sequential.quick_def: Something that is sequential follows a fixed order.  [formal]

finished.quick_def: When you finish doing or dealing with something, you do or deal with the last part of it, so that there is no more for you to do or deal with.

guess.quick_def: If you guess something, you give an answer or provide an opinion which may not be true because you do not have definite knowledge about the matter concerned.

activate.quick_def: If a device or process is activated, something causes it to start working.

candy.quick_def: Candy is sweet foods such as toffees or chocolate.  [US]

limited.quick_def: A limit is the greatest amount, extent, or degree of something that is possible.

activates.quick_def: If a device or process is activated, something causes it to start working.

co-activation.quick_def: Co-activation means two or more things are activated at the same time.

russian-english.quick_def: Russian-English means related to both the Russian language and the English language.

pick.quick_def: If you pick a particular person or thing, you choose that one.

marka.quick_def: Marka is a Russian word that means 'stamp'.

listener.quick_def: If you listen to someone who is talking or to a sound, you give your attention to them or it.

hears.quick_def: When you hear a sound, you become aware of it through your ears.

map.quick_def: A map is a drawing of a particular area such as a city, a country, or a continent, showing its main features as they would appear if you looked at them from above.

persistent.quick_def: Something that is persistent continues to exist or happen for a long time; used especially about bad or undesirable states or situations.

speakers.quick_def: A speaker at a meeting, conference, or other gathering is a person who is making a speech or giving a talk.

tip-of-the-tongue.quick_def: A tip-of-the-tongue state is when you know a word but can't say it right away.

juggling.quick_def: If you juggle lots of different things, for example your work and your family, you try to give enough time or attention to all of them.

accesses.quick_def: If you have access to a building or other place, you are able or allowed to go into it.

conflict.quick_def: Conflict is serious disagreement and argument about something important. If two people or groups are in conflict, they have had a serious disagreement or argument and have not yet reached agreement.

stroop.quick_def: Stroop is related to a task where there is a conflict between what you see and what you need to respond. It's used to test how your brain processes information.

font.quick_def: In printing, a font is a set of characters of the same style and size.

correctly.quick_def: If something is correct, it is in accordance with the facts and has no mistakes.  [formal]

excel.quick_def: If someone excels in something or excels at it, they are very good at doing it.

tap.quick_def: A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.  [mainly British]

ignore.quick_def: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

competing.quick_def: When one firm or country competes with another, it tries to get people to buy its own goods in preference to those of the other firm or country. You can also say that two firms or countries compete.

focus.quick_def: If you focus on a particular topic or if your attention is focused on it, you concentrate on it and think about it, discuss it, or deal with it, rather than dealing with other topics.

bilinguals.quick_def: Bilinguals are people who can speak two languages well.

switching.quick_def: A switch is a small control for an electrical device which you use to turn the device on or off.

categorizing.quick_def: If you categorize people or things, you divide them into sets or you say which set they belong to.

triangle.quick_def: A triangle is an object, arrangement, or flat shape with three straight sides and three angles.

sensory.quick_def: Sensory means relating to the physical senses.  [formal]

processing.quick_def: A process is a series of actions which are carried out in order to achieve a particular result.

adolescents.quick_def: Adolescent is used to describe young people who are no longer children but who have not yet become adults. It also refers to their behaviour.

listen.quick_def: If you listen to someone who is talking or to a sound, you give your attention to them or it.

intervening.quick_def: If you intervene in a situation, you become involved in it and try to change it.

stem.quick_def: If a condition or problem stems from something, it was caused originally by that thing.

listeners.quick_def: If you listen to someone who is talking or to a sound, you give your attention to them or it.

encoding.quick_def: If you encode a message or some information, you put it into a code or express it in a different form or system of language.

perception.quick_def: Your perception of something is the way that you think about it or the impression you have of it.

focussing.quick_def: When you are focussing, you are giving all your attention to one thing.

interference.quick_def: Interference by a person or group is their unwanted or unnecessary involvement in something.  [disapproval]

mechanisms.quick_def: In a machine or piece of equipment, a mechanism is a part, often consisting of a set of smaller parts, which performs a particular function.

recruiting.quick_def: If you recruit people for an organization, you select them and persuade them to join it or work for it.

alternate.quick_def: When you alternate two things, you keep using one then the other. When one thing alternates with another, the first regularly occurs after the other.

networks.quick_def: A network of lines, roads, veins, or other long thin things is a large number of them which cross each other or meet at many points.

compensate.quick_def: To compensate someone for money or things that they have lost means to pay them money or give them something to replace that money or those things.

aging.quick_def: Someone or something that is ageing is becoming older and less healthy or efficient.

real-world.quick_def: If something is real-world, it exists in the actual world, not in a theoretical or imagined one.

alzheimer.quick_def: Alzheimer refers to a kind of serious illness that affects the brain and makes people gradually lose their memory and the ability to think clearly.

degenerative.quick_def: A degenerative disease or condition is one that gets worse as time progresses.

initial.quick_def: You use initial to describe something that happens at the beginning of a process.

symptoms.quick_def: A symptom of an illness is something wrong with your body or mind that is a sign of the illness.

follow-up.quick_def: A follow-up is an action or activity that is done after an earlier one to check on the results or to continue the process.

abilities.quick_def: Your ability to do something is the fact that you can do it.

seven-month-old.quick_def: If someone or something is seven-month-old, they have existed for seven months.

babies.quick_def: A baby is a very young child, especially one that cannot yet walk or talk.

tinkling.quick_def: If something tinkles, it makes a clear, high-pitched, ringing noise, especially as small parts of it strike a surface.

puppet.quick_def: A puppet is a doll that you can move, either by pulling strings which are attached to it or by putting your hand inside its body and moving your fingers.

halfway.quick_def: Halfway means in the middle of a place or between two points, at an equal distance from each of them.

appearing.quick_def: If you say that something appears to be the way you describe it, you are reporting what you believe or what you have been told, though you cannot be sure it is true.  [vagueness]

navigating.quick_def: When someone navigates a ship or an aircraft somewhere, they decide which course to follow and steer it there. You can also say that a ship or an aircraft navigates somewhere.

imparts.quick_def: If you impart information to people, you tell it to them.  [formal]

spiny.quick_def: A spiny plant or animal is covered with long sharp points.

cacti.quick_def: A cactus is a thick fleshy plant that grows in many hot, dry parts of the world. Cacti have no leaves and many of them are covered in prickles.

uneven.quick_def: An uneven surface or edge is not smooth, flat, or straight.

isabela.quick_def: Isabela is the name of a place, like an island. It's used to call and tell others about this specific place.

lunar.quick_def: Lunar means relating to the moon.

vegetation.quick_def: Plants, trees, and flowers can be referred to as vegetation.  [formal]

skirt.quick_def: A skirt is a piece of clothing that fastens at the waist and hangs down around the legs.

cloud-covered.quick_def: If a place or thing is cloud-covered, it is covered by clouds.

peak.quick_def: The peak of a process or an activity is the point at which it is at its strongest, most successful, or most fully developed.

sierra.quick_def: A sierra is a range of mountains with jagged peaks.  [US]

negra.quick_def: Negra is a proper name, often used for a place or a thing. It can be the name of a mountain, a street, etc.

respite.quick_def: A respite is a short period of rest from something unpleasant.  [formal]

barren.quick_def: A barren landscape is dry and bare, and has very few plants and no trees.

terrain.quick_def: Terrain is used to refer to an area of land or a type of land when you are considering its physical features.

inhospitable.quick_def: An inhospitable place is unpleasant to live in.

tortoise.quick_def: A tortoise is a slow-moving animal with a shell into which it can pull its head and legs for protection.

colonised.quick_def: If people colonize a foreign country, they go to live there and take control of it.

tortoises.quick_def: A tortoise is a slow-moving animal with a shell into which it can pull its head and legs for protection.

mainland.quick_def: You can refer to the largest part of a country or continent as the mainland when contrasting it with the islands around it.

subspecies.quick_def: A subspecies of a plant or animal is one of the types that a particular species is divided into.

longest-living.quick_def: If something is the longest-living, it can live for the longest time compared to others of the same kind.

kilograms.quick_def: A kilogram is a metric unit of weight. One kilogram is a thousand grams, or a thousandth of a metric ton, and is equal to around 2.2 pounds.

exceeding.quick_def: If something exceeds a particular amount or number, it is greater or larger than that amount or number.  [formal]

pirates.quick_def: Pirates are sailors who attack other ships and steal property from them.

board.quick_def: A board is a flat, thin, rectangular piece of wood or plastic which is used for a particular purpose.

whaling.quick_def: Whaling is the activity of hunting and killing whales.

exponentially.quick_def: Exponential means growing or increasing very rapidly.  [formal]

immobile.quick_def: Someone or something that is immobile is completely still.

high-grade.quick_def: If something is high-grade, it is of very good quality.

exacerbated.quick_def: If something exacerbates a problem or bad situation, it makes it worse.  [formal]

hunted.quick_def: If you hunt for something or someone, you try to find them by searching carefully or thoroughly.

destroyed.quick_def: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

habitat.quick_def: The habitat of an animal or plant is the natural environment in which it normally lives or grows.

alien.quick_def: Alien means belonging to a different country, race, or group, usually one you do not like or are frightened of.  [formal, disapproval]

pigs.quick_def: A pig is a pink or black animal with short legs and not much hair on its skin. Pigs are often kept on farms for their meat, which is called pork, ham, bacon, or gammon.

goats.quick_def: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and hairs on their chin which resemble a beard.

dogs.quick_def: A dog is a very common four-legged animal that is often kept by people as a pet or to guard or hunt. There are many different breeds of dog.

ants.quick_def: Ants are small crawling insects that live in large groups.

destroy.quick_def: To destroy something means to cause so much damage to it that it is completely ruined or does not exist any more.

tortoise-breeding.quick_def: Tortoise-breeding is the activity of raising and reproducing tortoises.

puerto.quick_def: Puerto is a Spanish word that often means port or harbor.

villamil.quick_def: Villamil is a name, usually for a place like a town or a village.

protecting.quick_def: To protect someone or something means to prevent them from being harmed or damaged.

captive-breeding.quick_def: Captive-breeding is a way to breed animals in a place where they are kept, not in the wild.

overpopulation.quick_def: If there is a problem of overpopulation in an area, there are more people living there than can be supported properly.

pressing.quick_def: If you press something somewhere, you push it firmly against something else.

captive-bred.quick_def: If an animal is captive-bred, it is born and raised in a place where it is kept, not in the wild.

reintroduced.quick_def: When something is reintroduced, it is brought back to a place or a situation where it was before.

hardened.quick_def: When something hardens or when you harden it, it becomes stiff or firm.

repatriation.quick_def: If a country repatriates someone, it sends them back to their home country.

treacherous.quick_def: If you describe someone as treacherous, you mean that they are likely to betray you and cannot be trusted.  [disapproval]

hikes.quick_def: A hike is a long walk in the country, especially one that you go on for pleasure.

trails.quick_def: A trail is a rough path across open country or through forests.

november.quick_def: November is the eleventh month of the year in the Western calendar.

environmentalist.quick_def: An environmentalist is a person who is concerned with protecting and preserving the natural environment, for example by preventing pollution.

liaison.quick_def: Liaison is co-operation and the exchange of information between different organizations or between different sections of an organization.

officer.quick_def: In the armed forces, an officer is a person in a position of authority.

merlin.quick_def: a small bird of prey (= a bird that kills other creatures for food) of the falcon family

visiting.quick_def: If you visit someone, you go to see them and spend time with them.

motor.quick_def: The motor in a machine, vehicle, or boat is the part that uses electricity or fuel to produce movement, so that the machine, vehicle, or boat can work.

yacht.quick_def: A yacht is a large boat with sails or a motor, used for racing or pleasure trips.

helicopter.quick_def: A helicopter is an aircraft with long blades on top that go round very fast. It is able to stay still in the air and to move straight upwards or downwards.

pilot.quick_def: A pilot is a person who is trained to fly an aircraft.

cafe.quick_def: a place where you can buy drinks and simple meals. Alcohol is not usually served in British or American cafes.

ayora.quick_def: Ayora is a name, usually a place-name. It can refer to a specific location like a town or a port.

cruz.quick_def: Cruz is a proper name, often used as a family name or a given name.

reintroduction.quick_def: the act of bringing something into use or existence again

locations.quick_def: A location is the place where something happens or is situated.

unprecedented.quick_def: If something is unprecedented, it has never happened before.

owners.quick_def: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

cloud.quick_def: A cloud is a mass of water vapour that floats in the sky. Clouds are usually white or grey in colour.

experienced.quick_def: Experience is knowledge or skill in a particular job or activity, which you have gained because you have done that job or activity for a long time.

logistical.quick_def: Logistical means related to the organization and planning of a complicated activity. For example, moving a lot of things from one place to another needs good logistical work.

cargo.quick_def: The cargo of a ship or plane is the goods that it is carrying.

crate.quick_def: A crate is a large box used for transporting or storing things.

maximum.quick_def: You use maximum to describe an amount which is the largest that is possible, allowed, or required.

payload.quick_def: The payload of an aircraft or spacecraft is the amount or weight of things or people that it is carrying.  [technical]

edge.quick_def: The edge of something is the place or line where it stops, or the part of it that is furthest from the middle.

capabilities.quick_def: If you have the capability or the capabilities to do something, you have the ability or the qualities that are necessary to do it.

clock.quick_def: A clock is an instrument, for example in a room or on the outside of a building, that shows what time of day it is.

wardens.quick_def: A warden is a person who is responsible for a particular place or thing, and for making sure that the laws or regulations that relate to it are obeyed.

brush.quick_def: A brush is an object which has a large number of bristles or hairs fixed to it. You use brushes for painting, for cleaning things, and for tidying your hair.

territory.quick_def: Territory is land which is controlled by a particular country or ruler.

surroundings.quick_def: When you are describing the place where you are at the moment, or the place where you live, you can refer to it as your surroundings.

lumbering.quick_def: Lumber consists of trees and large pieces of wood that have been roughly cut up.  [mainly US]

stood.quick_def: When you are standing, your body is upright, your legs are straight, and your weight is supported by your feet.

eradicated.quick_def: To eradicate something means to get rid of it completely.  [formal]

vaccinations.quick_def: If a person or animal is vaccinated, they are given a vaccine, usually by injection, to prevent them from getting a disease.

healthcare.quick_def: the service of providing medical care

globalised.quick_def: When industry globalizes or is globalized, companies from one country link with companies from another country in order to do business with them.  [business]

super-viruses.quick_def: Super-viruses are very strong viruses that are hard to kill or stop.

infections.quick_def: An infection is a disease caused by germs or bacteria.

antibiotics.quick_def: Antibiotics are medical drugs used to kill bacteria and treat infections.

geographical.quick_def: Geographical or geographic means concerned with or relating to geography.

malaria-prone.quick_def: If an area is malaria-prone, it is likely to have malaria because the conditions there are good for the spread of the disease.

tropical.quick_def: Tropical means belonging to or typical of the tropics.

mosquitos.quick_def: Mosquitos are small flying insects which bite people and animals in order to suck their blood.

high-altitude.quick_def: High-altitude means at a very high height above the ground.

amounts.quick_def: The amount of something is how much there is, or how much you have, need, or get.

smog.quick_def: Smog is a mixture of fog and smoke which occurs in some busy industrial cities.

pollution.quick_def: Pollution is the process of polluting water, air, or land, especially with poisonous chemicals.

asthma.quick_def: Asthma is a lung condition which causes difficulty in breathing.

lung.quick_def: Your lungs are the two organs inside your chest which fill with air when you breathe in.

eyesight.quick_def: Your eyesight is your ability to see.

polio.quick_def: Polio is a serious infectious disease which often makes people unable to use their legs.

re-emerging.quick_def: When something is re-emerging, it appears again after disappearing for some time.

cure.quick_def: If doctors or medical treatments cure an illness or injury, they cause it to end or disappear.

analyse.quick_def: If you analyse something, you consider it carefully or use statistical methods in order to fully understand it.

interpret.quick_def: If you interpret something in a particular way, you decide that this is its meaning or significance.

hybrid.quick_def: A hybrid is an animal or plant that has been bred from two different species of animal or plant.  [technical]

geography-based.quick_def: If something is geography-based, it is related to or depends on a particular place or area.

prone.quick_def: To be prone to something, usually something bad, means to have a tendency to be affected by it or to do it.

illness.quick_def: Illness is the fact or experience of being ill.

illnesses.quick_def: Illness is the fact or experience of being ill.

sick.quick_def: If you are sick, you are ill. Sick usually means physically ill, but it can sometimes be used to mean mentally ill.

treat.quick_def: If you treat someone or something in a particular way, you behave towards them or deal with them in that way.

ill.quick_def: Someone who is ill is suffering from a disease or a health problem.

analyses.quick_def: If you analyse something, you consider it carefully or use statistical methods in order to fully understand it.

overlays.quick_def: If something is overlaid with something else, it is covered by it.

correlation.quick_def: A correlation between things is a connection or link between them.  [formal]

geographers.quick_def: A geographer is a person who studies geography or is an expert in it.

epidemiology.quick_def: Epidemiology is a branch of medicine that is concerned with the occurrence, distribution, and control of epidemic diseases.

categorising.quick_def: When you are categorising things, you are putting them into different groups according to their features.

epidemics.quick_def: If there is an epidemic of a particular disease somewhere, it affects a very large number of people there and spreads quickly to other areas.

decrease.quick_def: When something decreases or when you decrease it, it becomes less in quantity, size, or intensity.

re-emergence.quick_def: Re-emergence is when something that was gone or hidden comes back again.

subcategory.quick_def: A subcategory is a smaller group within a larger category.

thereof.quick_def: Thereof is used after a noun to relate that noun to a situation or thing that you have just mentioned.  [formal]

discrepancy.quick_def: If there is a discrepancy between two things that ought to be the same, there is a noticeable difference between them.

brackets.quick_def: If you say that someone or something is in a particular bracket, you mean that they come within a particular range, for example a range of incomes, ages, or prices.

village.quick_def: A village consists of a group of houses, together with other buildings such as a church and a school, in a country area.

hospital.quick_def: A hospital is a place where people who are ill are looked after by nurses and doctors.

frontline.quick_def: The frontline is the most important or active position in a particular activity or situation.

recommendations.quick_def: The recommendations of a person or a committee are their suggestions or advice on what is the best thing to do.

constitutes.quick_def: If something constitutes a particular thing, it can be regarded as being that thing.

devoid.quick_def: If you say that someone or something is devoid of a quality or thing, you are emphasizing that they have none of it.  [formal, emphasis]

explicit.quick_def: Something that is explicit is expressed or shown clearly and openly, without any attempt to hide anything.

touch.quick_def: If you touch something, you put your hand onto it in order to feel it or to make contact with it.

listening.quick_def: If you listen to someone who is talking or to a sound, you give your attention to them or it.

betrays.quick_def: If you betray someone who loves or trusts you, your actions hurt and disappoint them.

arousal.quick_def: Arousal is the state of being sexually excited.

dilate.quick_def: When things such as blood vessels or the pupils of your eyes dilate or when something dilates them, they become wider or bigger.

pulse.quick_def: Your pulse is the regular beating of blood through your body, which you can feel when you touch particular parts of your body, especially your wrist.

conductance.quick_def: the degree to which an object allows electricity or heat to pass through it

cerebellum.quick_def: The cerebellum is a part of the brain in humans and other mammals that controls the body's movements and balance.  [medicine]

bodily.quick_def: Your bodily needs and functions are the needs and functions of your body.

strangely.quick_def: Something that is strange is unusual or unexpected, and makes you feel slightly nervous or afraid.

re-directed.quick_def: When something is re-directed, it is made to go in a different direction.

muscles.quick_def: A muscle is a piece of tissue inside your body which connects two bones and which you use when you make a movement.

stirs.quick_def: If you stir a liquid or other substance, you move it around or mix it in a container using something such as a spoon.

biological.quick_def: Biological is used to describe processes and states that occur in the bodies and cells of living things.

neuroscience.quick_def: the science that deals with the structure and function of the brain and the nervous system

underpinnings.quick_def: If one thing underpins another, it helps the other thing to continue or succeed by supporting and strengthening it.

potent.quick_def: Something that is potent is very effective and powerful.

stimulus.quick_def: A stimulus is something that encourages activity in people or things.

plenty.quick_def: If there is plenty of something, there is a large amount of it. If there are plenty of things, there are many of them. Plenty is used especially to indicate that there is enough of something, or more than you need.

fancy.quick_def: If you fancy something, you want to have it or to do it.  [mainly British, informal]

functional.quick_def: Functional things are useful rather than decorative.

magnetic.quick_def: If something metal is magnetic, it acts like a magnet.

resonance.quick_def: If something has a resonance for someone, it has a special meaning or is particularly important to them.

fmri.quick_def: fMRI is a way to take pictures of the inside of the brain to see how it works.

ligand-based.quick_def: If something is ligand-based, it is based on or related to ligands. Ligands are substances that can bind to other molecules.

positron.quick_def: a particle in an atom which has the same mass as an electron and an equal but positive charge

emission.quick_def: An emission of something such as gas or radiation is the release of it into the atmosphere.  [formal]

tomography.quick_def: a way of producing an image of the inside of the human body or a solid object using X-rays or ultrasound

pet.quick_def: A pet is an animal that you keep in your home to give you company and pleasure.

scanning.quick_def: When you scan written material, you look through it quickly in order to find important or interesting information.

screening.quick_def: A screen is a flat vertical surface on which pictures or words are shown. Television sets and computers have screens, and films are shown on a screen in cinemas.

requesting.quick_def: If you request something, you ask for it politely or formally.  [formal]

chills.quick_def: When you chill something or when it chills, you lower its temperature so that it becomes colder but does not freeze.

pool.quick_def: A pool is the same as a swimming pool.

subjects.quick_def: The subject of something such as a conversation, letter, or book is the thing that is being discussed or written about.

playlist.quick_def: A playlist is a list of songs, albums, and artists that a radio station broadcasts.

genre.quick_def: A genre is a particular type of literature, painting, music, film, or other art form which people consider as a class because it has special characteristics.  [formal]

represented.quick_def: If someone such as a lawyer or a politician represents a person or group of people, they act on behalf of that person or group.

techno.quick_def: Techno is a form of modern electronic music with a very fast beat.

tango.quick_def: The tango is a South American dance in which two people hold each other closely, walk quickly in one direction, then walk quickly back again.

monitored.quick_def: If you monitor something, you regularly check its development or progress, and sometimes comment on it.

methodologies.quick_def: A methodology is a system of methods and principles for doing something, for example for teaching or for carrying out research.  [formal]

impressively.quick_def: Something that is impressive impresses you, for example because it is great in size or degree, or is done with a great deal of skill.

exact.quick_def: Exact means correct in every detail. For example, an exact copy is the same in every detail as the thing it is copied from.

portrait.quick_def: A portrait is a painting, drawing, or photograph of a particular person.

triggers.quick_def: The trigger of a gun is a small lever which you pull to fire it.

dopamine.quick_def: a chemical produced by nerve cells that has an effect on other cells

moods.quick_def: Your mood is the way you are feeling at a particular time. If you are in a good mood, you feel cheerful. If you are in a bad mood, you feel angry and impatient.

nerve.quick_def: Nerves are long thin fibres that transmit messages between your brain and other parts of your body.

ventral.quick_def: on or connected with the part of a fish or an animal that is under its body (or that in humans faces forward)

caudate.quick_def: If something is caudate, it has a tail or a part that looks like a tail.

stimulus-response.quick_def: Stimulus-response is a connection between a thing that causes a reaction (stimulus) and the reaction itself. For example, when you see a ball coming at you (stimulus), you move your hand to catch it (response).

associations.quick_def: An association is an official group of people who have the same job, aim, or interest.

anticipating.quick_def: If you anticipate an event, you realize in advance that it may happen and you are prepared for it.

stimuli.quick_def: A stimulus is something that encourages activity in people or things.

seconds.quick_def: A second is one of the sixty parts that a minute is divided into. People often say 'a second' or 'seconds' when they simply mean a very short time.

moments.quick_def: You can refer to a very short period of time, for example a few seconds, as a moment or moments.

anticipatory.quick_def: An anticipatory feeling or action is one that you have or do because you are expecting something to happen soon.  [formal]

phase.quick_def: A phase is a particular stage in a process or in the gradual development of something.

preceding.quick_def: If one event or period of time precedes another, it happens before it.  [formal]

typically.quick_def: You use typically to say that something usually happens in the way that you are describing.

associate.quick_def: If you associate someone or something with another thing, the two are connected in your mind.

surges.quick_def: A surge is a sudden large increase in something that has previously been steady, or has only increased or developed slowly.

rewards.quick_def: A reward is something that you are given, for example because you have behaved well, worked hard, or provided a service to the community.

cluster.quick_def: A cluster of people or things is a small group of them close together.

unresolved.quick_def: If a problem or difficulty is unresolved, no satisfactory solution has been found to it.  [formal]

outsider.quick_def: An outsider is someone who does not belong to a particular group or organization.

labyrinth.quick_def: If you describe a place as a labyrinth, you mean that it is made up of a complicated series of paths or passages, through which it is difficult to find your way.  [literary]

turns.quick_def: When you turn or when you turn part of your body, you move your body or part of your body so that it is facing in a different or opposite direction.

song.quick_def: A song is words sung to a tune.

unpredictable.quick_def: If you describe someone or something as unpredictable, you mean that you cannot tell what they are going to do or how they are going to behave.

annoyingly.quick_def: Someone or something that is annoying makes you feel fairly angry and impatient.

alarm.quick_def: Alarm is a feeling of fear or anxiety that something unpleasant or dangerous might happen.

demonstrated.quick_def: To demonstrate a fact means to make it clear to people.

predictable.quick_def: If you say that an event is predictable, you mean that it is obvious in advance that it will happen.

composers.quick_def: A composer is a person who writes music, especially classical music.

introduce.quick_def: To introduce something means to cause it to enter a place or exist in a system for the first time.

avoidance.quick_def: Avoidance of someone or something is the act of avoiding them.

repeat.quick_def: If you repeat something, you say or write it again. You can say I repeat to show that you feel strongly about what you are repeating.

denied.quick_def: When you deny something, you state that it is not true.

demonstrate.quick_def: To demonstrate a fact means to make it clear to people.

musicologist.quick_def: a person who studies the history and theory of music

meyer.quick_def: Meyer is a name of a person.

beethoven.quick_def: Beethoven is a very famous composer from the past. He made many great pieces of classical music.

string.quick_def: String is thin rope made of twisted threads, used for tying things together or tying up parcels.

c-sharp.quick_def: C-sharp is a musical note that is a half step higher than the note C.

minor.quick_def: You use minor when you want to describe something that is less important, serious, or significant than other things in a group or situation.

op.quick_def: An op is a medical operation.  [mainly British, informal]

flirtation.quick_def: If you flirt with someone, you behave as if you are sexually attracted to them, in a playful or not very serious way.

submission.quick_def: Submission is a state in which people can no longer do what they want to do because they have been brought under the control of someone else.

dissected.quick_def: If someone dissects the body of a dead person or animal, they carefully cut it up in order to examine it scientifically.

statement.quick_def: A statement is something that you say or write which gives information in a formal or definite way.

rhythmic.quick_def: A rhythmic movement or sound is repeated at regular intervals, forming a regular pattern or beat.

harmonic.quick_def: Harmonic means composed, played, or sung using two or more notes which sound right and pleasing together.

tonal.quick_def: Tonal means relating to the qualities or pitch of a sound or to the tonality of a piece of music.

dance.quick_def: When you dance, you move your body and feet in a way which follows a rhythm, usually in time to music.

repeating.quick_def: If you repeat something, you say or write it again. You can say I repeat to show that you feel strongly about what you are repeating.

variations.quick_def: A variation on something is the same thing presented in a slightly different form.

beg.quick_def: If you beg someone to do something, you ask them very anxiously or eagerly to do it.

chord.quick_def: A chord is a number of musical notes played or sung at the same time with a pleasing effect.

refuses.quick_def: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

suspenseful.quick_def: A suspenseful story makes you feel excited or anxious about what is going to happen in the story next.

tension.quick_def: Tension is the feeling that is produced in a situation when people are anxious and do not trust each other, and when there is a possibility of sudden violence or conflict.

arising.quick_def: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

unfulfilled.quick_def: If you use unfulfilled to describe something such as a promise, ambition, or need, you mean that what was promised, hoped for, or needed has not happened.

feeling.quick_def: If you feel a particular emotion or physical sensation, you experience it.

connotative.quick_def: If a word or thing is connotative, it has an additional meaning or feeling that it makes you think of.

unfolding.quick_def: If a situation unfolds, it develops and becomes known or understood.

embodied.quick_def: To embody an idea or quality means to be a symbol or expression of that idea or quality.

arises.quick_def: If a situation or problem arises, it begins to exist or people start to become aware of it.

ignores.quick_def: If you ignore someone or something, you pay no attention to them.

struggle.quick_def: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though other people or things may be making it difficult for you to succeed.

expectantly.quick_def: If someone is expectant, they are excited because they think something interesting is about to happen.

completed.quick_def: You use complete to emphasize that something is as great in extent, degree, or amount as it possibly can be.  [emphasis]

obsidian.quick_def: a type of dark rock that looks like glass and comes from volcanoes

eruption.quick_def: When a volcano erupts, it throws out a lot of hot, melted rock called lava, as well as ash and steam.

tips.quick_def: The tip of something long and narrow is the end of it.

spears.quick_def: A spear is a weapon consisting of a long pole with a sharp metal point attached to the end.

man-made.quick_def: If something is man-made, it is made by people, not by nature.

glazes.quick_def: A glaze is a thin layer of liquid which is put on a piece of pottery and becomes hard and shiny when the pottery is heated in a very hot oven.

coating.quick_def: A coat is a piece of clothing with long sleeves which you wear over your other clothes when you go outside.

container.quick_def: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

covering.quick_def: A covering is a layer of something that protects or hides something else.

containers.quick_def: A container is something such as a box or bottle that is used to hold or store things in.

coloured.quick_def: The colour of something is the appearance that it has as a result of the way in which it reflects light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

impurities.quick_def: Impurities are substances that are present in small quantities in another substance and make it dirty or of an unacceptable quality.

colourless.quick_def: Something that is colourless has no colour at all.

tinted.quick_def: A tint is a small amount of colour.

colouring.quick_def: The colour of something is the appearance that it has as a result of the way in which it reflects light. Red, blue, and green are colours.

glass-making.quick_def: Glass-making is the activity of making glass.

venetians.quick_def: Venetians are people who come from Venice, a city in Italy.

bottles.quick_def: A bottle is a glass or plastic container in which drinks and other liquids are kept. Bottles are usually round with straight sides and a narrow top.

craftsmen.quick_def: A craftsman is a man who makes things skilfully with his hands.

glassworks.quick_def: A glassworks is a factory where glass is made.

milestone.quick_def: A milestone is an important event in the history or development of something or someone.

manufacturer.quick_def: A manufacturer is a business or company which makes goods in large quantities to sell.  [business]

ravenscroft.quick_def: Ravenscroft is a name, often used as a person's last name.

attempted.quick_def: If you attempt to do something, especially something difficult, you try to do it.

counter.quick_def: In a place such as a shop or café, a counter is a long narrow table or flat surface at which customers are served.

clouding.quick_def: A cloud is a mass of water vapour that floats in the sky. Clouds are usually white or grey in colour.

introducing.quick_def: To introduce something means to cause it to enter a place or exist in a system for the first time.

softer.quick_def: Something that is soft is pleasant to touch, and not rough or hard.

decorate.quick_def: If you decorate something, you make it more attractive by adding things to it.

refractive.quick_def: causing, caused by or relating to refraction

index.quick_def: An index is a system by which changes in the value of something and the rate at which it changes can be recorded, measured, or interpreted.

brilliance.quick_def: the quality of being extremely impressive, intelligent or skilful

invaluable.quick_def: If you describe something as invaluable, you mean that it is extremely useful.

astronomical.quick_def: If you describe an amount, especially the cost of something as astronomical, you are emphasizing that it is very large indeed.  [emphasis]

telescopes.quick_def: A telescope is a long instrument shaped like a tube. It has lenses inside it that make distant things seem larger and nearer when you look through it.

microscopes.quick_def: A microscope is a scientific instrument which makes very small objects look bigger so that more detail can be seen.

repeal.quick_def: If the government repeals a law, it officially ends it, so that it is no longer valid.

excise.quick_def: Excise is a tax that the government of a country puts on particular goods, such as cigarettes and alcoholic drinks, which are produced for sale in its own country.

melted.quick_def: When a solid substance melts or when you melt it, it changes to a liquid, usually because it has been heated.

glasshouse.quick_def: A glasshouse is a greenhouse, especially a large one which is used for the commercial production of fruit, flowers, or vegetables.  [mainly British]

levied.quick_def: A levy is a sum of money that you have to pay, for example as a tax to the government.

continuously.quick_def: A continuous process or event continues for a period of time without stopping.

paxton.quick_def: Paxton is a name, often used as a person's last name.

palace.quick_def: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

exhibition.quick_def: If someone or something shows a particular quality, feeling, or type of behaviour, you can say that they exhibit it.  [formal]

revolutionary.quick_def: Revolutionary activities, organizations, or people have the aim of causing a political revolution.

manufacturing.quick_def: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory, usually in large quantities.  [business]

advancement.quick_def: Advancement is progress in your job or in your social position.

mouth-blowing.quick_def: Mouth-blowing is a way of making things by blowing air from your mouth.

semi-automatic.quick_def: If something is semi-automatic, it can work partly by itself, but still needs some human help.

factory-owner.quick_def: A factory-owner is a person who owns a factory.

hm.quick_def: HM is the written abbreviation for Her or His Majesty or Her or His Majesty's. It is used as part of the name of some British government organizations, or as part of a person's title.

ashley.quick_def: a first name for boys or girls

castleford.quick_def: Castleford is the name of a place, like a town or a small area.

yorkshire.quick_def: a former county in north-east England. In 1974 it was divided into two new counties, North Yorkshire and Humberside, and two metropolitan counties, West Yorkshire and South Yorkshire.

quicker.quick_def: Someone or something that is quick moves or does things with great speed.

automated.quick_def: To automate a factory, office, or process means to put in machines which can do the work instead of people.

owens.quick_def: Owens is a common surname. A surname is a family name passed down from parents to children.

manufacturers.quick_def: A manufacturer is a business or company which makes goods in large quantities to sell.  [business]

owens-illinois.quick_def: Owens-Illinois is the name of a big company that makes things.

installed.quick_def: If you install a piece of equipment, you fit it or put it somewhere so that it is ready to be used.

factory.quick_def: A factory is a large building where machines are used to make large quantities of goods.

cut.quick_def: If you cut something, you use a knife or a similar tool to divide it into pieces, or to mark it or damage it. If you cut a shape or a hole in something, you make the shape or hole by using a knife or similar tool.

suppliers.quick_def: A supplier is a person, company, or organization that sells or supplies something such as goods or equipment to customers.  [business]

hi-tech.quick_def: Hi-tech means related to high technology, which uses the latest and most advanced scientific knowledge and methods.

operating.quick_def: If you operate a business or organization, you work to keep it running properly. If a business or organization operates, it carries out its work.

fiercely.quick_def: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

brown.quick_def: Something that is brown is the colour of earth or of wood.

whenever.quick_def: You use whenever to refer to any time or every time that something happens or is true.

sit.quick_def: If you are sitting somewhere, for example in a chair, your bottom is resting on the chair and the upper part of your body is upright.

packaging.quick_def: A package is a small parcel.

foodstuffs.quick_def: Foodstuffs are substances which people eat.

medicines.quick_def: Medicine is the treatment of illness and injuries by doctors and nurses.

cosmetics.quick_def: Cosmetics are substances such as lipstick or powder, which people put on their face to make themselves look more attractive.
