superseded.quick_def: If something is superseded by something newer, it is replaced because it has become old-fashioned or unacceptable.

coffee.quick_def: Coffee is a hot drink made with water and ground or powdered coffee beans.

sugar.quick_def: Sugar is a sweet substance that is used to make food and drinks sweet. It is usually in the form of small white or brown crystals.

oxytocin.quick_def: Oxytocin is a kind of chemical in our body that can make us feel good and help with things like love and trust.

hormone.quick_def: A hormone is a chemical, usually occurring naturally in your body, that makes an organ of your body do something.

pituitary.quick_def: a small organ at the base of the brain that produces hormones that influence growth and sexual development

gland.quick_def: A gland is an organ in the body which produces chemical substances for the body to use or get rid of.

bonds.quick_def: A bond between people is a strong feeling of friendship, love, or shared beliefs and experiences that unites them.

prairie.quick_def: A prairie is a large area of flat, grassy land in North America. Prairies have very few trees.

voles.quick_def: A vole is a small animal that looks like a mouse but has very small ears and a short tail. Voles usually live in fields or near rivers.

motherly.quick_def: Motherly feelings or actions are like those of a kind mother.

newborn.quick_def: A newborn baby or animal is one that has just been born.

lambs.quick_def: A lamb is a young sheep.

childbirth.quick_def: Childbirth is the act of giving birth to a child.

strengthening.quick_def: If something strengthens a person or group or if they strengthen their position, they become more powerful and secure, or more likely to succeed.

attachment.quick_def: If you have an attachment to someone or something, you are fond of them or loyal to them.

sniff.quick_def: When you sniff, you breathe in air through your nose hard enough to make a sound, for example when you are trying not to cry, or in order to show disapproval.

trusting.quick_def: If you trust someone, you believe that they are honest and sincere and will not deliberately do anything to harm you.

empathetic.quick_def: Someone who is empathetic has the ability to share another person's feelings or emotions as if they were their own.  [formal]

generous.quick_def: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

cooperative.quick_def: A cooperative is a business or organization run by the people who work for it, or owned by the people who use it. These people share its benefits and profits.  [business]

revise.quick_def: If you revise the way you think about something, you adjust your thoughts, usually in order to make them better or more suited to how things are.

wave.quick_def: If you wave or wave your hand, you move your hand from side to side in the air, usually in order to say hello or goodbye to someone.

groundbreaking.quick_def: You use groundbreaking to describe things which you think are significant because they provide new and positive ideas, and influence the way people think about things.

markus.quick_def: Markus is a name for a person.

heinrichs.quick_def: Heinrichs is a surname. A surname is the family name that a person shares with other members of their family.

freiburg.quick_def: Freiburg is the name of a city. It is a place where people live, work and do many things.

anonymous.quick_def: If you remain anonymous when you do something, you do not let people know that you were the person who did it.

guaranteed.quick_def: If one thing guarantees another, the first is certain to cause the second thing to happen.

honest.quick_def: If you describe someone as honest, you mean that they always tell the truth, and do not try to deceive people or break the law.

sniffed.quick_def: When you sniff, you breathe in air through your nose hard enough to make a sound, for example when you are trying not to cry, or in order to show disapproval.

nasal.quick_def: Nasal is used to describe things relating to the nose and the functions it performs.

spray.quick_def: Spray is a lot of small drops of water which are being thrown into the air.

received.quick_def: When you receive something, you get it after someone gives it to you or sends it to you.

placebo.quick_def: A placebo is a substance with no effects that a doctor gives to a patient instead of a drug. Placebos are used when testing new drugs or sometimes when a patient has imagined their illness.

lonesome.quick_def: Someone who is lonesome is unhappy because they do not have any friends or do not have anyone to talk to.  [mainly US]

recalls.quick_def: When you recall something, you remember it and tell others about it.

charitable.quick_def: A charitable organization or activity helps and supports people who are ill or very poor, or who have a disability.

faces.quick_def: Your face is the front part of your head from your chin to the top of your forehead, where your mouth, eyes, nose, and other features are.

communicating.quick_def: If you communicate with someone, you share or exchange information with them, for example by speaking, writing, or using equipment. You can also say that two people communicate.

constructively.quick_def: A constructive discussion, comment, or approach is useful and helpful rather than negative and unhelpful.

arguments.quick_def: An argument is a statement or set of statements that you use in order to try to convince people that your opinion about something is correct.

universally.quick_def: If something is universally believed or accepted, it is believed or accepted by everyone with no disagreement.

enhanced.quick_def: To enhance something means to improve its value, quality, or attractiveness.

contrasting.quick_def: A contrast is a great difference between two or more things which is clear when you compare them.

simone.quick_def: Simone is a name for a person.

shamay-tsoory.quick_def: Shamay-Tsoory is a surname, which is used to identify a person.

haifa.quick_def: Haifa is a city in Israel.

israel.quick_def: a country in the Middle East

inhaled.quick_def: When you inhale, you breathe in. When you inhale something such as smoke, you take it into your lungs when you breathe in.

beat.quick_def: If you beat someone or something, you hit them very hard.

players.quick_def: A player in a sport or game is a person who takes part, either as a job or for fun.

envy.quick_def: Envy is the feeling you have when you wish you could have the same thing or quality that someone else has.

administering.quick_def: If someone administers something such as a country, the law, or a test, they take responsibility for organizing and supervising it.

disposition.quick_def: Someone's disposition is the way that they tend to behave or feel.

bartz.quick_def: Bartz is a name used to call a person.

sinai.quick_def: Sinai is a place name, usually referring to the Sinai Peninsula which is a piece of land in Egypt.

socially.quick_def: Social means relating to society or to the way society is organized.

cooperation.quick_def: If you cooperate with someone, you work with them or help them for a particular purpose. You can also say that two people cooperate.

anxious.quick_def: If you are anxious to do something or anxious that something should happen, you very much want to do it or very much want it to happen.

rejection.quick_def: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

interacting.quick_def: When people interact with each other or interact, they communicate as they work or spend time together.

conducted.quick_def: When you conduct an activity or task, you organize it and carry it out.

declerck.quick_def: DeClerck is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a particular family.

antwerp.quick_def: Antwerp is a city in Belgium.

dose.quick_def: A dose of medicine or a drug is a measured amount of it which is intended to be taken at one time.

strangers.quick_def: A stranger is someone you have never met before.

carsten.quick_def: Carsten is a name for a person.

de.quick_def: In some names, 'De' is a part of the family name, often with a historical or cultural origin, like in French or Italian names.

dreu.quick_def: Dreu is a surname, which is a family name used to identify a person's family.

amsterdam.quick_def: Amsterdam is the capital city of the Netherlands. It's a place where many people live and visit.

favouritism.quick_def: If you accuse someone of favouritism, you disapprove of them because they unfairly help or favour one person or group much more than another.  [disapproval]

names.quick_def: The name of a person, place, or thing is the word or group of words that is used to identify them.

drives.quick_def: When you drive somewhere, you operate a car or other vehicle and control its movement and direction.

circles.quick_def: A circle is a shape consisting of a curved line completely surrounding an area. Every part of the line is the same distance from the centre of the area.

strengthens.quick_def: If something strengthens a person or group or if they strengthen their position, they become more powerful and secure, or more likely to succeed.

biases.quick_def: Bias is a tendency to prefer one person or thing to another, and to favour that person or thing.

promoting.quick_def: If people promote something, they help or encourage it to happen, increase, or spread.

goodwill.quick_def: Goodwill is a friendly or helpful attitude towards other people, countries, or organizations.

subtleties.quick_def: Subtleties are very small details or differences which are not obvious.

nuanced.quick_def: If something is nuanced, it has small, subtle differences or details.

propelling.quick_def: To propel something in a particular direction means to cause it to move in that direction.

investigations.quick_def: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

pinpointing.quick_def: If you pinpoint the cause of something, you discover or explain the cause exactly.

cataloguing.quick_def: A catalogue is a list of things such as the goods you can buy from a particular company, the objects in a museum, or the books in a library.

hypotheses.quick_def: A hypothesis is an idea which is suggested as a possible explanation for a particular situation or condition, but which has not yet been proved to be correct.  [formal]

mutually.quick_def: You use mutual to describe a situation, feeling, or action that is experienced, felt, or done by both of two people mentioned.

anxiety.quick_def: Anxiety is a feeling of nervousness or worry.

connections.quick_def: A connection is a relationship between two things, people, or groups.

spotlight.quick_def: A spotlight is a powerful light, for example in a theatre, which can be directed so that it lights up a small area.

shines.quick_def: When the sun or a light shines, it gives out bright light.

posture.quick_def: Your posture is the position in which you stand or sit.

flicker.quick_def: If a light or flame flickers, it shines unsteadily.

dip.quick_def: If you dip something in a liquid, you put it into the liquid for a short time, so that only part of it is covered, and take it out again.

attuned.quick_def: If you are attuned to something, you can understand and appreciate it.

overly.quick_def: Overly means more than is normal, necessary, or reasonable.

cues.quick_def: In the theatre or in a musical performance, a performer's cue is something another performer says or does that is a signal for them to begin speaking, playing, or doing something.

worst.quick_def: Something that is bad is unpleasant, harmful, or undesirable.

surprised.quick_def: A surprise is an unexpected event, fact, or piece of news.

perplexing.quick_def: If something perplexes you, it confuses and worries you because you do not understand it or because it causes you difficulty.

octopuses.quick_def: An octopus is a soft sea creature with eight long arms called tentacles which it uses to catch food.

stretch.quick_def: Something that stretches over an area or distance covers or exists in the whole of that area or distance.

co-opted.quick_def: When something is co-opted, it is taken and used for a new purpose.

functions.quick_def: The function of something or someone is the useful thing that they do or are intended to do.

sue.quick_def: If you sue someone, you start a legal case against them, usually in order to claim money from them because they have harmed you in some way.

carter.quick_def: Carter is a name for a person.

illinois.quick_def: a state in the US Midwest, also called the Prairie State. Its largest city is Chicago and its capital city is Springfield. Manufacturing industry is important and the state produces coal, oil and agricultural products. Illinois became a state in 1818 and is associated with Abraham Lincoln, who was a lawyer in Springfield.

chicago.quick_def: the third largest US city. It is in the state of Illinois on Lake Michigan and is sometimes called the 'Windy City'. It had the world's first skyscrapers. Chicago is the centre of the American Middle West and its O'Hare airport is one of the busiest airports in the world. The El train runs around the business district, called the Loop. During Prohibition, Chicago was known for its gangsters (= criminals), especially Al Capone.

agrees.quick_def: If people agree with each other about something, they have the same opinion about it or say that they have the same opinion.

higher-order.quick_def: Higher-order means more complex or advanced than the basic ones.

manifest.quick_def: If you say that something is manifest, you mean that it is clearly true and that nobody would disagree with it if they saw it or considered it.  [formal]

conducting.quick_def: When you conduct an activity or task, you organize it and carry it out.

fail.quick_def: If you fail to do something that you were trying to do, you are unable to do it or do not succeed in doing it.

recognize.quick_def: If you recognize someone or something, you know who that person is or what that thing is.

influencing.quick_def: Influence is the power to make other people agree with your opinions or do what you want.

behaviors.quick_def: People's or animals' behavior is the way that they behave. You can refer to a typical and repeated way of behaving as a behavior.

peripheral.quick_def: A peripheral activity or issue is one which is not very important compared with other activities or issues.

wait-and-see.quick_def: A wait-and-see attitude means you don't act right away. You wait to see what will happen first, and then decide what to do.

competitors.quick_def: A company's competitors are companies who are trying to sell similar goods or services to the same people.

missed.quick_def: If you miss something, you fail to hit it, for example when you have thrown something at it or you have shot a bullet at it.

jeopardize.quick_def: To jeopardize a situation or activity means to do something that may destroy it or cause it to fail.

ceding.quick_def: If someone in a position of authority cedes land or power to someone else, they let them have the land or power, often as a result of military or political pressure.  [formal]

transform.quick_def: To transform something into something else means to change or convert it into that thing.

twofold.quick_def: You can use twofold to introduce a topic that has two equally important parts.  [formal]

spur.quick_def: If one thing spurs you to do another, it encourages you to do it.

expansively.quick_def: If something is expansive, it covers or includes a large area or many things.  [formal]

engender.quick_def: If someone or something engenders a particular feeling, atmosphere, or situation, they cause it to occur.  [formal]

propositions.quick_def: If you describe something such as a task or an activity as, for example, a difficult proposition or an attractive proposition, you mean that it is difficult or pleasant to do.

high-level.quick_def: High-level means something that is important, advanced, or involves people with a lot of power or knowledge.

analyzing.quick_def: When you are analyzing something, you are looking at it carefully to understand it better.

exploiting.quick_def: If you say that someone is exploiting you, you think that they are treating you unfairly by using your work or ideas and giving you very little in return.

infuse.quick_def: To infuse a quality into someone or something, or to infuse them with a quality, means to fill them with it.  [formal]

augment.quick_def: To augment something means to make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.  [formal]

retains.quick_def: To retain something means to continue to have that thing.  [formal]

attributes.quick_def: If you attribute something to an event or situation, you think that it was caused by that event or situation.

category.quick_def: If people or things are divided into categories, they are divided into groups in such a way that the members of each group are similar to each other in some way.

desires.quick_def: A desire is a strong wish to do or have something.

unleashed.quick_def: If you say that someone or something unleashes a powerful force, feeling, activity, or group, you mean that they suddenly start it or send it somewhere.

poppy.quick_def: A poppy is a plant with a large, delicate flower, usually red in colour. The drug opium is obtained from one type of poppy.

handbags.quick_def: A handbag is a small bag which a woman uses to carry things such as her money and keys in when she goes out.

coach.quick_def: A coach is someone who trains a person or team of people in a particular sport.

reaction.quick_def: Your reaction to something that has happened or something that you have experienced is what you feel, say, or do because of it.

risked.quick_def: If there is a risk of something unpleasant, there is a possibility that it will happen.

cheapening.quick_def: If something cheapens a person or thing, it lowers their reputation or position.

consumer-research.quick_def: Consumer-research is the activity of studying what consumers want, like, and need.

lower-priced.quick_def: If something is lower-priced, it costs less money than other similar things.

colors.quick_def: Colors are the different looks of things, like red, blue, yellow. They make things look different and nice.

youthful.quick_def: Someone who is youthful behaves as if they are young or younger than they really are.

playful.quick_def: A playful gesture or person is friendly or humorous.

sub-brand.quick_def: A sub-brand is a smaller brand that belongs to a bigger brand.

avert.quick_def: If you avert something unpleasant, you prevent it from happening.

across-the-board.quick_def: If something is across-the-board, it affects everyone or everything in a group equally.

mindset.quick_def: If you refer to someone's mindset, you mean their general attitudes and the way they typically think about things.

supermarket.quick_def: A supermarket is a large shop which sells all kinds of food and some household goods.

tesco.quick_def: one of Britain's largest chains of supermarkets. It was started by Jack Cohen (1898-1979), a Jewish immigrant who started selling tea in a market in the East End of London just after the First World War. The name Tesco was used first in 1924 on a brand of tea sold by Cohen; it consisted of the first letters of T E Stockwell, who was a partner in a firm that supplied the tea, and the first two letters of Cohen's own name. In 1929 Cohen opened a food shop in London, and by the beginning of the Second World War there were many more Tesco shops in or near London. In the 1970s, Tesco superstores began to appear and there are now thousands of shops across Britain, in or just outside most towns and cities. The largest ones sell not only food but also clothes and household goods, as well as providing other services. In 1997 Tesco started its own bank, and in 2003 it began offering mobile phone services. It also has stores in many countries across the world.

retailers.quick_def: A retailer is a person or business that sells goods to the public.  [business]

greener.quick_def: Green is the colour of grass or leaves.

demonstrates.quick_def: To demonstrate a fact means to make it clear to people.

tangible.quick_def: If something is tangible, it is clear enough or definite enough to be easily seen, felt, or noticed.

reusing.quick_def: When you reuse something, you use it again instead of throwing it away.

cans.quick_def: You use can when you are mentioning a quality or fact about something which people may make use of if they want to.

printer.quick_def: A printer is a machine that can be connected to a computer in order to make copies on paper of documents or other information held by the computer.

cartridges.quick_def: A cartridge is a metal or cardboard tube containing a bullet and an explosive substance. Cartridges are used in guns.

home-insulation.quick_def: Home-insulation is materials used to keep a home warm in winter and cool in summer, and save energy.

earned.quick_def: If you earn money, you receive money in return for work that you do.

purchases.quick_def: When you purchase something, you buy it.  [formal]

redeemed.quick_def: If you redeem yourself or your reputation, you do something that makes people have a good opinion of you again after you have behaved or performed badly.

retail.quick_def: Retail is the activity of selling goods direct to the public, usually in small quantities. Compare wholesale.  [business]

offerings.quick_def: An offering is something that is specially produced to be sold.

augmented.quick_def: To augment something means to make it larger, stronger, or more effective by adding something to it.  [formal]

infusing.quick_def: To infuse a quality into someone or something, or to infuse them with a quality, means to fill them with it.  [formal]

streak.quick_def: A streak is a long stripe or mark on a surface which contrasts with the surface because it is a different colour.

combine.quick_def: If you combine two or more things or if they combine, they exist together.

transcend.quick_def: Something that transcends normal limits or boundaries goes beyond them, because it is more significant than them.

entails.quick_def: If one thing entails another, it involves it or causes it.  [formal]

glance.quick_def: If you glance at something or someone, you look at them very quickly and then look away again immediately.

incorporate.quick_def: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.  [formal]

worthwhile.quick_def: If something is worthwhile, it is enjoyable or useful, and worth the time, money, or effort that is spent on it.

nike.quick_def: Nike is a well-known brand that makes sports shoes, clothes and other sports products.

integrate.quick_def: If someone integrates into a social group, or is integrated into it, they behave in such a way that they become part of the group or are accepted into it.

digital.quick_def: Digital systems record or transmit information in the form of thousands of very small signals.

high-performance.quick_def: If something is high-performance, it can work very well and do things quickly and effectively.

athletic.quick_def: Athletic means relating to athletes and athletics.

footwear.quick_def: Footwear refers to things that people wear on their feet, for example shoes and boots.

teamed.quick_def: A team is a group of people who play a particular sport or game together against other similar groups of people.

apple.quick_def: An apple is a round fruit with smooth green, yellow, or red skin and firm white flesh.

kit.quick_def: A kit is a group of items that are kept together, often in the same container, because they are all used for similar purposes.

comprising.quick_def: If you say that something comprises or is comprised of a number of things or people, you mean it has them as its parts or members.  [formal]

sensor.quick_def: A sensor is an instrument which reacts to certain physical conditions or impressions such as heat or light, and which is used to provide information.

attaches.quick_def: If you attach something to an object, you join it or fasten it to the object.

shoe.quick_def: Shoes are objects which you wear on your feet. They cover most of your foot and you wear them over socks or stockings.

wireless.quick_def: Wireless technology uses radio waves rather than electricity and therefore does not require any wires.

receiver.quick_def: A phone's receiver is the part that you hold near to your ear and speak into.

ipod.quick_def: An iPod is a portable MP3 player that can play music downloaded from the internet.  [trademark, computing]

athletes.quick_def: An athlete is a person who does a sport, especially athletics, or track and field events.

apparel.quick_def: Apparel means clothes, especially formal clothes worn on an important occasion.  [mainly US, formal]

plane.quick_def: A plane is a vehicle with wings and one or more engines, which can fly through the air.

counteract.quick_def: To counteract something means to reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

reaffirm.quick_def: If you reaffirm something, you state it again clearly and firmly.  [formal]

oppose.quick_def: If you oppose someone or oppose their plans or ideas, you disagree with what they want to do and try to prevent them from doing it.

temporarily.quick_def: in a way that lasts or is intended to last or be used only for a short time; in a way that is not permanent

video.quick_def: A video is a film or television programme recorded digitally (or in the past on tape) for people to watch on a television set.

itoys.quick_def: iToys is a name of a company that makes products like video-games.

reaffirming.quick_def: If you reaffirm something, you state it again clearly and firmly.  [formal]

counteracted.quick_def: To counteract something means to reduce its effect by doing something that produces an opposite effect.

gaming.quick_def: Gaming means the same as gambling.

handheld.quick_def: A handheld device such as a camera or a computer is small and light enough to be used while you are holding it.

games.quick_def: A game is an activity or sport usually involving skill, knowledge, or chance, in which you follow fixed rules and try to win against an opponent or to solve a puzzle.

featured.quick_def: A feature of something is an interesting or important part or characteristic of it.

exciting.quick_def: If something excites you, it makes you feel very happy, eager, or enthusiastic.

full-color.quick_def: If something is full-color, it has all the colors instead of just black and white.

lcd.quick_def: An LCD is a display of information on a screen, which uses liquid crystals that become visible when electricity is passed through them. LCD is an abbreviation for 'liquid crystal display'.

graphics.quick_def: If you say that a description or account of something unpleasant is graphic, you are emphasizing that it is clear and detailed.  [emphasis]

incorporated.quick_def: If one thing incorporates another thing, it includes the other thing.  [formal]

pedometer.quick_def: A pedometer is a device that measures the distance that someone has walked.

tracked.quick_def: A track is a narrow road or path.

awarded.quick_def: An award is a prize or certificate that a person is given for doing something well.

biking.quick_def: A bike is a bicycle or a motorcycle.  [informal]

skateboarding.quick_def: Skateboarding is the activity of riding on a skateboard.

stairs.quick_def: Stairs are a set of steps inside a building which go from one floor to another.

catered.quick_def: In British English, to cater for a group of people means to provide all the things that they need or want. In American English, you say you cater to a person or group of people.

kids.quick_def: You can refer to a child as a kid.  [informal]

countering.quick_def: In a place such as a shop or café, a counter is a long narrow table or flat surface at which customers are served.

negatives.quick_def: A fact, situation, or experience that is negative is unpleasant, depressing, or harmful.

obesity.quick_def: If someone is obese, they are extremely fat.

trend-related.quick_def: If something is trend-related, it has a connection with the latest trends.

opinions.quick_def: Your opinion about something is what you think or believe about it.

pursue.quick_def: If you pursue an activity, interest, or plan, you carry it out or follow it.  [formal]

infuse-and-augment.quick_def: To add something to make something else better and increase its value or power.

reinvigorate.quick_def: to give new energy or strength to something/somebody

disparity.quick_def: If there is a disparity between two or more things, there is a noticeable difference between them.  [formal]

worlds.quick_def: The world is the planet that we live on.

clash.quick_def: When people clash, they fight, argue, or disagree with each other.  [journalism]

undesired.quick_def: If something is undesired, it is not wanted by people.

unhealthy.quick_def: Something that is unhealthy is likely to cause illness or poor health.

perceive.quick_def: If you perceive something, you see, notice, or realize it, especially when it is not obvious.

coconut.quick_def: A coconut is a very large nut with a hairy shell, which has white flesh and milky juice inside it.

asian.quick_def: Asian means belonging to or relating to Asia. British people use this term especially to refer to India, Pakistan, and Bangladesh. Americans use this term especially to refer to China, Korea, Thailand, Japan, or Vietnam.

merchant.quick_def: A merchant is a person who buys or sells goods in large quantities, especially one who imports and exports them.

traveller.quick_def: A traveler is a person who is on a trip or a person who travels a lot.

marco.quick_def: Marco is a common male name.

polo.quick_def: Polo is a game played between two teams of players. The players ride horses and use wooden hammers with long handles to hit a ball.

sir.quick_def: People sometimes say sir as a very formal and polite way of addressing a man whose name they do not know or a man of superior rank. For example, a shop assistant might address a male customer as sir.  [politeness]

mandeville.quick_def: Mandeville is a name, usually a person's name.

mention.quick_def: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

ynde.quick_def: Ynde means India. It is an old-fashioned way to say India.

palm-fringed.quick_def: If a place is palm-fringed, there are palm trees around its edge.

beaches.quick_def: A beach is an area of sand or stones beside the sea.

cliches.quick_def: Cliches are ideas or expressions that are used so often that they become boring and not original.

fizzy.quick_def: Fizzy drinks are drinks that contain small bubbles of carbon dioxide. They make a sound like a long 's' when you pour them.  [British]

romance.quick_def: A romance is a relationship between two people who are in love with each other but who are not married to each other.

envisage.quick_def: If you envisage something, you imagine that it is true, real, or likely to happen.

cannonballs.quick_def: A cannonball is a heavy metal ball that is fired from a cannon.

flesh.quick_def: Flesh is the soft part of a person's or animal's body between the bones and the skin.

fruit.quick_def: Fruit or a fruit is something which grows on a tree or bush and which contains seeds or a stone covered by a substance that you can eat.

slender.quick_def: A slender person is attractively thin and graceful.  [written, approval]

replacement.quick_def: If you refer to the replacement of one thing by another, you mean that the second thing takes the place of the first.

hardwoods.quick_def: Hardwood is wood such as oak, teak, and mahogany, which is very strong and hard.

surmounted.quick_def: If you surmount a problem or difficulty, you deal successfully with it.

rosette.quick_def: A rosette is a large circular decoration made from coloured ribbons which is given as a prize in a competition, or, especially in Britain, is worn to show support for a political party or sports team.

veins.quick_def: Your veins are the thin tubes in your body through which your blood flows towards your heart. Compare artery.

brushes.quick_def: A brush is an object which has a large number of bristles or hairs fixed to it. You use brushes for painting, for cleaning things, and for tidying your hair.

immature.quick_def: Something or someone that is immature is not yet completely grown or fully developed.

tightly.quick_def: Tight clothes or shoes are rather small and fit closely to your body.

clustered.quick_def: A cluster of people or things is a small group of them close together.

flower.quick_def: A flower is the part of a plant which is often brightly coloured, grows at the end of a stem, and only survives for a short time.

tapped.quick_def: A tap is a device that controls the flow of a liquid or gas from a pipe or container, for example on a sink.  [mainly British]

sap.quick_def: If something saps your strength or confidence, it gradually weakens or destroys it.

cooking.quick_def: When you cook a meal, you prepare food for eating by heating it.

fruits.quick_def: Fruit or a fruit is something which grows on a tree or bush and which contains seeds or a stone covered by a substance that you can eat.

kilogram.quick_def: A kilogram is a metric unit of weight. One kilogram is a thousand grams, or a thousandth of a metric ton, and is equal to around 2.2 pounds.

fibrous.quick_def: A fibrous object or substance contains a lot of fibres or fibre, or looks as if it does.

produces.quick_def: To produce something means to cause it to happen.

coir.quick_def: Coir is a rough material made from coconut shells which is used to make ropes and mats.

woody.quick_def: Woody plants have very hard stems.

innermost.quick_def: Your innermost thoughts and feelings are your most personal and secret ones.

prominent.quick_def: Someone who is prominent is important.

surrounds.quick_def: If a person or thing is surrounded by something, that thing is situated all around them.

bowls.quick_def: A bowl is a round container with a wide uncovered top. Some kinds of bowl are used, for example, for serving or eating food from, or in cooking, while other larger kinds are used for washing or cleaning.

endosperm.quick_def: the part of the plant seed that provides food for the embryo

sweetish.quick_def: A sweetish smell or taste is fairly sweet.

matures.quick_def: When a child or young animal matures, it becomes an adult.

solidifies.quick_def: When a liquid solidifies or is solidified, it changes into a solid.

fat-rich.quick_def: If something is fat-rich, it contains a lot of fat.

edible.quick_def: If something is edible, it is safe to eat and not poisonous.

copra.quick_def: the dried white inner part of coconuts, from which oil is obtained

derivative.quick_def: A derivative is something which has been developed or obtained from something else.

glycerine.quick_def: Glycerine is a thick, sweet, colourless liquid that is used especially in making medicine, explosives, and antifreeze for cars.

strategic.quick_def: Strategic means relating to the most important, general aspects of something such as a military operation or political policy, especially when these are decided in advance.

sphere.quick_def: A sphere is an object that is completely round in shape like a ball.

nobel.quick_def: Nobel is related to a very famous and important prize. People who do great things in science, literature, etc. can get this prize.

nitroglycerine-based.quick_def: If something is nitroglycerine-based, it is made with nitroglycerine as an important part.

dynamite.quick_def: Dynamite is a type of explosive that contains nitroglycerin.

maritime.quick_def: Maritime is used to describe things relating to the sea and to ships.

voyagers.quick_def: A voyage is a long journey on a ship or in a spacecraft.

coastal.quick_def: Coastal is used to refer to things that are in the sea or on the land near a coast.

colonizers.quick_def: If people colonize a foreign country, they go to live there and take control of it.

energy-rich.quick_def: If something is energy-rich, it has a lot of energy in it.

float.quick_def: If something or someone is floating in a liquid, they are in the liquid, on or just below the surface, and are being supported by it. You can also float something on a liquid.

salt.quick_def: Salt is a strong-tasting substance, in the form of white powder or crystals, which is used to improve the flavour of food or to preserve it. Salt occurs naturally in sea water.

viable.quick_def: Something that is viable is capable of doing what it is intended to do.

indefinitely.quick_def: If a situation will continue indefinitely, it will continue for ever or until someone decides to change it or end it.

germinate.quick_def: If a seed germinates or if it is germinated, it starts to grow.

cast.quick_def: The cast of a play or film is all the people who act in it.

shores.quick_def: The shores or the shore of a sea, lake, or wide river is the land along the edge of it. Someone who is on shore is on the land rather than on a ship.

seeds.quick_def: A seed is the small, hard part of a plant from which a new plant grows.

pocket.quick_def: A pocket is a kind of small bag which forms part of a piece of clothing, and which is used for carrying small things such as money or a handkerchief.

embryo.quick_def: An embryo is an unborn animal or human being in the very early stages of development.

voyage.quick_def: A voyage is a long journey on a ship or in a spacecraft.

stores.quick_def: A store is a building or part of a building where things are sold. In British English, store is used mainly to refer to a large shop selling a variety of goods, but in American English a store can be any size of shop.

seedling.quick_def: A seedling is a young plant that has been grown from a seed.

americas.quick_def: People sometimes refer to North America, Central America, and South America collectively as the Americas.

vasco.quick_def: Vasco is a name for a person.

gama.quick_def: Gama is a name, often used as a person's last name. People with this name can be well-known in history or other fields.

columbus.quick_def: the capital of the US state of Ohio

sailors.quick_def: A sailor is someone who works on a ship or sails a boat.

southeast.quick_def: The southeast is the direction which is halfway between south and east.

suggestions.quick_def: If you make a suggestion, you put forward an idea or plan for someone to think about.

indigenous.quick_def: Indigenous people or things belong to the country in which they are found, rather than coming there or being brought there from another country.  [formal]

dispersed.quick_def: When something disperses or when you disperse it, it spreads over a wide area.

talking.quick_def: When you talk, you use spoken language to express your thoughts, ideas, or feelings.

high-pitched.quick_def: If a sound is high-pitched, it has a high tone. It's like the sound a small bird makes.

exaggerated.quick_def: If you exaggerate, you indicate that something is, for example, worse or more important than it really is.

repetitious.quick_def: Something that is repetitious involves actions or elements that are repeated many times and is therefore boring.  [disapproval]

linguists.quick_def: A linguist is someone who is good at speaking or learning foreign languages.

talk.quick_def: When you talk, you use spoken language to express your thoughts, ideas, or feelings.

prompting.quick_def: If you respond to prompting, you do what someone encourages or reminds you to do.

hopeful.quick_def: If you are hopeful, you are fairly confident that something that you want to happen will happen.

pregnant.quick_def: If a woman or a female animal is pregnant, she has a baby or babies developing in her body.

tongue.quick_def: Your tongue is the soft movable part inside your mouth which you use for tasting, eating, and speaking.

exposure.quick_def: Exposure to something dangerous means being in a situation where it might affect you.

mentally.quick_def: Mental means relating to the process of thinking.

prioritize.quick_def: If you prioritize something, you treat it as more important than other things.

absurd.quick_def: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.  [disapproval]

infant-directed.quick_def: If something is infant-directed, it is made or done for infants.

fathers.quick_def: Your father is your male parent. You can also call someone your father if he brings you up as if he was this man. You can call your father 'Father'.

mark.quick_def: A mark is a small area of something such as dirt that has accidentally got onto a surface or piece of clothing.

vandam.quick_def: VanDam is a surname. A surname is the family name that people share in a family.

washington.quick_def: a north-western state of the US, also called the Evergreen State. The largest city is Seattle and the capital city is Olympia. Both Britain and the US occupied the land in the first half of the 19th century. Washington became part of the Oregon Territory in 1848 and a state in 1889. Its products include wood, paper, apples and fish, and it has a large aerospace industry. Tourist attractions include Mount Rainier, Mount St Helens and Seattle's Pacific Science Center and Space Needle.

spokane.quick_def: a city in the US state of Washington

speech-recognition.quick_def: Speech-recognition is a technology that can understand and turn spoken words into text.

interacted.quick_def: When people interact with each other or interact, they communicate as they work or spend time together.

youngsters.quick_def: Young people, especially children, are sometimes referred to as youngsters.

moms.quick_def: Your mom is your mother. You can call your mom 'Mom'.  [US, informal]

dads.quick_def: Your dad is your father. You can call your dad 'Dad'.  [informal]

talked.quick_def: When you talk, you use spoken language to express your thoughts, ideas, or feelings.

familial.quick_def: Familial means relating to families in general, or typical of a family.  [formal]

mom.quick_def: Your mom is your mother. You can call your mom 'Mom'.  [US, informal]

dad.quick_def: Your dad is your father. You can call your dad 'Dad'.  [informal]

wider.quick_def: Something that is wide measures a large distance from one side or edge to the other.

repertoire.quick_def: A performer's repertoire is all the plays or pieces of music that he or she has learned and can perform.

connecticut.quick_def: a small US state forming part of New England. It was one of the 13 original states. Its nickname is the Constitution State and the state song is Yankee Doodle. Connecticut has many industries but also large forests. The capital city is Hartford, which is the centre for US insurance companies. Its largest city is Bridgeport. Many people living in south-western Connecticut travel to work each day in New York City.

conversations.quick_def: If you have a conversation with someone, you talk with them, usually in an informal situation.

audio-recording.quick_def: An audio-recording is a record of sounds that you can play back later.

vests.quick_def: A vest is a piece of underwear which you can wear on the top half of your body in order to keep warm.  [British]

eight-hour.quick_def: If something is eight-hour, it lasts for eight hours.

babble.quick_def: If someone babbles, they talk in a confused or excited way.

boosted.quick_def: If one thing boosts another, it causes it to increase, improve, or be more successful.

socioeconomic.quick_def: Socioeconomic circumstances or developments involve a combination of social and economic factors.

listened.quick_def: If you listen to someone who is talking or to a sound, you give your attention to them or it.

nairan.quick_def: Nairan is a name of a person.

ramirez-esparza.quick_def: Ramirez-Esparza is a person's name. People use names to call and identify each other.

one-on-one.quick_def: One-on-one means a situation where there is direct interaction between two people, with just one person facing another person.

mcgill.quick_def: McGill is the name of a well-known university. It's a place where people go to study and learn.

du.quick_def: In French, 'du' is a contraction of 'de le'. 'De' often shows a relationship like 'of' or 'from', and 'le' is the masculine singular definite article 'the'. So 'du' can mean 'of the' or 'from the' in masculine singular cases.

vowel.quick_def: A vowel is a sound such as the ones represented in writing by the letters 'a', 'e', 'i', ' o', and 'u', which you pronounce with your mouth open, allowing the air to flow through it. Compare consonant.

synthesizing.quick_def: To synthesize a substance means to produce it by means of chemical or biological reactions.  [technical]

mimicked.quick_def: If you mimic the actions or voice of a person or animal, you imitate them, usually in a way that is meant to be amusing or entertaining.

induced.quick_def: To induce a state or condition means to cause it.

lip.quick_def: Your lips are the two outer parts of the edge of your mouth.

approximates.quick_def: An approximate number, time, or position is close to the correct number, time, or position, but is not exact.

theorizes.quick_def: If you theorize that something is true or theorize about it, you develop an abstract idea or set of ideas about something in order to explain it.

attraction.quick_def: Attraction is a feeling of liking someone, and often of being sexually interested in them.

property.quick_def: Someone's property is all the things that belong to them or something that belongs to them.  [formal]

drawing.quick_def: When you draw, or when you draw something, you use a pencil or pen to produce a picture, pattern, or diagram.

co-author.quick_def: A co-author is a person who writes a book, article, etc. together with one or more other people.

polka.quick_def: A polka is a fast lively dance that was popular in the nineteenth century.

maybe.quick_def: You use maybe to express uncertainty, for example when you do not know that something is definitely true, or when you are mentioning something that may possibly happen in the future in the way you describe.  [vagueness]

speculating.quick_def: If you speculate about something, you make guesses about its nature or identity, or about what might happen.

proceedings.quick_def: Legal proceedings are legal action taken against someone.  [formal]

academy.quick_def: Academy is sometimes used in the names of secondary schools and colleges, or private high schools in the United States.

syllables.quick_def: A syllable is a part of a word that contains a single vowel sound and that is pronounced as a unit. So, for example, ' book' has one syllable, and ' reading' has two syllables.

non-native.quick_def: If someone or something is non-native, they are not from the place where they are now.

brain-activation.quick_def: Brain-activation means the process of making the brain start to be active.

scanner.quick_def: A scanner is a machine which is used to examine, identify, or record things, for example by using a beam of light, sound, or X-rays.

prompts.quick_def: To prompt someone to do something means to make them decide to do it.

seven-month-olds.quick_def: Seven-month-olds are babies who are seven months old.

kuhl.quick_def: Kuhl is a proper name, usually used as a person's last name.

activations.quick_def: Activations are the acts of making something start to work or become active.

harappan.quick_def: Harappan refers to something related to the Harappa area or the ancient civilization there.

pakistan.quick_def: a country in southern Asia, west of India. During the time of the British Empire it was part of India. When India became independent in 1947, Pakistan became a separate state consisting of the two areas where most of India's Muslims lived: West Pakistan to the west, and East Pakistan to the east. In 1971 there was a civil war between the two parts of the country and East Pakistan became Bangladesh. West Pakistan became Pakistan and left the Commonwealth in protest against Bangladesh becoming a member. Pakistan joined the Commonwealth again in 1989. Its capital city is Islamabad and its official language is Urdu. There are many Pakistanis living in Britain.

flourished.quick_def: If something flourishes, it is successful, active, or common, and developing quickly and strongly.

megacities.quick_def: a very large city, usually one with a population of over 10 million people

depictions.quick_def: A depiction of something is a picture or a written description of it.

self-imagery.quick_def: Self-imagery is the way you think about and picture yourself in your mind.

carving.quick_def: If you carve an object, you make it by cutting it out of a substance such as wood or stone. If you carve something such as wood or stone into an object, you make the object by cutting it out.

representations.quick_def: If a group or person has representation in a parliament or on a committee, someone in the parliament or on the committee supports them and makes decisions on their behalf.

temples.quick_def: A temple is a building used for the worship of a god or gods, especially in the Buddhist and Hindu religions, and in ancient Greek and Roman times.

petrie.quick_def: Petrie is a proper name, usually used as a person's last name.

baths.quick_def: A bath is a container, usually a long rectangular one, which you fill with water and sit in while you wash your body.  [British]

palaces.quick_def: A palace is a very large impressive house, especially one which is the official home of a king, queen, or president.

halls.quick_def: The hall in a house or flat is the area just inside the front door, into which some of the other rooms open.  [British]

streets.quick_def: A street is a road in a city, town, or village, usually with houses along it.

alleyways.quick_def: An alleyway is the same as an alley.

drainage.quick_def: Drainage is the system or process by which water or other liquids are drained from a place.

thriving.quick_def: If someone or something thrives, they do well and are successful, healthy, or strong.

uncleaned.quick_def: If something is uncleaned, it has not been made clean.

ritual.quick_def: A ritual is a religious service or other ceremony which involves a series of actions performed in a fixed order.

fell.quick_def: If someone or something falls, they move quickly downwards onto or towards the ground, by accident or because of a natural force.

demise.quick_def: The demise of something or someone is their end or death.  [formal]

glacier-fed.quick_def: If a river or lake is glacier-fed, it gets its water from a glacier.

affecting.quick_def: If something affects a person or thing, it influences them or causes them to change in some way.

invasion.quick_def: If there is an invasion of a country, a foreign army enters it by force.

well-argued.quick_def: If an argument is well-argued, it is presented clearly and has good reasons to support it.

ravindanath.quick_def: Ravindanath is a name for a person.

singh.quick_def: Singh is a common surname, often used by people, especially in India.

banaras.quick_def: Banaras is the former name of Varanasi, a city in India. It is a very famous and important place.

hindu.quick_def: A Hindu is a person who believes in Hinduism and follows its teachings.

altering.quick_def: If something alters or if you alter it, it changes.

inhabited.quick_def: If a place or region is inhabited by a group of people or a species of animal, those people or animals live there.

relation.quick_def: Relations between people, groups, or countries are contacts between them and the way in which they behave towards each other.

inaccuracies.quick_def: The inaccuracy of a statement or measurement is the fact that it is not accurate or correct.

settlements.quick_def: A settlement is an official agreement between two sides who were involved in a conflict or argument.

fundamentally.quick_def: You use fundamentally for emphasis when you are stating an opinion, or when you are making an important or general statement about something.  [emphasis]

flawed.quick_def: Something that is flawed has a mark, fault, or mistake in it.

fieldwork.quick_def: Fieldwork is the gathering of information about something in a real, natural environment, rather than in a place of study such as a laboratory or classroom.

surveys.quick_def: If you carry out a survey, you try to find out detailed information about a lot of different people or things, usually by asking people a series of questions.

astonishing.quick_def: If something or someone astonishes you, they surprise you very much.

yama.quick_def: Yama is a proper name, usually used for a person's name.

dixit.quick_def: Dixit is a proper name, usually used as a last name for a person.

hodell.quick_def: Hodell is a name, usually used to call a person.

definitive.quick_def: Something that is definitive provides a firm conclusion that cannot be questioned.

melanoides.quick_def: Melanoides is a kind of snail. It's a name for a group of these small animals with shells.

tuberculata.quick_def: Tuberculata is a name used for a kind of thing, often for a species in nature like a type of snail.

snails.quick_def: A snail is a small animal with a long, soft body, no legs, and a spiral-shaped shell. Snails move very slowly.

geochemical.quick_def: connected with the study of the different chemical substances that combine to form the earth and its rocks and minerals

tracing.quick_def: If you trace the origin or development of something, you find out or describe how it started or developed.

monsoon.quick_def: The monsoon is the season in Southern Asia when there is a lot of very heavy rain.

abrupt.quick_def: An abrupt change or action is very sudden, often in a way which is unpleasant.

evaporation.quick_def: When a liquid evaporates, or is evaporated, it changes from a liquid state to a gas, because its temperature has increased.

exceeded.quick_def: If something exceeds a particular amount or number, it is greater or larger than that amount or number.  [formal]

indicative.quick_def: If one thing is indicative of another, it suggests what the other thing is likely to be.  [formal]

weakening.quick_def: If you weaken something or if it weakens, it becomes less strong or less powerful.

lasted.quick_def: You use last in expressions such as last Friday, last night, and last year to refer, for example, to the most recent Friday, night, or year.

declined.quick_def: If something declines, it becomes less in quantity, importance, or strength.

global-scale.quick_def: If something is global-scale, it happens all over the world or affects the whole world.

local-scale.quick_def: If something is local-scale, it happens or exists in a small, local area.

larger-scale.quick_def: If something is larger-scale, it is bigger in size, amount, or degree than other similar things.

considering.quick_def: If you consider a person or thing to be something, you have the opinion that this is what they are.

variable.quick_def: Something that is variable changes quite often, and there usually seems to be no fixed pattern to these changes.

mohenjodaro.quick_def: Mohenjodaro is an ancient city in history. It was an important place in an old civilization.

harappa.quick_def: Harappa is the name of an ancient city. It is a place with a long-history and was an important part of an old civilization.

punjab.quick_def: Punjab is a region in South Asia. It is an area with its own people, culture and history.

examining.quick_def: If you examine something, you look at it carefully.

analysing.quick_def: If you analyse something, you consider it carefully or use statistical methods in order to fully understand it.

grains.quick_def: A grain of wheat, rice, or other cereal crop is a seed from it.

cultivated.quick_def: If you cultivate land or crops, you prepare land and grow crops on it.

adjusting.quick_def: When you adjust to a new situation, you get used to it by changing your behaviour or your ideas.

pottery.quick_def: You can use pottery to refer to pots, dishes, and other objects which are made from clay and then baked in an oven until they are hard.

insight.quick_def: If you gain insight or an insight into a complex situation or problem, you gain an accurate and deep understanding of it.

investigate.quick_def: If someone, especially an official, investigates an event, situation, or claim, they try to find out what happened or what is the truth.

threats.quick_def: A threat to a person or thing is a danger that something unpleasant might happen to them. A threat is also the cause of this danger.

governmental.quick_def: Governmental means relating to a particular government, or to the practice of governing a country.

administrative.quick_def: Administrative work involves organizing and supervising an organization or institution.

heritage.quick_def: A country's heritage is all the qualities, traditions, or features of life there that have continued over many years and have been passed on from one generation to another.

steam.quick_def: Steam is the hot mist that forms when water boils. Steam vehicles and machines are operated using steam as a means of power.

clippers.quick_def: Clippers are a tool used for cutting small amounts from something, especially from someone's hair or nails.

three-masted.quick_def: If a ship is three-masted, it has three masts on it.

passengers.quick_def: A passenger in a vehicle such as a bus, boat, or plane is a person who is travelling in it, but who is not driving it or working on it.

propulsion.quick_def: Propulsion is the power that moves something, especially a vehicle, in a forward direction.  [formal]

replacing.quick_def: If one thing or person replaces another, the first is used or acts instead of the second.

cutty.quick_def: Cutty is often used as a proper name, like a name for a ship or a person.

sark.quick_def: a part of the British Channel Islands, consisting of two islands, Great Sark and Little Sark, which are joined by a narrow strip of land. Sark has its own parliament, and a leader called the Seigneur (if a man) or the Dame (if a woman), who passes the title on to his or her children. The islands are popular with tourists.

greenwich.quick_def: a district of south-east London, on the south bank of the Thames, with many attractive old buildings and parks. The original Royal Observatory was built there in the 17th century. Its buildings now form part of the National Maritime Museum. The Millennium Dome was built in Greenwich as the main centre for Britain's celebrations for the year 2000. Maritime Greenwich was made a World Heritage Site in 1997.

tam.quick_def: television audience measurement (research that is used to estimate how many people watched a particular television programme)

o.quick_def: O is the fifteenth letter of the English alphabet.

scottish.quick_def: Scottish means belonging or relating to Scotland, its people, language, or culture.

poet.quick_def: A poet is a person who writes poems.

bums.quick_def: Someone's bum is the part of their body which they sit on.  [British, informal]

witch.quick_def: In fairy stories, a witch is a woman, usually an old woman, who has evil magic powers. Witches often wear a pointed black hat, and have a pet black cat.

nannie.quick_def: Nannie is a name for a woman, often used as a kind or familiar way to call an old woman.

wearing.quick_def: If you say that a situation or activity is wearing, you mean that it requires a lot of energy and makes you feel mentally or physically tired.

nightdress.quick_def: A nightdress is a sort of loose dress that a woman or girl wears in bed.  [British]

figurehead.quick_def: If someone is the figurehead of an organization or movement, they are recognized as being its leader, although they have little real power.

burns.quick_def: If there is a fire or a flame somewhere, you say that there is a fire or flame burning there.

witches.quick_def: In fairy stories, a witch is a woman, usually an old woman, who has evil magic powers. Witches often wear a pointed black hat, and have a pet black cat.

dumbarton.quick_def: Dumbarton is the name of a place in Scotland.

willis.quick_def: Willis is a name for a person.

chose.quick_def: If you choose someone or something from several people or things that are available, you decide which person or thing you want to have.

shipbuilding.quick_def: Shipbuilding is the industry of building ships.

linton.quick_def: Linton is a name, often used as a person's last name or a place name.

ensured.quick_def: To ensure something, or to ensure that something happens, means to make certain that it happens.  [formal]

contract.quick_def: A contract is a legal agreement, usually between two companies or between an employer and employee, which involves doing work for a stated sum of money.

competitor.quick_def: A company's competitors are companies who are trying to sell similar goods or services to the same people.

shipowners.quick_def: A shipowner is someone who owns a ship or ships or who has shares in a shipping company.

prestige.quick_def: If a person, a country, or an organization has prestige, they are admired and respected because of the position they hold or the things they have achieved.

maiden.quick_def: A maiden is a young girl or woman.  [literary]

laden.quick_def: If someone or something is laden with a lot of heavy things, they are holding or carrying them.  [literary]

owner.quick_def: The owner of something is the person to whom it belongs.

misfortunes.quick_def: A misfortune is something unpleasant or unlucky that happens to someone.

thermopylae.quick_def: Thermopylae is the name of a place, usually a well-known location in history.

rudder.quick_def: A rudder is a device for steering a boat. It consists of a vertical piece of wood or metal at the back of the boat.

severely.quick_def: You use severe to indicate that something bad or undesirable is great or intense.

stormy.quick_def: If there is stormy weather, there are strong winds and heavy rain.

steer.quick_def: When you steer a car, boat, or plane, you control it so that it goes in the direction that you want.

daunting.quick_def: If something daunts you, it makes you feel slightly afraid or worried about dealing with it.

repairing.quick_def: If you repair something that has been damaged or is not working properly, you mend it.

posed.quick_def: If something poses a problem or a danger, it is the cause of that problem or danger.

stronger.quick_def: Someone who is strong is healthy with good muscles and can move or carry heavy things, or do hard physical work.

violence.quick_def: Violence is behaviour which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

aboard.quick_def: If you are aboard a ship or plane, you are on it or in it.

rejected.quick_def: If you reject something such as a proposal, a request, or an offer, you do not accept it or you do not agree to it.

glorious.quick_def: Something that is glorious is very beautiful and impressive.

discouraged.quick_def: If someone or something discourages you, they cause you to lose your enthusiasm about your actions.

stopped.quick_def: If you have been doing something and then you stop doing it, you no longer do it.

copenhagen.quick_def: Copenhagen is the name of a city. It is the capital city of Denmark.

bike-share.quick_def: Bike-share is a service where people can rent bikes for a short time. They can pick up a bike and return it at different places.

deposit.quick_def: A deposit is a sum of money which is part of the full price of something, and which you pay when you agree to buy it.

coin.quick_def: A coin is a small piece of metal which is used as money.

bike.quick_def: A bike is a bicycle or a motorcycle.  [informal]

danish.quick_def: Danish means relating to or belonging to Denmark, or to its people, language, or culture.

arousing.quick_def: If something arouses a particular reaction or attitude in people, it causes them to have that reaction or attitude.

ministry.quick_def: In Britain and some other countries, a ministry is a government department which deals with a particular thing or area of activity, for example trade, defence, or transport.

guilder.quick_def: A guilder was a unit of money that was used in the Netherlands. In 2002 it was replaced by the euro.

payment.quick_def: A payment is an amount of money that is paid to someone, or the act of paying this money.

chip.quick_def: Chips are long, thin pieces of potato fried in oil or fat and eaten hot, usually with a meal.  [British]

card.quick_def: A card is a piece of stiff paper or thin cardboard on which something is written or printed.

postbank.quick_def: Postbank is a name of a bank. A bank is a place where people can save money, borrow money and do other money-related things.

conspicuous.quick_def: If someone or something is conspicuous, people can see or notice them very easily.

sturdy.quick_def: Someone or something that is sturdy looks strong and is unlikely to be easily injured or damaged.

locked.quick_def: When you lock something such as a door, drawer, or case, you fasten it, usually with a key, so that other people cannot open it.

racks.quick_def: A rack is a frame or shelf, usually with bars or hooks, that is used for holding things or for hanging things on.

stations.quick_def: A station is a building by a railway line where trains stop so that people can get on or off.

theo.quick_def: a first name for boys, short for Theodore

molenaar.quick_def: Molenaar is a family name. People with this name can be someone you know or meet.

testing.quick_def: When you test something, you try it, for example by touching it or using it for a short time, in order to find out what it is, what condition it is in, or how well it works.

vandalism.quick_def: Vandalism is the deliberate damaging of things, especially public property.

theft.quick_def: Theft is the crime of stealing.

weekend.quick_def: A weekend is Saturday and Sunday.

blow.quick_def: When a wind or breeze blows, the air moves.

abolish.quick_def: If someone in authority abolishes a system or practice, they formally put an end to it.

pivotal.quick_def: A pivotal role, point, or figure in something is one that is very important and affects the success of that thing.

disappointed.quick_def: If things or people disappoint you, they are not as good as you had hoped, or do not do what you hoped they would do.

characteristically.quick_def: The characteristics of a person or thing are the qualities or features that belong to them and make them recognizable.

jc.quick_def: JC is an abbreviation, usually used as a short form of a name or a company name.

decaux.quick_def: Decaux is the name of a French advertising corporation.

vienna.quick_def: Vienna is the capital city of Austria.

lyon.quick_def: Lyon is a city in France.

paris.quick_def: Paris is the capital city of France. It is a very famous and beautiful place with many interesting things to see.

decisive.quick_def: If a fact, action, or event is decisive, it makes it certain that there will be a particular result.

parisian.quick_def: Parisian means belonging or relating to Paris.

boasts.quick_def: If someone boasts about something that they have done or that they own, they talk about it very proudly, in a way that other people may find irritating or offensive.  [disapproval]

bicycles.quick_def: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet. You steer it by turning a bar that is connected to the front wheel.

wonderful.quick_def: If you describe something or someone as wonderful, you think they are extremely good.

filed.quick_def: A file is a box or a folded piece of heavy paper or plastic in which letters or documents are kept.

trips.quick_def: A trip is a journey that you make to a particular place.

cycle-friendly.quick_def: If a place is cycle-friendly, it is easy and safe for people to ride bicycles there.

capitals.quick_def: Capital is a large sum of money which you use to start a business, or which you invest in order to make more money.  [business]

longs.quick_def: Long means a great amount of time or for a great amount of time.

hrm.quick_def: HRM means Human Resource Management, which is about dealing with a company's employees, like hiring and managing them.

organizations.quick_def: An organization is an official group of people, for example a political party, a business, a charity, or a club.

workplaces.quick_def: Your workplace is the place where you work.

non-service.quick_def: Non-service means not related to the service industry. The service industry is about providing services to people, like restaurants or hotels. Non-service is for other kinds of work, like making things in a factory.

emphasized.quick_def: To emphasize something means to indicate that it is particularly important or true, or to draw special attention to it.

fun.quick_def: You refer to an activity or situation as fun if you think it is pleasant and enjoyable and it causes you to feel happy.

work-life.quick_def: Work-life refers to the combination of a person's work and personal life.

pfeffer.quick_def: Pfeffer is a name, usually used for a person.

emphasizes.quick_def: To emphasize something means to indicate that it is particularly important or true, or to draw special attention to it.

hospitality.quick_def: Hospitality is friendly, welcoming behaviour towards guests or people you have just met.

underdeveloped.quick_def: An underdeveloped country or region does not have modern industries and usually has a low standard of living. Some people prefer to use the term developing.

hr.quick_def: hr is a written abbreviation for hour.

relations.quick_def: Relations between people, groups, or countries are contacts between them and the way in which they behave towards each other.

broadly.quick_def: Something that is broad is wide.

turnover.quick_def: The turnover of a company is the value of the goods or services sold during a particular period of time.  [business]

cited.quick_def: If you cite something, you quote it or mention it, especially as an example or proof of what you are saying.  [formal]

inadequate.quick_def: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

compromised.quick_def: A compromise is a situation in which people accept something slightly different from what they really want, because of circumstances or because they are considering the wishes of other people.

morale.quick_def: Morale is the amount of confidence and cheerfulness that a group of people have.

maroudas.quick_def: Maroudas is a name of a person. People use names to call and identify each other.

et.quick_def: a film (1982) directed and produced by Steven Spielberg. ET is an ' extraterrestrial' (= a visitor from space) who has been left on earth by mistake. Three children protect him until he can return to his planet. The film was then the most successful ever made and won several Oscars.

al.quick_def: a first name for boys, short for Alan, Albert or Alexander

ng.quick_def: In this context, 'Ng' is likely a surname. A surname is the family name that a person shares with other family members.

sorensen.quick_def: Sorensen is a common surname. A surname is the family name that a person shares with other family members.

obstacles.quick_def: An obstacle is an object that makes it difficult for you to go where you want to go, because it is in your way.

obligated.quick_def: If something obligates you to do a particular thing, it creates a situation where you have to do it.  [formal]

summarized.quick_def: If you summarize something, you give a summary of it.

michel.quick_def: Michel is a name for a person.

organization.quick_def: An organization is an official group of people, for example a political party, a business, a charity, or a club.

retention.quick_def: The retention of something is the keeping of it.  [formal]

improvement.quick_def: If there is an improvement in something, it becomes better. If you make improvements to something, you make it better.

predisposition.quick_def: If you have a predisposition to behave in a particular way, you tend to behave like that because of the kind of person that you are or the attitudes that you have.  [formal]

negatively.quick_def: A fact, situation, or experience that is negative is unpleasant, depressing, or harmful.

spector.quick_def: Spector is a name, usually a person's last name.

poulston.quick_def: Poulston is a name, maybe a person's name. People use it to call someone.

vacations.quick_def: A vacation is a period of the year when universities and colleges, and in the United States also schools, are officially closed.

troubling.quick_def: You can refer to problems or difficulties as trouble.

recognized.quick_def: If you recognize someone or something, you know who that person is or what that thing is.

schneider.quick_def: Schneider is a common surname. A surname is the family name that a person shares with other family members.

bowen.quick_def: Bowen is a name, usually used for a person.

representation.quick_def: If a group or person has representation in a parliament or on a committee, someone in the parliament or on the committee supports them and makes decisions on their behalf.

guest.quick_def: A guest is someone who is visiting you or is at an event because you have invited them.

dichotomy.quick_def: If there is a dichotomy between two things, there is a very great difference or opposition between them.  [formal]

inspire.quick_def: If someone or something inspires you to do something new or unusual, they make you want to do it.

enz.quick_def: Enz is a name, usually used to refer to a person.

siguaw.quick_def: Siguaw is a name, usually used to refer to a person.

implies.quick_def: If you imply that something is the case, you say something which indicates that it is the case in an indirect way.

favorable.quick_def: If your opinion or your reaction is favorable to something, you agree with it and approve of it.

herzberg.quick_def: Herzberg is a person's name. Usually, it refers to someone who may be well-known in a certain field, like in the field of motivation theory.

extrinsic.quick_def: Extrinsic reasons, forces, or factors exist outside the person or situation they affect.  [formal]

performed.quick_def: When you perform a task or action, especially a complicated one, you do it.

unfavorable.quick_def: Unfavorable conditions or circumstances cause problems for you and reduce your chances of success.

dissatisfaction.quick_def: If you feel dissatisfaction with something, you are not contented or pleased with it.

motivators.quick_def: Motivators are things that make people want to do something.

motivator.quick_def: a thing or person that makes somebody want to do something, especially something that involves hard work and effort

discusses.quick_def: If people discuss something, they talk about it, often in order to reach a decision.

motivating.quick_def: If you are motivated by something, especially an emotion, it causes you to behave in a particular way.

tews.quick_def: Tews is a name, like a person's family name.

stafford.quick_def: a town in western central England. It is the administrative centre of Staffordshire and a traditional centre of the shoemaking industry.

themed.quick_def: A themed place or event has been created so that it shows a particular historical time or way of life, or tells a well-known story.  [mainly British]

framing.quick_def: The frame of a picture or mirror is the wood, metal, or plastic that is fitted around it, especially when it is displayed or hung on a wall.

organizational.quick_def: Organizational abilities and methods relate to the way that work, activities, or events are planned and arranged.

deery.quick_def: Deery is a name, usually a person's last name.

recommended.quick_def: If someone recommends a person or thing to you, they suggest that you would find that person or thing good or useful.

balancing.quick_def: If you balance something somewhere, or if it balances there, it remains steady and does not fall.
